safi-cedvel:105-105.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (لا) prohibitive, causing the jussive. (تكونوا) a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is a pronoun, the ism (subject) of kāna. (الكاف) a preposition [Note: or a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as the khabar of تكونوا.], (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of تكونوا. (تفرّقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الواو) conjunction. (اختلفوا) like تفرّقوا. (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تفرّقوا or اختلفوا), (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. (جاء) a past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (البيّنات) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءهم البيّنات) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(الواو) resumptive. (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address. (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive; attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (عظيم) naʿt (adjective) of عذاب, nominative like it.
The clause «لا تكونوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لتكن منكم أمّة [Note: in the previous verse (104).].
The clause «تفرّقوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «اختلفوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «جاءهم البيّنات» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لهم عذاب» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.

safi-cedvel:106-106.t:
* I'rab:
(يوم) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of العذاب in the previous verse. (تبيض) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (وجوه) fāʿil (agent), nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (تسود وجوه) like تبيضّ وجوه. (الفاء) of consequence (tafrīʿiyya), resumptive. (أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (اسودّت) a past verb ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (وجوه) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).. The khabar of the mubtadaʾ is omitted, its implied form being "فيقال لهم" (so it will be said to them) ... (الهمزة) for reproachful interrogation. (كفرتم) a verb and its fāʿil. (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (كفرتم), (إيمان) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (ذوقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (العذاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الباء) a preposition of causation. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. (كنتم) a defective past verb and its ism (subject). (تكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم تكفرون) is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, attached to (ذوقوا).
The clause «تبيضّ وجوه» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تسودّ وجوه» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause تبيضّ.
The clause «الذين اسودّت ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اسودّت وجوههم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أكفرتم ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb which is the khabar ... i.e.: so Allah will say to them, or the angels will say: أكفرتم.
The clause «ذوقوا» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن كفرتم فذوقوا (if you disbelieved, then taste).
The clause «كنتم تكفرون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تكفرون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كنتم.

* Rhetoric:
1- The whiteness of the face and its blackness are two kināyas (metonymies) for the appearance in it of the radiance of joy and the gloom of fear. This is also one of the arts of rhetoric called the art of tadbīj (colour-weaving), which is an art subtle in its course, sweet in its derivation, elegant in its signification. Its definition is that the poet or prose writer mentions two or more colours, intending thereby a kināya or tawriya (double entendre) for the purposes he intends, and he may intend nothing but description.
2- Istiʿāra (metaphor): in «ذوق العذاب» (tasting the punishment), He likened it to something bitter that is eaten, then deleted the thing compared to and kept one of its concomitants, which is tasting. The feeling of bitterness in it is not hidden. That is by way of the dependent (tabaʿiyya), implicit (makniyya) metaphor.

safi-cedvel:107-107.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (أمّا الذين ابيضّت وجوههم) like أمّا الذين اسودّت وجوههم in the previous verse. (الفاء) occurring in the answer of أمّا. (في رحمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الذين) [Note: Some of the grammarians indicated that the preposition is attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هم ... and this clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).]. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خالدون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «الذين ابيضّت وجوههم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اسودّت ... [Note: in the previous verse.].
The clause «ابيضّت وجوههم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم فيها خالدون» has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: It may be a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين..].

* Rhetoric:
1- «فَفِي رَحْمَتِ اللَّهِ» i.e. Paradise and everlasting bliss. He expressed it by "mercy" to draw attention to the fact that the believer, even if he spends his entire life in obedience to Allah the Exalted, does not enter Paradise except by His mercy, the Exalted. This is by way of majāz mursal (non-metaphorical trope), and the relation in it is al-ḥāliyya (the thing occupying for its place), because a human being does not dwell in mercy; he dwells only in its place, which is Paradise.

* Benefits:
1- In these two verses Quranic eloquence manifests itself in its clearest forms. They comprise several arts of inimitability: in them is compound ṭibāq (antithesis) between whiteness and blackness; in them is detailing after «أمّا»; in them is muqābala (correspondence) in the recompense; in them is concision, which is one of the root features of the Noble Qur'an; and finally this clarity by means of embodying and giving form to abstract matters and bestowing on them movement accompanied by colours.

safi-cedvel:108-108.t:
* I'rab:
(تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn appearing on the yāʾ which was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (آيات) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: It may be a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative ... and the clause نتلوها is the khabar.], (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (نتلو) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being نحن, for majesty. (على) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نتلوها), (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of نتلو. (الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative, acting like ليس. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the ism (subject) of ما. (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "He". (ظلما) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (اللام) redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening. (العالمين) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar (ظلما).
The clause «تلك آيات الله» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «نتلوها ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of آيات.
The clause «ما الله يريد ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يريد ظلما» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of ما.

* Morphology:
(ظلما), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ظلم يظلم, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn. There are other maṣdars: ظلما with fatḥa on its first letter, and مظلمة with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the lām.

* Rhetoric:
1- «تِلْكَ آياتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوها عَلَيْكَ» attributing that to Him, the Exalted, is majāz (figurative), since the reciter is Jibrīl, peace be upon him, by His command, Glorified and Exalted is He. In His departing from the literal, together with the iltifāt (shift) to the first person with the nūn of majesty, there is evident care for the recitation and for the one to whom it is recited.
2- «وَمَا اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْماً لِلْعالَمِينَ» the iltifāt (shift) to the Majestic Name, as an intimation of the cause of the ruling, is a declaration of His perfect transcendence, Mighty and Majestic is He, above injustice, beyond which nothing can be added; i.e. He does not want a single instance of injustice for a single one of the beings of the worlds.

safi-cedvel:109-109.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the first ما. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) like the first, and conjoined to it. (في الأرض) like في السموات, attached to the ṣila of the second ما. (الواو) conjunction. (إلى الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ترجع), which is an imperfect verb, passive, nominative (marfūʿ). (الأمور) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative.
The clause «لله ما في السموات ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «ترجع الأمور» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لله ما في السموات.

* Rhetoric:
- «وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ» using the overt noun where a pronoun would be expected, to instil awe.

safi-cedvel:147-147.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (ما) negative; (كان) a deficient past verb; (قول) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, fronted, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أن) a maṣdar particle; (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن قالوا ...) is in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna, postponed.
(ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اغفر) an imperative verb of supplication, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (اللام) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اغفر); (ذنوب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (إسراف) conjoined to ذنوب, accusative like it, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ثبّت أقدامنا) like اغفر ... ذنوبنا; (الواو) conjunction; (انصر) like اغفر, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (على القوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انصرنا); (الكافرين) a naʿt (adjective) of القوم, genitive like it, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «ما كان قولهم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ما وهنوا in the previous verse.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «the vocative and what falls within its scope» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb "to say" (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ثبّت» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that answers the vocative.
The clause «انصرنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that answers the vocative.

* Morphology:
(إسراف): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the four-letter verb أسرف; its pattern is إفعال, with a kasra on the hamza.

* Benefits:
1- «وَما كانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ قالُوا»: there are two views on the i'rab of this passage:
The first: that «قولهم» is the fronted khabar of kāna, and the noun of kāna is the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb. The second: the reverse, so that قولهم is the subject («the noun of kāna»), and the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن and the verb» is in the position of accusative as its khabar. I do not know what made the majority, with the exception of Ibn Kathīr and ʿĀṣim, incline to the first view, given that it requires fronting and postponement, whereas the second view dispenses with fronting and postponement, and on it the meaning is coherent and becomes clearer.

safi-cedvel:148-148.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive, linking the cause to the effect; (آتى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (ثواب) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الدنيا) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (حسن) conjoined to ثواب, accusative like it; (ثواب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الآخرة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil being "he" (هو); (المحسنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «آتاهم الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله يحبّ ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يحبّ المحسنين» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

safi-cedvel:149-149.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; (وها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from أيّ - following it in its position - or a naʿt (adjective) of it; (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (إن) a jussivizing conditional particle; (تطيعوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الذين) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (كفروا) like آمنوا; (يردّوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (على أعقاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يردّوكم); (كم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) conjunction; (تنقلبوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to يردّوا ...
and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (خاسرين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «يأيّها الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إن تطيعوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يردّوكم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussivizing condition not joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «تنقلبوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause.

safi-cedvel:150-150.t:
* I'rab:
(بل) a particle of digression (iḍrāb); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (مولى) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (خير) khabar, nominative; (الناصرين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «الله مولاكم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «هو خير الناصرين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

safi-cedvel:151-151.t:
* I'rab:
(السين) a particle of futurity; (نلقي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "we" (نحن), for majesty; (في قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نلقي); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ...
and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الرعب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar particle; (أشركوا) like كفروا; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أشركوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أشركوا) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (نلقي).
(ما) a relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), and the clause is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of it.]» indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (لم) a particle of negation, conversion (qalb) and jussivization; (ينزّل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ينزّل); (سلطانا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (مأوى) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (النار) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (بئس) an inert (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (مثوى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif; (الظالمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "the Fire" (النار).
The clause «سنلقي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أشركوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the maṣdar relative particle (ما).
The clause «ينزّل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «مأواهم النار» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «بئس مثوى الظالمين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الرعب): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رعب يرعب, of the fataḥa class (bāb fataḥa); its pattern is فعل with a ḍamma on the fāʾ, and there is another maṣdar with a fatḥa on it.
(سلطان): it has been treated like a maṣdar and so is not pluralised; it is a noun meaning proof and evidence, and its derivation is from السليط, which is what is used for lighting ... Every سلطان in the Qur'an means proof. Its pattern is فعلان with a ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(مأوى): a noun of place on the pattern مفعل, with a fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn because it is defective (nāqiṣ); it involves a phonetic change (iʿlāl); its original form is مأوي.
(مثوى): a noun of place on the pattern مفعل, with a fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn because it is defective (nāqiḍ) «[Translator's note: the source has ناقض, evidently a misprint for ناقص "defective", as in the previous entry.]»; it involves a phonetic change; its original form is مثوي.

* Rhetoric:
1- Iltifāt (shift of address): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «سَنُلْقِي فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا», where He expressed it with the nūn of majesty by way of a shift from the third person to the first person, following the way of grandeur, in order to instil awe.
2- Istiʿāra (metaphor): in His saying «سنلقي», since Allah cast terror into their hearts on the day of Uḥud, and they fled in defeat to Mecca without cause, while they had strength and the upper hand. So "casting" is borrowed here for terror, by way of embodiment and personification, treating the abstract as though it were material.

* Benefits:
1-
It has come in the reports: from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I have been given five things that were not given to any of the prophets before me: I have been helped by terror at a distance of a month's journey; the earth has been made for me a place of prayer and a means of purification; the spoils of war have been made lawful for me; I have been given the intercession; and a prophet used to be sent to his own people specifically, while I have been sent to all people generally." «Narrated by the two Shaykhs», al-Bukhārī and Muslim.

safi-cedvel:60-60.t:
* I'rab:
(الحقّ) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: Or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the account of ʿĪsā or the matter of ʿĪsā; and (من ربّك) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a second khabar.]», (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar; and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تكن) an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the ism of تكن is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being (أنت); (من الممترين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of تكون, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «الحقّ من ربّك» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا تكن ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of an implied, non-jussive condition, i.e.:
إذا كان الأمر كذلك فلا تكن من الممترين (if the matter is so, then do not be among the doubters).

* Rhetoric:
- «فَلا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ»: His forbidding him from doubt — and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is far above being a doubter — is by way of stirring him up to increase his steadfastness and tranquillity, and it may be a kindness to others.

safi-cedvel:61-61.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (من) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (حاجّ) a past verb, mabnī on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (في) a preposition; (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حاجّ), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. في أمره (concerning his matter); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حاجّ); (ما) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) «[Note: Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī rejected (ما) being maṣdariyya — contrary to al-Akhfash — because no pronoun refers back to a maṣdar particle, according to the view of Sībawayh and the majority. And in (حاجّك) there is a pronoun as fāʿil, since nothing after it is fit to be the fāʿil; and العلم cannot be the fāʿil, because (من) is not redundant in an affirmative statement.]», (جاء) a past verb, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو; (من العلم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent pronoun in جاء; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is أنت; (تعالوا) an imperative verb, mabnī on the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ندع) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), as it is the answer to the request, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being نحن; (أبناء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction in the five places; (أبناءكم، نساءنا، نساءكم أنفسنا، أنفسكم) expressions composed of muḍāf and muḍāf ilayhi, conjoined by conjunctions to (أبناء), accusative like it; (ثم) a conjunction; (نبتهل) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to ندع, and the fāʿil is نحن; (الفاء) conjunction; (نجعل) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (نبتهل), and the fāʿil is نحن; (لعنة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (على الكاذبين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of (نجعل).. i.e. نجعل لعنة الله واقعة على الكاذبين (we make the curse of Allah fall upon the liars) ...
The clause «من حاجّك» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّ مثل ... in the previous verse.
The clause «حاجّك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «جاءك» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «قل ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تعالوا» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «ندع» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ «[Note: Ibn Hishām says: in interpreting the condition we must say: تعالوا فإن تأتوا ندع (come, for if you come we will call); it is not permissible to assume فإن تتعالوا, because (تعال) is an inflexible (jāmid) verb having neither an imperfect nor a past, so much so that some — namely al-Zamakhsharī — imagined it to be a verbal noun (ism fiʿl).]».
The clause «نبتهل» is conjoined to the clause ندع.
The clause «نجعل» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause نبتهل.

* Morphology:
(تعالوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the quiescent alif before the quiescent wāw of the plural was deleted to avoid the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the letter before the wāw was given a fatḥa to indicate it «[Note: It is permissible to give the wāw a ḍamma in (تعالوا) — in a reading other than Ḥafṣ — according to the dialect of the people of the Hijaz.]»; or it is an inflexible (jāmid) verb that comes in the imperative with pronouns attached to it, or without attaching pronouns (تعال); on that view it involves neither deletion nor iʿlāl.
(ندع): it contains iʿlāl by deletion because of the jussive; its pattern is نفع.
(الكاذبين): plural of الكاذب, active participle of the triliteral كذب, on the pattern فاعل.

safi-cedvel:62-62.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (ها) a particle of alerting; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the ism of إنّ; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (هو) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: It may be a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is القصص.. and the nominal clause is the khabar of إنّ.]», (القصص) khabar of إنّ, nominative (marfūʿ); (الحقّ) naʿt (adjective) of القصص, nominative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating, inoperative; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (اله) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative «[Note: The khabar may be omitted, the implied form being: ما من إله لنا (there is no god for us).. so (إلّا) is a particle of exception, and the Name of Majesty is a badal (substitute) of the position of إله.. Abū Ḥayyān chose this analysis.]», (الواو) conjunction; (إنّ) like the first; (الله) the Name of Majesty, ism of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (لهو العزيز) like لهو القصص; (الحكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «إنّ هذا لهو القصص» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما من إله إلّا الله» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «إنّ الله لهو العزيز» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive one.

* Morphology:
(القصص): maṣdar (verbal noun) of قصّ يقصّ, of the نصر class.. Its original meaning is following a track, for the narrator (القاصّ) follows one report after another; the pattern of القصص is فعل with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:63-63.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a conditional particle making the verb jussive; (تولّوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) «[Note: The verb may be an imperfect from which one of the two tāʾs was deleted.. it is then jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.]».. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّ الله عليم) a particle resembling the verb, its ism and its khabar; (بالمفسدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عليم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «أن تولّوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an earlier resumption. «[Translator's note: The source writes «أن تولّوا» here, while the Quranic text is «فإن تولّوا».]»
The clause «إنّ الله عليم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ ...
The clause may also be a causal explanation (taʿlīl) of the implied apodosis, i.e. فإن تولّوا فهم المفسدين لأن الله عليم بهم (if they turn away, they are the corrupters, because Allah knows them). «[Translator's note: The source writes «المفسدين» here, though as a khabar one would expect «المفسدون».]»

safi-cedvel:64-64.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت; (يا) a vocative particle; (أهل) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb); (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (تعالوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الى كلمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تعالوا); (سواء) naʿt (adjective) of كلمة, genitive like it; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to سواء since it is a maṣdar (verbal noun); and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (بين) like the first, conjoined to it and attached to what the first is attached to; and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; (أن) a maṣdar particle that makes the verb subjunctive; (لا) negating; (نعبد) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being نحن; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا نعبد ...) is in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) of كلمة سواء.. i.e. تعالوا إلى ترك عبادة غير الله (come to abandoning the worship of other than Allah).. It may also be that the maṣdar is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هي, and the clause is explicative of سواء.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (نشرك) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, conjoined to (نعبد), and the fāʿil is نحن; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نشرك); (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (يتّخذ) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, conjoined to (نعبد); (بعض) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (نا) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (بعضا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (أربابا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of أرباب; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) resumptive; (إن تولّوا) its i'rab was given in the previous verse; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قولوا) an imperative verb, mabnī on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (اشهدوا) like قولوا; (الباء) a preposition; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (نا) a pronoun, the ism of أنّ, in the position of accusative; (مسلمون) khabar of أنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّا مسلمون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (اشهدوا).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The vocative clause «يا أهل الكتاب» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «تعالوا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «لا نعبد إلّا الله» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا نشرك..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا نعبد.
The clause «لا يتّخذ بعضنا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا نعبد.
The clause «تولّوا» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قولوا ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «اشهدوا ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.

* Benefits:
- سواء: meaning "equal, level" (مستو); a place is described by it, as in «فكانا سوى», and it is one of the adjectives that came on the pattern فعل, like their saying «ماء روى» and «قوم عدى». It comes with the meaning of "the middle", as in the words of Allah the Exalted: فِي سَواءِ الْجَحِيمِ, and with the meaning of "complete", as in their saying «هذا درهم سواء».
سواء is used as a predicate of one or more, as in «ليسوا سواء». And «سواء» is used for equalization, followed by the hamza of equalization and then the word أم, as in the words of Allah the Exalted: «سَواءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ», i.e. your warning and its absence are equal.
His words, Exalted is He: «لِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ»: when ما comes attached in an interrogative context, the deletion of its alif is obligatory, and that is in «علام وإلام وحتام، وبم، وعمّ وفيم، وممّ». They said this is for reasons, among them distinguishing it from the particle «ما», its being joined to the preposition, and lightening the pronunciation; and the fatḥa indicates to us that what was deleted is an «alif».

safi-cedvel:65-65.t:
* I'rab:
(يا أهل الكتاب) its i'rab was given in the previous verse; (اللام) a preposition; (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تحاجّون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (في إبراهيم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تحاجّون), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote, being a proper name and foreign; (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (ما) negating; (أنزل) a past verb, passive, and (التاء) for the feminine; (التوراة) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (الإنجيل) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to التوراة, nominative like it; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزلت), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval; (الفاء) conjunction; (لا) negating; (تعقلون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The vocative clause «يا أهل الكتاب» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تحاجّون» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أنزلت التوراة» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «تعقلون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
أغفلتم فلا تعقلون (have you become heedless, so that you do not reason?).

safi-cedvel:22-22.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الكاف) is for address. (الذين): a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). (حبط): past verb, and (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine. (أعمال): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (في الدنيا): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from أعمال; the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra. (الواو): conjunction. (الآخرة): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الدنيا, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): negating. (اللام): preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (من): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (ناصرين): genitive in form, nominative in position, as a postponed mubtadaʾ; the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «أولئك الذين..» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of (إنّ) in the previous verse «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position, being resumptive.]».
The clause «حبطت أعمالهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ما لهم من ناصرين» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(ناصرين): plural of ناصر, active participle from نصر; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
- «وَما لَهُمْ مِنْ ناصِرِينَ»: the grammarians have been accustomed to regard the redundant preposition as being only for emphasis, and it has escaped their minds that these particles carry significations far beyond emphasis. When we state the report stripped of this particle or that, it is a report that admits of truth and falsehood, as the scholars of rhetoric say; but when the redundant preposition enters, the report rises to the rank of fact and certainty.

safi-cedvel:23-23.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for interrogation. (تر): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the jussive particle (لم); the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (إلى): preposition. (الذين): a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تر). (أوتوا): past verb, passive, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (نصيبا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (من الكتاب): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (نصيبا). (يدعون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), passive, with its nāʾib fāʿil. (إلى كتاب): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدعون). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (اللام): the lām of causation. (يحكم): imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) implied after the lām, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (بين): adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يحكم), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحكم) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يدعون).
(ثمّ): conjunction. (يتولّى): imperfect verb, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif. (فريق): fāʿil, nominative. (من): preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun ل (نصيبا), (يدعون) imperfect verb, nominative, passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (إلى in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of فريق «[Translator's note: the printed text is garbled here: material from the parsing of (من الكتاب) and (يدعون) above has intruded; the intended sense is evidently: (من) preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of فريق.]». (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (معرضون): khabar (predicate), nominative; the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «ألم تر..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أوتوا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يدعون..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the relative الذين أوتوا.
The clause «يحكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يتولّى فريق» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يدعون.
The clause «هم معرضون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from فريق منهم.

* Morphology:
(نصيبا): the noun from أنصبه, said when one assigns him a share and portion; its pattern is فعيل (al-Baqara 202).
(يدعون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the lām of the word, the alif, was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent wāw of the plural; its pattern is يفعون with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn (see al-Baqara 221).

* Benefits:
1- لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ: the lām is the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl). The difference between it and the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd) lies in two matters:
First, it comes in an affirmative context, while the lām of denial comes in a negative context. Second, both of them make the verb accusative by an أن implied after them, but أن is implied optionally after the lām of causation and obligatorily after the lām of denial.
2- The Messenger ﷺ called the Jews to Islam; they asked him about his religion and he answered them that he was upon the creed of Ibrāhīm. The Jews claimed that Ibrāhīm was a Jew, so he asked them to take the Torah as judge, and they refused.
3- In His saying, the Exalted, «مِنَ الْكِتابِ», this مِن is partitive, and it has been said it is explicative; it contains an indication that the Jews had an ample share of the Torah.

safi-cedvel:24-24.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلك): a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the reference is to the turning away..
(اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (الباء): preposition. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb, and (هم) is a pronoun, the noun of أنّ. (قالوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم قالوا) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك).
(لن): accusative-governing particle. (تمسّ): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (النار): fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (إلّا): particle of restriction. (أيّاما): adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تمسّنا). (معدودات): naʿt (adjective) of أيام, accusative like it; the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (الواو): conjunction. (غرّ): past verb, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (في دين): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (غرّ), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (ما): a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil — or a maṣdar particle, the interpreted maṣdar being the fāʿil. (كانوا): an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the noun of kāna. (يفترون): imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ذلك بأنّهم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive and causal.
The clause «قالوا..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «لن تمسّنا النار» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «غرّهم.. ما كانوا» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause قالوا.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal or particle relative (ما).
The clause «يفترون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kāna.

* Morphology:
(معدودات): plural of معدود, passive participle from the verb عدّ on the pattern مفعول (al-Baqara 203).
(يفترون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is يفتريون: the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made quiescent by transferring its vowel to the rāʾ; then the yāʾ was deleted because it was quiescent and the wāw after it was quiescent.. Its pattern is يفتعون.

safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): resumptive. (كيف): an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "صنعهم" or "حالهم" «[Note: It may be accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) by an omitted verb, its implied form being "يصنعون".. The first implied form is more regular.]». (إذا): an adverb stripped of the conditional sense, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied mubtadaʾ, since it is construed as a maṣdar (verbal noun) «[Note: Or it is attached to the implied verb.]». (جمعنا): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. (نا) is the fāʿil (agent), and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (ليوم): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جمعناهم), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "for the recompense of a day". (لا): the lā of generic negation. (ريب): the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative. (في): preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of lā. (الواو): conjunction. (وفّيت): past verb, passive..
and (التاء) is for the feminine. (كلّ): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative. (نفس): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (كسبت): past verb.. (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (الواو): of the ḥāl. (هم): a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. (لا): negating. (يظلمون): imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «كيف (حالهم)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «جمعناهم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا ريب فيه» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of يوم.
The clause «وفّيت كلّ نفس» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause لا ريب فيه. In the clause there is an implied linking element, i.e. "every soul was paid in full in it".
The clause «كسبت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "كسبته".
The clause «هم لا يظلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «لا يظلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

* Rhetoric:
1- With His saying «فكيف» the interrogative has departed from its literal meaning: it is a rebuttal of their saying mentioned above and an invalidation of what deluded them, by magnifying what will overtake them and making fearsome the horrors that will befall them, i.e. "how then will their state be?"

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "أنت". (الله): the Name of Majesty, a vocative of a single proper name (munādā mufrad ʿalam) from which the vocative particle has been omitted, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; (الميم) with shadda is redundant (zāʾida), a compensation for the vocative particle. (مالك): badal (substitute) from the Name of Majesty, following its position in the accusative because it is a muḍāf «[Note: Or it is a second vocative, accusative.. and the clause is a badal from the first vocative clause.. Abū Ḥayyān chose this.]». (الملك): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (تؤتي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الملك): first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (من): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi. (تشاء): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "أنت". (الواو): conjunction. (تنزع الملك): like تؤتي الملك. (من): preposition. (من): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تنزع). (تشاء): like the first. (الواو): conjunction in both places. (تعزّ من تشاء، تذلّ من تشاء): like تؤتي.. من تشاء. (بيد): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (الكاف): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الخير): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, the noun of إنّ. (على كلّ): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير. (شيء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (قدير): the khabar of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «قل..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «the vocative and what is within its scope» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تؤتي الملك» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «تشاء (the first)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (من).
The clause «تنزع الملك» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause تؤتي.
The clause «تشاء (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «تعز» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause تؤتي.
The clause «تشاء (the third)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative (من).
The clause «تذلّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause تؤتي.
The clause «تشاء (the fourth)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the fourth relative (من).
The clause «بيدك الخير» has no grammatical position, being a badal from the clause تؤتي الملك «[Note: Or it is resumptive.]».
The clause «انّك.. قدير» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(مالك): active participle from ملك; its pattern is فاعل (see al-Fātiḥa, verse 4).
(الملك): either a noun meaning "what is owned" or a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ملك يملك, of the ضرب class; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(الخير): either a noun meaning "what is good" or a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the verb خار يخير, of the ضرب class; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Iktifāʾ (sufficing with one of two): in His saying «بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ», where He singled out good for mention — though evil too is [in His hand] — intending both good and evil, and sufficed with one of them because it points to the other, as in His saying, the Exalted, «سَرابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ», i.e. "and the cold". He singled out good for mention only because it is what is desired.
2- In the verse there is «the art of muqābala (sustained antithesis)»: He set in contrast «تؤتي» and «تنزع», and «تعز» and «تذل».

* Benefits:
1- قل اللهمّ: the word «اللهم» is a vocative from which the yāʾ of the vocative has been deleted and compensated by the doubled mīm; this treatment is peculiar to the Name of Majesty. The doubled mīm may be joined to the Name of Majesty in two other cases besides the vocative:
The first: that it comes before a particle of reply, to strengthen the reply, as when you say to someone asking about a matter «اللهم نعم» (Yes, by Allah / Indeed yes).
The second: to indicate the rarity of the thing's occurrence, as when you say to someone whose ability in trade you doubt: "You will make a profit — اللهم (only) if you study the affairs of the market and choose your goods well."
2- The compound antithesis «al-muqābala» has spanned the two verses in their entirety, and it has spread through the atmosphere of these two verses a kind of inimitable Quranic music; it has also established contrasting meanings, thereby making them clearer and bringing the absolute power of Allah in all circumstances nearer to the mind.

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(تولج): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الليل): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (في النهار): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تولج). (الواو): conjunction. (تولج النهار في الليل): like تولج الليل في النهار. (الواو): conjunction. (تخرج): like تولج. (الحيّ): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من الميّت): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخرج). (الواو): conjunction. (تخرج الميّت من الحيّ): like تخرج الحيّ من الميّت. (الواو): conjunction. (ترزق): like تولج. (من): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (تشاء): like تولج. (بغير): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of تشاء «[Note: I.e. "whomever You will to provide for, being generous".. or from the object, i.e. "whomever You will, being honoured" (mukram, with fatḥa on the rāʾ)..
It may also be attached to a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) governed by ترزق, i.e. "You provide him a provision without reckoning", or "You provide him abundantly without reckoning"..]». (حساب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).
The clause «تولج ... (the first)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تولج ... the second» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تخرج (the first)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تخرج (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ترزق» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تشاء» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).

* Morphology:
(تولج): it contains deletion of the hamza for lightening, like تنفق and تكرم; its origin is تؤولج, with ḍamma on the tāʾ and fatḥa on the hamza.
(الحيّ): an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from حيي يحيى, of the فرح class; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn (see al-Baqara 255).

* Rhetoric:
1- The explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya): if by the living and the dead He meant the Muslim and the unbeliever.
For it has been said in the exegesis of this verse: "You bring forth the believer from the unbeliever and the unbeliever from the believer." If this meaning is intended, the verse contains an explicit metaphor; and if the sperm-drop and the egg are intended, the speech runs on the side of literal truth, not on the side of figurative usage.

safi-cedvel:28-28.t:
* I'rab:
(لا): the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. (يتّخذ): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. (المؤمنون): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (الكافرين): first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ. (أولياء): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; it does not take tanwīn because it is assimilated to nouns ending in the extended alif of the feminine, on the pattern أفعلاء. (من دون): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أولياء «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from المؤمنين, i.e. "passing over".. It may also be attached to the verb يتّخذ, with (من) for the beginning of the extent.]». (المؤمنين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ. (الواو): parenthetical. (من): a jussive-governing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (يفعل): imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (ليس): an incomplete past verb; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring back to the conditional noun. (من الله): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from شيء — an adjective that has been placed before the noun it qualifies — i.e. "he is not upon anything of the religion of Allah", so there is an omitted muḍāf in the speech. (في شيء): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ليس. (إلا): particle of restriction. (أن): maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (تتّقوا): imperfect verb, accusative; the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من): preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تتّقوا). (تقاة): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar because it meets it in derivation «[Note: It may be accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "that you fear from them something or a matter that must be guarded against".]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تتّقوا..) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), its governor being لا يتّخذ, i.e. "let the believer not take the unbeliever as a protector for any reason whatsoever except outward guarding" «[Note: See verse (229) of Sūrat al-Baqara and the i'rab of (إلّا) there, and see the footnote on the construal of the exception.]»; the exception in this case is emptied (mufarragh) for the mafʿūl li-ajlihi.
(الواو): conjunction. (يحذّر): imperfect verb, nominative, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (نفس): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): resumptive. (إلى الله): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (المصير): postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The clause «لا يتّخذ المؤمنون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «من يفعل (the nominal one)» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «يفعل ذلك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.]».
The clause «ليس من الله» في شيء is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تتّقوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يحذركم الله..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «إلى الله المصير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(أولياء): plural of وليّ, on the measure فعيل, an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) formed irregularly, taken from the quadriliteral والى (al-Baqara 107).
(تقاة): it contains ibdāl (letter substitution) and iʿlāl (weak-letter change). The ibdāl is the changing of the wāw into tāʾ; its origin is وقية, taken from الوقاية. The iʿlāl is the changing of the yāʾ into alif because it is voweled and what precedes it has fatḥa. Its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn. In al-Mukhtār: تقى يتقي like قضى يقضي; التقوى and التقى are one thing, and التقاة is التقية; one says اتّقى تقية وتقاة. In al-Qāmūs:
تقيت الشيء أتّقيه, of the ضرب class.

* Rhetoric:
1- «إِلَّا أَنْ تَتَّقُوا», in the form of address by way of iltifāt (shift of person) from the third person, is an emptied exception from the most general of states; the governor is the verb of prohibition, with address taken into account in it, as if it were said: "Do not take them as protectors, outwardly or inwardly, in any state whatever, except the state of your guarding yourselves."
2- «وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ»: using the overt noun where a pronoun would be expected, to cultivate awe and instil dread.

* Benefits:
1- We cannot but draw attention to this kind of eloquence, namely this iltifāt from the absent to the addressed, and the profound effect it produces in the soul of the hearer. How many are the rhetorical features of the Qur'an!
2- A lesson in warning: some of the Anṣār used to take Jews as allies and supporters, and they used to declare that openly in the presence of the Messenger and not conceal it. Allah and His Messenger knew the cunning of the Jews and the enmity they harboured towards Islam and the Muslims, so this verse was revealed warning the Muslims and cautioning them against taking unbelievers as protectors.

safi-cedvel:29-29.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (إن): jussive-governing conditional particle. (تخفوا): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (في صدور): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أو): conjunction. (تبدوا): imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and parsed like it, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (يعلم): imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (الهاء) is mafʿūl bihi. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو): resumptive. (يعلم): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو". (ما): like the first. (في السموات): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of ما. (الواو): conjunction. (في الأرض): like في السموات and conjoined to it. (الواو): resumptive. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (على كلّ): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قدير). (شيء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (قدير): khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The clause «قل..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ان تخفوا..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تبدوه» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تخفوا.
The clause «يعلمه الله» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يعلم ما في السموات» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله على كلّ شيء قدير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تخفوا): it contains deletion of the hamza for lightening; its origin is تؤخفيوا..
It also contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by making quiescent and iʿlāl by deletion: the yāʾ was made quiescent because the ḍamma on it was felt heavy, then it was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, the quiescent yāʾ and the quiescent wāw of the plural. Its pattern is تفعوا with ḍamma on the tāʾ (see al-Baqara 271).
(تبدوه): the same happened in it as in (تخفوا): deletion of the hamza, iʿlāl by making quiescent and iʿlāl by deletion.

* Benefits:
1- The wāw in His saying, the Exalted, «وَيَعْلَمُ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ» is the resumptive wāw. The speech was brought as a new start rather than conjoined because the knowledge of Allah the Exalted is not dependent on a condition; it is of the type of mentioning the general after the specific: He mentioned His knowledge of what is in people's breasts, then followed that by mentioning His knowledge of everything.

safi-cedvel:30-30.t:
* I'rab:
(يوم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" «[Note: Or it is attached to (تودّ), which is what Abū Ḥayyān chose; he judged weak attaching it to (قدير), since His power over everything is not confined to one day rather than another.]». (تجد): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (كلّ): fāʿil (agent), nominative. (نفس): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (عملت): past verb.. (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (من خير): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied object of عملت. (محضرا): ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb), from ما, its governor being تجد «[Note: It may be a second object of the verb تجد if it is construed as a verb of the heart.]». (الواو): conjunction. (ما عملت من سوء): like ما عملت من خير «[Note: ما may not be conditional with its apodosis being the clause تودّ with an implied fāʾ, i.e. "then it will wish".]». (تودّ): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (لو): a non-jussive conditional particle of "impossibility for impossibility" «[Note: The basic rule for (لو) when it comes after the verb ودّ and what has its meaning is that it is maṣdar-forming; that is ruled out here because of the presence of the maṣdar particle (أنّ).]». (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis. (بين): adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and (ها) is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (بين): like the first and conjoined to it, and (الهاء) is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (أمدا): the postponed noun of أنّ, accusative. (بعيدا): naʿt (adjective) of (أمدا), accusative like it.
The interpreted maṣdar from أنّ, its noun and its khabar is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ثبت", i.e. "the occurrence of a distant span between it and it were established".
(الواو): resumptive. (يحذّر): imperfect verb, nominative, and (كم) is an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (نفس): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): resumptive. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (رؤف): khabar, nominative. (بالعباد): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رؤوف.
The clause «تجد كلّ نفس» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «عملت ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «عملت (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the first ṣila clause.
The clause «تودّ ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, its governor being تجد.
The implied clause «(ثبت حصول)» is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb تودّ «[Note: Abū Ḥayyān said in al-Baḥr: The apodosis of لو is omitted, and the object of تودّ is omitted; the implied form is: "it will wish for the distance between them — were there a distant span between it and it, it would be glad of that"... What the meaning requires is that لو أنّ and what follows it is governed by (تودّ), in the place of the mafʿūl bihi.]».
The clause «يحذّركم الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله رؤف بالعباد» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(محضرا): it contains deletion of the hamza for lightening; its origin is مؤحضرا. It is a passive participle from the quadriliteral verb أحضر; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(أمدا): a noun for the end-point of a thing, i.e. its limit; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(بعيدا): a derived adjective on the pattern فعيل, from بعد يبعد, of the كرم class (see verse 176 of Sūrat al-Baqara).

* Benefits:
1- We can regard the verb «تجد» in this verse in two ways. The first: that it is transitive to a single object, so that the relative noun «ما» is its object and «محضرا» is a ḥāl from the object.
The second: regarding it as transitive to two objects, the first being the relative noun and the second «محضرا».
2- His saying وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللَّهُ نَفْسَهُ: this expression is called mushākala (verbal correspondence), because Allah addresses people in what resembles their language and their selves, as in His saying, the Exalted, «وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْماكِرِينَ»; for Allah does not scheme, but the expression corresponds to the state of the unbelievers. The like of this is frequent in the Noble Qur'an, and it is one of the familiar features of Arabic.

safi-cedvel:181-181.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath; (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (سمع) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (قول) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قالوا) a past verb and its agent; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (فقير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) a conjunction; (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (أغنياء) khabar, nominative; it is prevented from taking tanwīn because it is assimilated to the feminine nouns ending in extended alif (al-mamdūda); (السين) a particle of futurity; (نكتب) an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "naḥnu" (we), for majesty; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: This i'rab is preferable so that the explicit maṣdar that follows (قتل) is conjoined to an interpreted maṣdar. It is also permissible for ما to be a relative noun, a direct object, with the returning pronoun omitted.]»; (قالوا) like the first.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما قالوا) is in the position of an accusative, a direct object, governed by the verb of writing «[Note: It is said that the writing is literal: the deeds of man are recorded in a book; and it is said that it is figurative, meaning the reckoning of man's deeds.]».
(الواو) a conjunction; (قتل) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the interpreted maṣdar, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الأنبياء) a direct object of the maṣdar قتل, accusative; (بغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in قتلهم; (حقّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction; (نقول) like نكتب; (ذوقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; (عذاب) a direct object, accusative; (الحريق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «سمع الله ...» has no grammatical position: the response to an implied oath.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الله فقير» is in the position of an accusative: the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «نحن أغنياء» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of the saying.
The clause «سنكتب..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «نقول ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause سنكتب.
The clause «ذوقوا» is in the position of an accusative: the object of the saying.

* Morphology:
(الحريق) the noun from حرق يحرق, of the pattern (bāb) نصر; it means المحرق (with kasra on the rāʾ, i.e. "the burning one"); its wazn is فعيل. It may also be intended as the maṣdar (verbal noun), which is الحرق.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَنَقُولُ ذُوقُوا عَذابَ الْحَرِيقِ»: tasting (الذوق) is perceiving flavour in the mouth. Originally it applies to what is taken in small amounts, not in large amounts, for the latter is called eating (أكل). Its use was then extended to the perception of all other sensible things and states, by way of implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya).
2- Antithesis (al-ṭibāq): between فقير and أغنياء.

* Benefits:
2- His saying: «وَقَتْلَهُمُ الْأَنْبِياءَ» «[Translator's note: the source numbers this point 2; there is no point 1.]». The grammarians have devoted a chapter to the governing action of the maṣdar, which we summarise as follows:
The maṣdar governs as its verb governs, whether transitive or intransitive. If its verb is intransitive, it needs only an agent, as in «يعجبني اجتهاد سعيد» (Saʿīd's diligence pleases me); here the maṣdar has been annexed to its agent, so سعيد is genitive in form and nominative in position. If it is transitive, it needs an agent and a direct object.
It reaches its object either by itself, as in «ساءني عصيانك أباك» (your disobeying your father grieved me), or by a preposition, as in «ساءني مرورك بمواضع الشبهة» (your passing by places of suspicion grieved me). Its agent may be omitted without the maṣdar bearing its pronoun, as in «سرّني تكريم العاملين» (the honouring of the workers pleased me): the maṣdar has been annexed to its object, and the agent is omitted optionally, i.e. «تكريم الناس العاملين» (people's honouring the workers).
Its object may be omitted, as in the saying of the Exalted: «وَما كانَ اسْتِغْفارُ إِبْراهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ إِلَّا عَنْ مَوْعِدَةٍ وَعَدَها إِيَّاهُ», i.e. Ibrāhīm's asking his Lord for forgiveness.
The maṣdar governs as its verb does whether it is annexed (muḍāf), made definite with al-, or free of both al- and annexation.
The first is as in the saying of the Exalted: «وَلَوْلا دَفْعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ», and the third as in His saying, Mighty and Majestic: أَوْ إِطْعامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ يَتِيماً ذا مَقْرَبَةٍ أَوْ مِسْكِيناً ذا مَتْرَبَةٍ. As for the second, it is as in the poet's saying:
لقد علمت أولى المغيرة أنني ... كررت فلم أنكل عن الضرب مسمعا
(The vanguard of the raiding party knew that I charged and did not shrink from striking Misma.)
The condition for the maṣdar to govern is that it stands in place of its verb, as in «ضربا اللصّ» (strike the thief!), or that it is valid to put the verb, accompanied by the maṣdar-forming أن or ما, in its place. If you say: سرّني فهمك الدرس (your understanding the lesson pleased me), it is valid to say: سرني أن تفهم الدرس. If you say: يسرني عملك الخير (your doing good pleases me), it is valid to say: يسرني أن تعمل الخير. If you say: يعجبني قولك الحق الآن (your speaking the truth now pleases me), it is valid to say: يعجبني ما تقول الحق الآن. If past or future time is intended, it is construed as accompanied by «أن»; if present time is intended, it is construed as accompanied by ما, as has been shown.

safi-cedvel:182-182.t:
* I'rab:
(ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative «[Translator's note: the source reads «في محلّ رفع رفع مبتدأ», with رفع written twice.]», mubtadaʾ (subject); the (اللام) is for distance and the (الكاف) for address; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: It may be a relative noun in the position of a genitive governed by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك).]»; (قدّمت) a past verb ... and the (التاء) is for the feminine; (أيدي) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما قدّمت أيديكم) is in the position of a genitive governed by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك; the bāʾ is causal.
(الواو) a conjunction; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative (manṣūb); (ليس) an incomplete, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa"; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (ظلّام) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of laysa; (اللام) redundant, for strengthening (al-taqwiya) «[Note: It may be a preposition attached to the intensive form (ظلّام).]»; (العبيد) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the intensive form ظلّام.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله ليس بظلّام ...) is in the position of a genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the interpreted maṣdar ما قدّمت ...
The clause «ذلك بما قدّمت أيديكم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قدّمت أيديكم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما), or of the nominal relative.
The clause «ليس بظلّام ...» is in the position of a nominative: the khabar of anna.

* Morphology:
(ظلّام) one of the intensive forms (ṣiyagh al-mubālagha), derived from ظلم يظلم, of the pattern (bāb) ضرب; its wazn is فعّال with a doubled ʿayn. The apparent view is that it is a noun of attribution (ism mansūb) to wrongdoing (al-ẓulm), like حدّاد (smith) and نجار (carpenter), so that the verse does not entail negating only the abundance [of wrongdoing] without negating wrongdoing that is not abundant, which would be unsound.

* Rhetoric:
1- «بِما قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ», i.e. because of your deeds which you sent ahead, such as killing the prophets.
What is meant by the hands is the selves, and expressing them by the hands is a case of expressing the whole by the part.
It is also said that what is meant by the hands is the evil deeds, and this is a case of mursal (non-metaphorical) trope (al-majāz al-mursal) whose relation is causality, because the hand is the cause of the deeds man commits.

* Benefits:
- His saying «لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ»: prepositions are of three kinds: original (aṣlī), redundant (zāʾid) and quasi-redundant (shabīh bi-l-zāʾid).
a- The original is the one that needs something to be attached to and cannot be dispensed with either in meaning or in i'rab, as in «كتبت بالقلم» (I wrote with the pen).
b- The redundant is the one that can be dispensed with in i'rab, does not need anything to be attached to, and cannot be dispensed with in meaning, for it is brought to emphasise the content of the statement, as in «ما جاءنا من أحد» (not anyone came to us) and «ليس سعيد بمسافر» (Saʿīd is not travelling).
These are four particles: «من, الباء, الكاف and اللام».
c- The quasi-redundant: it cannot be dispensed with in wording or meaning, yet it does not need anything to be attached to. These are five particles: «ربّ, خلا, عدا, حاشا and لعلّ». It resembles the redundant in not needing attachment, and resembles the original in that its wording and meaning cannot be dispensed with. Whoever wishes to learn more about the places where these particles are redundant should consult their chapter in its proper place in the extended works of the grammarians.

safi-cedvel:110-110.t:
* I'rab:
(كنتم) a defective verb and its ism (subject). (خير) khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb). (أمّة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (أخرجت) a past verb, passive.. the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هي. (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرجت). (تأمرون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تأمرون), (الواو) conjunction. (تنهون عن المنكر) like تأمرون بالمعروف, and the attachment is to (تنهون), (الواو) conjunction. (تؤمنون بالله) like تأمرون بالمعروف, and the attachment is to (تؤمنون). (الواو) resumptive. (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (آمن) a past verb. (أهل) fāʿil, nominative.
