(الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (اللام) occurring in the answer of لو. (كان) a defective past verb, and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو, i.e. faith. (خيرا) khabar, accusative. (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خيرا), (منهم) like لهم, attached to an omitted khabar. (المؤمنون) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (الواو) conjunction. (أكثر) mubtadaʾ, nominative - or a fronted khabar - and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاسقون) khabar, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw - or a postponed mubtadaʾ -
The clause «كنتم خير أمّة» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أخرجت للناس» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt (adjective) of أمة [Note: or in the position of the accusative as naʿt of خير ..., and it may be in the position of the accusative as a second khabar of the defective verb.].
The clause «تأمرون بالمعروف» is in the position of the accusative as a second khabar of the defective verb [Note: or in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of (خير أمة) - because the indefinite noun here has been qualified by the clause - or a naʿt of (خير أمّة), or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).].
The clause «تنهون ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause تأمرون.
The clause «تؤمنون..» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause تأمرون ...
The clause «آمن أهل الكتاب» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان خيرا لهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «منهم المؤمنون» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «أكثرهم الفاسقون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause منهم المؤمنون.

* Morphology:
(الفاسقون), plural of الفاسق, an active participle from فسق يفسق, of the first and second classes, and of the fifth class; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- Muqābala (correspondence): in the verse is the art of muqābala, for ṭibāq (antithesis) is multiplied between «تأمرون» and «تنهون», between «المعروف» and «المنكر», and between «المؤمنون» and «الفاسقون».

* Benefits:
1- «لكان»: the lām occurs at the beginning of the apodosis of the conditional «لو». Just as the fāʾ occurs in the answer of the jussive-causing conditional particles, the lām occurs in the answer of لو and لولا, which are non-jussive, and it conveys emphasis.

safi-cedvel:111-111.t:
* I'rab:
(لن) a particle of negation and of the accusative. (يضرّوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (إلّا) a particle of restriction [Note: Some permitted (إلّا) to be a particle of exception and (أذى) excepted from an implied mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: لن يضرّوكم ضررا الّا ضرر أذى (they will not harm you with any harm except the harm of annoyance).]. (أذى) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative, standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. إلّا ضرر أذى; the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (الواو) conjunction. (ان) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (يقاتلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (يولّوكم) like يقاتلوكم, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (الأدبار) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (ثمّ) a particle of resumption [Note: It is not far-fetched that (ثمّ) is a particle of resumption, as we shall see in Sūrat al-ʿAnkabūt, because the speech is resumed ... or it is a conjunction [Translator's note: the source prints حرذ, evidently a misprint for حرف], conjoining the clause after it to the clause of the condition and apodosis, which is conjoined to the clause لن يضرّوكم.], (لا) negative. (ينصرون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), passive ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «لن يضرّوكم ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إن يقاتلوكم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يولّوكم الأدبار» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لا ينصرون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الأدبار) plural of دبر with two ḍammas, a primitive (jāmid) noun; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas, or with ḍamma then sukūn, and the verb is of the class of نصر.

* Rhetoric:
1- In this verse is an art called «the art of clarification (fann al-īḍāḥ)», which is that the speaker says something whose surface is ambiguous, then clarifies it in the rest of his speech. The difficulty that the clarification resolves lies in the meanings of the rhetorical figures of the words and in their i'rab. On the surface of the verse there are two difficulties:
One of them from the side of the i'rab, and the other from the side of the meaning.
As for the one from the side of the i'rab, it is the conjoining of what is not jussive to what is jussive. The one from the side of the meaning is that the opening of the verse makes its ending (fāṣila) unnecessary, because their turning their backs at fighting is proof of their being forsaken, and being forsaken and victory do not come together. The answer is that Allah, Glorified is He, informed the believers that this enemy of theirs, if he fights them, will be routed; then He wished to complete the promise by informing them that, along with his turning away now, he will never be given victory in the future, so he is forsaken forever as long as he fights them.
2- We see in the verse «the art of suspension (fann al-taʿlīq)», which is that the speech is suspended for a time. For that reason the word «ثمّ» was chosen rather than the other conjunctions, because it indicates a delay that suits the imperfect verb's indication of the future.
3- The art of semantic correspondence (muṭābaqa maʿnawiyya) between the victory of the believers and the forsaking of the disbelievers.

safi-cedvel:112-112.t:
* I'rab:
(ضربت) a past verb, passive.. and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ضربت), (الذلّة) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (أينما) a jussive-causing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (ثقفوا) or to the implied apodosis. (ثقفوا) a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. (إلا) a particle of exception. (بحبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); it is excepted from all states, i.e.: they were abased in all states except in their state of holding fast to the covenant of Allah. (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حبل. (الواو) conjunction. (باءوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بغضب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil in (باءوا), i.e.:
clothed with wrath from Allah. (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of غضب. (الواو) conjunction. (ضربت عليهم المسكنة) like ضربت عليهم الذلّة. (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (الباء) a preposition. (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the ism (subject) of أنّ. (كانوا) a defective verb ... and the wāw is the ism of kāna. (يكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يكفرون), (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (يقتلون) like يكفرون. (الأنبياء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (بغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يقتلون) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl of الأنبياء, i.e. wrongfully or unjustly.], (حقّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم كانوا ...) is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ذلك.
(ذلك) like the first. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. (عصوا) like باءوا. (الواو) conjunction. (كانوا) like the first. (يعتدون) like يكفرون.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما عصوا) is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar of the (second) mubtadaʾ ذلك.
The clause «ضربت عليهم الذلّة» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ثقفوا» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: أينما ثقفوا ذلّوا (wherever they are found, they are abased).
The clause «باءوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ضربت ...
The clause «ضربت.. المسكنة» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the (first) clause ضربت.
The clause «كانوا يكفرون ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of أنّ.
The clause «يكفرون ...» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا.
The clause «يقتلون ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause يكفرون.
The clause «ذلك بأنّهم (in both instances)» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «عصوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.
The clause «كانوا يعتدون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause عصوا.
The clause «يعتدون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
See verse (61) of Sūrat al-Baqara, for it contains most of the morphological points of the words occurring in this verse.

* Rhetoric:
1- «ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَسْكَنَةُ» this is from the pitching (ḍarb) of tents and domes.
So in it is an implicit, imaginative metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya takhyīliyya); and the encompassing of abasement and its enveloping them may be likened to that by way of the dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya).
2- «إِلَّا بِحَبْلٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَحَبْلٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ» i.e. they are not safe from abasement in any state except in the state of their holding fast to Allah the Exalted, or to His Book which came to them, and to the protection (dhimma) of the Muslims, for by that they are safe.
He likened holding fast to the means of safety to holding fast to a firm rope let down from a high place. This is by way of the representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya).

* Benefits:
1- His saying, the Exalted: إِلَّا بِحَبْلٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ the speech does not stand straight except by means of an implied construction, since we must ask about the reason for the presence of the bāʾ and the cause of this exception. Although the grammarians have spoken a great deal on this matter, the presence of the bāʾ stands straight merely with this implied construction: «except if they are found protected by a rope from Allah or having entered into a protection from the Muslims». In this case abasement and wretchedness are lifted from them and they are saved from the wrath of Allah.

safi-cedvel:113-113.t:
* I'rab:
(ليس) an inflexible (jāmid) defective past verb, and (الواو) a pronoun in the position of the nominative as the ism (subject) of ليس [Note: The pronoun refers back to the People of the Book mentioned previously.], (سواء) khabar (predicate) of ليس, accusative (manṣūb). (من أهل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar. (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (أمّة) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (قائمة) naʿt (adjective) of أمة, nominative like it. (يتلون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (آيات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. (آناء) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يتلون), (الليل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (يسجدون) like يتلون.
The clause «ليسوا سواء» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من أهل الكتاب أمّة» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) or explicative [Note: it explains the manner of their not being equal.].
The clause «يتلون» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of أمّة, or in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «هم يسجدون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of the wāw in يتلون.
The clause «يسجدون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

* Morphology:
(قائمة), feminine of قائم, an active participle from قام يقوم, of the class of نصر. In it the weak letter is regularly changed (ibdāl) into a hamza after the alif of the pattern فاعل. (See verse 18 of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān).
(آناء), plural of أنى with fatḥa on the hamza and the nūn, on the measure of عصا; or إنى with kasra on the hamza and fatḥa on the nūn, on the measure of معى; or أني with fatḥa then sukūn, on the measure of ظبي; or إني with kasra then sukūn, on the measure of حمل; or إنو with kasra and sukūn with the wāw, on the measure of جرو ... So in آناء there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion), since the yāʾ - or the wāw - was converted into a hamza because it came at the end of the word after a vowelless alif. It is a primitive (jāmid) noun indicating a time or period.

* Rhetoric:
1- Majāz mursal (non-metaphorical trope): in His saying, the Exalted, «أُمَّةٌ قائِمَةٌ يَتْلُونَ آياتِ اللَّهِ آناءَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ», i.e.: while they pray, because recitation is forbidden in actual prostration, and it is not right to praise by means of what has been forbidden. So He expressed the part, which is prostration, and intended the whole, which is the prayer. The relation of the trope here is partiality (juzʾiyya).

* Benefits:
1- ليسوا سواء: «سواء» is used as a predicate of one and more than one, and it means "equal" (مستو). «سواء» comes for equalisation (taswiya), and after it comes the hamza of equalisation, as in «سَواءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ», and what follows the hamza is interpreted as a maṣdar; its implied form here is: your warning and its absence are equal to them. So the maṣdar is the mubtadaʾ and سواء is the khabar. «سواء» means "equal/even" (مستو) when a place is described by it, and the most eloquent usage in this case is to shorten it, so you say: «سوى» on the pattern «فعل», like ماء روى and قوم عدى.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(ها) a particle of alerting; (أنتم) an overt, detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ها) like the first; (أولاء) a demonstrative, mabnī on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on its end, its appearance prevented by the original vowel of indeclinability, in the position of accusative as a vocative, the vocative particle having been omitted from it «[Note: This i'rab is not permissible according to the Basrans and Sībawayh, because it is not permissible to omit the vocative particle from a demonstrative; but al-ʿUkbarī, al-Suyūṭī and Abū Ḥayyān.. then al-Jamal in his gloss on al-Jalālayn, cited it according to the school of the Kufans, and we have chosen it because it does not conflict with the meaning and is far from forced interpretation.. Further, the demonstrative may be the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause حاججتم a ḥāl (circumstantial).. or resumptive, explaining the first clause; and they allowed the demonstrative to be a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), with the khabar being the clause حاججتم ... (See verse 85 of Sūrat al-Baqara).]», (حاججتم) a past verb, mabnī on the sukūn.. and (تم) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (في) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حاججتم) «[Note: It may be an indefinite noun qualified by a description, with the clause after it as its description.]», (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of علم — a description that precedes what it describes; (علم) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) conjunction; (لم تحاجّون) its i'rab was given in the previous verse; (في ما) like the first «[Note: (ما) may be an indefinite noun qualified by a description, with the clause after it as its description.]», (ليس) an incomplete past verb; (لكم به علم) the khabar of ليس, its ism, and a ḥāl of its ism, as given before.
(الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (الواو) conjunction; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (لا) negating; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «أنتم ...» حاججتم has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The vocative clause «هؤلاء» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
The clause «حاججتم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).
The clause «لكم به علم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لم تحاجّون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «ليس لكم به علم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «الله يعلم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يعلم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «أنتم لا تعلمون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause الله يعلم.
The clause «لا تعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).

* Benefits:
1- Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ said, regarding the words of Allah the Exalted «ها أنتم», that this hāʾ is changed from a hamza to ease pronunciation and to avoid repetition, and because the hāʾ is the sister of the hamza; this is a good view, with little strain or forcedness.

safi-cedvel:67-67.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negating; (كان) an incomplete past verb; (إبراهيم) ism of كان, nominative (marfūʿ); (يهوديّا) khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation; (نصرانيّا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (يهوديّا), accusative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no governing effect; (كان) like the first, and its ism is a pronoun, its implied form being هو; (حنيفا) khabar of كان, accusative; (مسلما) a second khabar, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (ما كان) like the first, and the ism of كان is a pronoun, its implied form being هو; (من المشركين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of كان.
The clause «ما كان إبراهيم..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كان حنيفا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «ما كان من المشركين» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive one.

safi-cedvel:68-68.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (أولى) ism of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (بإبراهيم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أولى, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is prevented from

* Morphology:
«[Translator's note: The source text breaks off here mid-sentence and a «Morphology» heading is inserted; what follows is in fact the continuation of the i'rab.]»
(اللام) it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and it conveys emphasis; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ; (اتبعوا) a past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) conjunction; (ها) a particle of alerting; (ذا) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of nominative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the relative noun; (النبيّ) a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative or a description of it; (الواو) conjunction; (الذين) like the first and conjoined to it, in the position of nominative; (آمنوا) like اتّبعوا; (الواو) conjunction or resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (وليّ) khabar (predicate), nominative; (المؤمنين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّ أولى الناس..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اتّبعوه» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (الذين).
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «الله وليّ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive one, or resumptive.

* Morphology:
(أولى): an elative (ism tafḍīl) from ولي يلي, of the ضرب class and the وثق class; its pattern is أفعل, and the alif is changed from yāʾ, so it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution.

safi-cedvel:69-69.t:
* I'rab:
(ودّ) a past verb, and (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine; (طائفة) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (من أهل) a preposition and its genitive noun, naʿt (adjective) of طائفة; (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (لو) a maṣdar particle; (يضلون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
The interpreted maṣdar (لو يضلّونكم) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governor being the verb ودّت.
(الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (ما) negating; (يضلّون) like the first; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ما يشعرون) like ما يضلّون.
The clause «ودّت طائفة» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يضلّونكم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (لو).
The clause «ما يضلّون إلّا أنفسهم» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «ما يشعرون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.

* Morphology:
(طائفة): derived from طاف يطوف, of the نصر class; a collective noun (ism jamʿ) with no singular from its own root-form; its pattern is فاعلة, and the weak letter was changed to a hamza, as happens with every hollow verb from which a word on the pattern فاعل is derived.
(يضلّون): the hamza of the past form was deleted in it for lightness, following the same course as ينفقون; the original form is يؤضللون (verse 26 of al-Baqara).

safi-cedvel:70-70.t:
* I'rab:
(يا أهل الكتاب لم تكفرون) like its earlier counterpart «[Note: In verse (65) of this sūra.]», (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تكفرون); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تشهدون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «يا أهل الكتاب» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لم تكفرون» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أنتم تشهدون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «تشهدون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).

safi-cedvel:71-71.t:
* I'rab:
(يا أهل الكتاب لم تلبسون) like its earlier counterpart «[Note: In verse (65) of this sūra.]», (الحقّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (بالباطل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تلبسون), the verb being made to carry the meaning of "you mix and blend"; (الواو) conjunction; (تكتمون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الحقّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (أنتم تعلمون) like أنتم تشهدون in the previous verse.
The clause «يا أهل الكتاب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لم تلبسون ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «تكتمون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause that answers the vocative.
The clause «أنتم تعلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (أنتم).

safi-cedvel:72-72.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قالت) a past verb.. (التاء) of the feminine; (طائفة) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (من أهل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of طائفة; (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (آمنوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition; (الذي) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to (آمنوا); (أنزل) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, and it is the referent pronoun; (على الذين) like بالذي, attached to (أنزل); (آمنوا) a past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (وجه) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (آمنوا); (النهار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (اكفروا آخره) like آمنوا وجه ... and the adverb is attached to the verb اكفروا.. and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope, and (هم) an attached pronoun, the ism of لعلّ, in the position of accusative; (يرجعون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قالت طائفة» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «أنزل» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «اكفروا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the request clause آمنوا.
The clause «لعلّهم يرجعون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يرجعون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.

safi-cedvel:183-183.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, naʿt (adjective) of the relative noun in verse (181), or a badal (substitute) from it «[Note: Or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم", in the position of a nominative, and the clause is resumptive.]»; (قالوا) a past verb and its agent; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (عهد) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa"; (إلى) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عهد); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (لا) negative; (نؤمن) an imperfect verb, accusative, its agent a latent pronoun, implied as "naḥnu"; (لرسول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نؤمن).
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا نؤمن ...) is in the position of a genitive governed by an omitted preposition, implied as في, attached to (عهد), i.e. He enjoined upon us regarding not believing ...
(حتّى) a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition; (يأتي) an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed (muḍmara) أن after حتّى, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its agent a latent pronoun, implied as "huwa"; (بقربان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأتينا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتينا ...) is in the position of a genitive governed by (حتّى), attached to (نؤمن).
(تأكل) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, direct object; (النار) the agent, nominative ... (قل) an imperative verb, its agent a latent pronoun, implied as "anta"; (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (جاء) a past verb and (كم) a pronoun, direct object; (رسل) the agent, nominative; (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاء) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt of رسل.]», and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بالبيّنات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاء); (الواو) a conjunction; (الباء) a preposition and (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (جاء), and it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to البيّنات with the preposition repeated; (قلتم) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun, the agent; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition; (اللام) a preposition and (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (قتلتموهم); (قتلتم) like قلتم, and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), for prolonging the ḍamma on the mīm (ishbāʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, direct object; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (كنتم) an incomplete past verb and its noun; (صادقين) the khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الله عهد» is in the position of an accusative: the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «عهد إلينا» is in the position of a nominative: the khabar of inna.
The clause «لا نؤمن» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the first particle relative (أن).
The clause «يأتينا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «تأكله النار» is in the position of a genitive: naʿt of قربان.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قد جاءكم» is in the position of an accusative: the object of the saying.
The clause «قلتم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «قتلتموهم» is in the position of a jussive: the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you are truthful, then why did you kill them. And the clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position: resumptive — or explicative — and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

* Morphology:
(قربان) a noun for everything by which one draws near to Allah; its wazn is فعلان with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
1- His saying «تَأْكُلُهُ النَّارُ»: the grammarians parse «آل» «[Translator's note: so in the source, written «آل»; the definite article «ال» is meant.]» as being for prior acquaintance (al-ʿahd). This leads us to review what the grammarians and lexicographers have said about this particle «ال». Although the scholars' statements on this matter are many and scattered, we shall present to the reader a brief, concise summary covering the aspects of this word, because of its benefit to the inquisitive and to every seeker of knowledge.
The definite al-: it comes as generic (jinsiyya), redundant (zāʾida), and of prior acquaintance (ʿahdiyya), and all three are fit to be a sign of the noun. Here is their explanation:
1- The generic al-: it is of three types: a- that which is mentioned to state the reality and quiddity, and which the word «كل» (every) cannot replace, as in «الكلمة قول مفرد» (the word is a single utterance); b- that which comes for comprehending the genus literally and covers its individuals, as in «وَخُلِقَ الْإِنْسانُ ضَعِيفاً»; this is the one that the word «كل» can replace, so we can say: وخلق كل إنسان ضعيفا (and every human was created weak), and the statement is correct.
c- that which is for comprehending the genus figuratively and for exaggeration, as in «أنت الرجل علما وأدبا» (you are the man [par excellence] in knowledge and refinement).
3- «[Translator's note: so numbered in the source; 2 is meant.]» The redundant al-: two types: necessary (lāzima) and not necessary.
a- The necessary is of three kinds:
a- That which has accompanied a proper name since its coining, whether by transfer (naql), like «اللّات» and «العزّى», or by improvisation (irtijāl), like «السموأل».
b- That which is in the noun for the present time, namely «الآن» (now).
c- That which is in the relative nouns, such as «الذي, التي and their derivatives» of dual and plural; it is redundant in all three because a single word cannot combine two kinds of definiteness.
As for the not necessary, which is the incidental (ʿāriḍa), it is of two types:
a- Occurring in poetry by necessity, or in prose anomalously (shudhūdhan). In poetry, as in the saying of al-Rammāḥ ibn Mayyāda:
رأيت الوليد بن اليزيد مباركا ... شديدا بأعباء الخلافة كاهله
(I saw al-Walīd ibn al-Yazīd blessed, his shoulders strong in bearing the burdens of the caliphate.)
As for its anomalous use in prose, it is as when you say: «ادخلوا الأول فالأول» (enter, the first and then the first).
b- That which is mentioned at the beginning of a proper name, pointing to its origin, such as «الحارث», «القاسم», «الحسن والحسين» and «النعمان». This is based on hearing (samāʿiyya), so no analogy is drawn from it.
3- The al- of prior acquaintance, which is of three types:
a- For mentioned acquaintance (al-ʿahd al-dhikrī): where the noun made definite by it has been mentioned before, as in «كَما أَرْسَلْنا إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا فَعَصى فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ».
b- For known acquaintance (al-ʿahd al-ʿilmī), also called «mental acquaintance (al-ʿahd al-dhihnī)»: where the noun made definite by it is already known, as in «إِذْ هُما فِي الْغارِ».
c- For present acquaintance (al-ʿahd al-ḥuḍūrī): where the noun made definite by it is present, as in:
«الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ». To this belong the qualifier of a demonstrative, as in «إن هذا الرجل نبيل» (this man is noble), and the qualifier of «أي» in the vocative, as in «يا أيها الإنسان» (O man).
4- The relative al-: it is a noun in the form of a particle, and it enters upon active and passive participles.
5- The al- that stands in place of annexation (iḍāfa): as in «وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوى», i.e. from its desire.
6- Writing «the definite al-» when it enters upon nouns beginning with lām.
a- If the definite al- enters upon a noun beginning with lām, it is written with two lāms, as in: اللحم (meat), اللبن (milk), اللجين (silver).
b- The relative nouns are all written with a single lām because of their frequent use, except for the dual of الذي, «اللّذين», which is written with two lāms; so reflect.

safi-cedvel:152-152.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) occurring in the answer to an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (صدق) a past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (وعد) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as an adverbial (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صدقكم); (تحسّون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بإذن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تحسّون), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (حتّى) a particle of commencement (ḥarf ibtidāʾ) «[Note: They permitted it to be a particle of limit and a preposition, attached to an omitted verb whose implied form is دام, or to the verb تحسّونهم, i.e.: you were slaying them up to the time of your faltering, or that continued for you up to the time of your faltering.. and إذا in this case means إذ.]», (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition «[Note: It is permissible for إذا to mean إذ, and in that case it has no apodosis.]», attached to the apodosis «[Note: There are several views on the implied apodosis: it was said it is "you were defeated", and it was said "He withheld His help from you", and it was said "you were tested", and it was said "your situation became clear to you".. and Abū Ḥayyān chose that the omitted apodosis be "you were divided into two groups".. and what follows indicates it.]»; (فشلتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (تنازعتم) like فشلتم; (في الأمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تنازعتم); (الواو) conjunction; (عصيتم) like فشلتم; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عصيتم); (ما) a maṣdar particle; (أرى) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, and (كم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi; (تحبّون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أراكم ...) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), and it is the resumptive pronoun (al-ʿāʾid); (الدنيا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (منكم من يريد الآخرة) like its counterpart above; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (صرفكم) like صدقكم; (عن) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (صرفكم); (اللام) of causation (taʿlīl); (يبتلي) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is "he" (هو).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبتليكم) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (صرفكم).
(الواو) resumptive; (لقد) like the first one; (عفا) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (عنكم) like عنهم, attached to (عفا); (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (ذو) khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw; (فضل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (على المؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فضل, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «صدقكم الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «تحسّونهم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «فشلتم..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تنازعتم..» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause فشلتم.
The clause «عصيتم» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause فشلتم.
The clause «أراكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar relative particle (ما).
The clause «تحبّون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «منكم من يريد..» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) - or parenthetical.
The clause «يريد الدنيا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (من).
The clause «منكم من يريد (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first clause.
The clause «يريد الآخرة» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «صرفكم عنهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) clause.
The clause «عفا عنكم» has no grammatical position, being the answer to an implied oath, and this oath is conjoined to the oath occurring at the opening of the verse.. or it is resumptive.
The clause الله ذو فضل.. has no grammatical position, being resumptive, and it carries the sense of giving a reason.

* Morphology:
(وعد): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb وعد يعد, of the ḍaraba class (bāb ḍaraba); its pattern is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- «حَتَّى إِذا فَشِلْتُمْ»: «حتى» can be taken in two senses. The first is to regard it as a particle of limit and a preposition, and this is the stronger; according to the holders of this view it can be replaced by «إلى» without the meaning changing, i.e. "until you faltered and disputed". On this view it is permissible to attach it, together with its genitive noun, to the verb تحسونهم, just as it is permissible to attach them to the verb «صدقكم». The first way is stronger, because the continuation of the Muslims' victory up to the time of their faltering and disputing is closer to logic and reason than to say that the continuation of Allah's promise to them stopped at their faltering and disputing; so reflect.
As for the second view on the meaning of «حتى»: that it is a particle of commencement, preceding the conditional clause «إذا فشلتم». It appears that the first view is stronger and makes the second view unnecessary, even if it is permissible..
2- «لكيلا»: the grammarians took two positions regarding «كي»:
The first: that it puts the verb in the accusative by itself, so it is equivalent to «أن» in putting the imperfect verb in the accusative. The second: that it is a preposition with the status of the lām, and the verb after it is put in the accusative by an implied «أن», just as «أن» is implied after the lām and puts the imperfect verb in the accusative.
An important remark: if we regard it as having the status of «أن», it is permissible for the lām to enter upon it, as in «لكيلا تحزنوا على ما فاتكم»; and if we regard it as a preposition, it is permissible for it to enter upon nouns as a preposition does. An example of that is its entering upon the interrogative «ما», as in «كيمه»?, on the model of «لم، بم and عمّ»: the alif is dropped in the interrogative case, and the hāʾ is added to it in the case of pausing (sakt).

safi-cedvel:153-153.t:
* I'rab:
(إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عفا) «[Note: Or to (صرفكم); and it is permissible for it to be an adverb for (عصيتم, or تنازعتم, or فشلتم).]»; (تصعدون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (تلوون) like تصعدون; (على أحد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تلوون); (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (الرسول) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (يدعو) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (في أخرى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of يدعو, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied on the alif, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) conjunction, linking the cause to the effect; (أثاب) a past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), i.e. Allah; (غمّا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (بغمّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (غمّا), i.e. grief bound up with grief; (اللام) of causation, a preposition; (كي) a maṣdar particle that governs the accusative; (لا) «[Note: Or redundant, depending on what the preposition - the lām of causation - is attached to.]» negative; (تحزنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (تحزنوا); (فات) a past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), and it is the resumptive pronoun (al-ʿāʾid).
The interpreted maṣdar (كيلا تحزنوا ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (عفا) «[Note: Or attached to (أثابكم), and in that case (لا) is redundant.]».
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, conjoined to the first relative noun; (أصابكم) like فاتكم. (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (خبير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (خبير) «[Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a maṣdar particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to خبير.]»; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «تصعدون» is in the position of genitive, (إذ) being annexed to it.
The clause «لا تلوون» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause تصعدون.
The clause «الرسول يدعوكم» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يدعوكم..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الرسول).
The clause «أثابكم..» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause تصعدون.
The clause «تحزنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar relative particle (كي).
The clause «فاتكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative (ما) «[Translator's note: the source says "the maṣdar relative particle (ما)", although (ما) was parsed above as a relative noun.]».
The clause «أصابكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «الله خبير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (ما).

* Morphology:
(غمّا): the maṣdar (verbal noun) of غمّ يغمّ, of the naṣara class (bāb naṣara); its pattern is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn.
(فاتكم): it involves a phonetic change by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb): the alif is changed from a wāw, because its imperfect is يفوت, and it is of the naṣara class. Its original form is فوت; the wāw came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was changed into an alif.
(أصابكم): it involves a phonetic change by substitution, following the same course as فاتكم; the alif may be changed from a wāw or from a yāʾ.

safi-cedvel:154-154.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ) a conjunction; (أنزل) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), i.e. Allah; (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل); (الغمّ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (أمنة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: al-ʿUkbarī permitted making it a ḥāl (circumstantial) - with نعاسا as the mafʿūl bihi - so it is a naʿt (adjective) placed before the word it qualifies, the original being:
نعاسا ذا أمنة.]»; (نعاسا) a badal (substitute) from أمنة, accusative like it «[Note: It is not valid for it to be an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) according to the view of the majority of the Basrans, because they require that to be among definite nouns.]»; (يغشى) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو), i.e. the drowsiness; (طائفة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of طائفة. (الواو) resumptive «[Note: Abū Ḥayyān chose that the wāw be of the ḥāl, and the clause after it a ḥāl.. He said: «and starting (with an indefinite) was permissible» [Translator's note: the quotation breaks off here in the source.]»; (طائفة) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (أهمّت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (أنفس) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يظنون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb يظنون «[Note: The bāʾ here is locative (ẓarfiyya), and the verb يظنون does not take two objects; the meaning is: they place their supposition in Allah, i.e. in Allah's decree (al-Baḥr 3/7).]»; (غير) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, to emphasise the meaning of supposition «[Note: Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī makes (غير) the first object of the verb of supposition, and (بالله) the second object.]», i.e. they suppose an incorrect supposition; (ظنّ) a mafʿūl muṭlaq specifying the kind, accusative; (الجاهلية) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يقولون) like يقولون «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably "like يظنون" is meant.]»; (هل) an interrogative particle; (اللام) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (من الأمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of شيء; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (شيء) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ; (قل) an imperative verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الأمر) the noun of inna, accusative; (كلّ) a tawkīd (emphasis) in meaning of الأمر, accusative like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of inna; (يخفون) like يظنّون; (في أنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخفون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), and the clause is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (ما).]»; (لا) negative; (يبدون) like يظنون; (اللام) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يبدون); (يقولون) like يظنّون; (لو) a non-jussivizing conditional particle; (كان) a deficient past verb; (لنا) like لك, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (من الأمر) like the first one; (شيء) the noun of kāna, postponed, nominative; (ما) negative; (قتلنا) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (نا) a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (هنا) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (قتلنا); (قل) like the first one; (لو) like the first one; (كنتم) a deficient past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (في بيوت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of كنتم, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو; (برز) a past verb; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (كتب) a past verb in the passive; (عليهم) like عليكم, attached to (كتب); (القتل) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative; (إلى مضاجع) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (برز), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction «[Note: Or it conjoins the stated reason to an implied reason, i.e.: He did that so that (Allah) might accomplish His command, and so that He might test.. or it is redundant and there is nothing implied.]»; (اللام) of causation (taʿlīl); (يبتلي) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن) after the lām; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (في صدور) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ليمحّص ما في قلوبكم) like ليبتلي.. صدوركم. (الواو) resumptive; (الله عليم) a mubtadaʾ and khabar, both nominative; (بذات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم; (الصدور) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبتلي الله) is in the position of genitive, attached to an implied verb whose implied form is: "He did that at Uḥud.. so that He might test" «[Translator's note: the source has بأحد.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يمحص) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar.
The clause أنزل ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أثابكم in the previous verse.
The clause «يغشى ...» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (نعاسا).
The clause «طائفة قد أهمّتهم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أهمّتهم أنفسهم..» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of طائفة.
The clause «يظنون بالله..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ طائفة «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be omitted and the clause to be a second naʿt of طائفة, the implied form being: "among you is a group that has ..."; and it is permissible for the clause يظنّون to be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in أهمّتهم ...]».
The clause «يقولون..» is in the position of nominative as a badal from the clause يظنّون «[Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يظنّون.]».
The clause «هل لنا من الأمر..» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb "to say" (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive or parenthetical.
The clause «إنّ الأمر كلّه لله» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يخفون..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يقولون, or has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا يبدون لك» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يقولون..» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لو كان لنا من الأمر شيء» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «ما قتلنا هاهنا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كنتم في بيوتكم» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «برز الذين..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition.
The clause «كتب عليهم القتل» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يبتلي الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «يمحّص ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «الله عليم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(أمنة): a noun for security (الأمن), which is the maṣdar (verbal noun) of أمن يأمن, of the fariḥa class (bāb fariḥa); or it is another maṣdar of the verb. There are other maṣdars, namely أمن with two fatḥas, and أمان.
The pattern of أمنة is فعلة, with a fatḥa on the fāʾ, the ʿayn and the lām.
(نعاسا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb نعس ينعس, of the naṣara class or the fataḥa class; its pattern is فعال with a ḍamma on the fāʾ, and another maṣdar is نعس, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn.
(يخفون): it involves a phonetic change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf); its original form is يخفيون: the yāʾ was dropped after being made vowelless because it met the vowelless wāw. Its pattern is يفعون, just as the hamza at its beginning was dropped.
(مضاجع): plural of مضجع, a noun of place on the pattern مفعل, with a fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, because its ʿayn in the imperfect has a fatḥa.

* Rhetoric:
1- His saying «ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ»: the explicit statement that the sending down came after it, even though ثمّ indicates that and its coming after an interval, is for added clarity and as a reminder of the greatness of the favour.
2- His saying «هَلْ لَنا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ», i.e. some of them say to others by way of denial: do we have any share of victory, conquest and triumph? i.e. we have nothing of that, because Allah, Glorified and Exalted is He, will not help Muhammad ﷺ; or those of them who were present say to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the form of seeking guidance: do we have anything of Allah the Exalted's command and His promise of victory?
3- Kināya (metonymy): He used "beds" (المضاجع) as a metonymy for places of death (المصارع), where they met their end and shook hands with their deaths.
4- المضاجع is the plural of مضجع; if it means "a place of sleep", then it is an istiʿāra (metaphor) for the place of death, and if it means the place where the body is stretched out in general, for the living and the dead, then it is literal.

* Benefits:
1- In this verse there is a depiction of the state of the Muslims on the day of Uḥud; it portrays their souls and the hidden things of their breasts, following, to achieve the intended purpose, the way of concision in the style of dialogue: it presents the sayings of those with weak souls and then answers them on the tongue of the Messenger ﷺ. The style of dialogue is more conducive to achieving the desired purpose and has a stronger effect on souls.

safi-cedvel:1-1.t: See its i'rab in ayah (1) of Sūrat al-Baqara.

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
«[Note: See ayah (163) of Sūrat al-Baqara, and likewise "Sūrat al-Kursī" [Translator's note: i.e. the Throne Verse (Āyat al-Kursī)] of al-Baqara, ayah (255).]»
* I'rab:
(الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (إله) the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative; the khabar (predicate) of لا is omitted, its implied form being "existent" (موجود); (إلّا) a particle of exception; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as badal (substitute) of the pronoun concealed in the khabar «[Note: Or a badal of the position of لا together with its noun, whose position is the nominative.]»; (الحيّ) a second khabar, nominative «[Note: Or it is a naʿt (adjective); or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو"; or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause نزّل عليك الكتاب; or it is a badal of the detached pronoun هو.]»; (القيّوم) a third khabar, nominative.

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(نزّل) a past verb, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (على) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نزّل); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكتاب; (مصدّقا) ḥāl, accusative, of the pronoun of عليك [Translator's note: so in the source; it is more commonly taken as a ḥāl of الكتاب]; (اللام) redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive in its near position, and in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the active participle in its remote position «[Note: It is permissible to make the lām an original preposition and attach the preposition and its genitive noun to (مصدّقا), the active participle.]»; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (يدي) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (أنزل التوراة) like نزّل الكتاب; (الإنجيل) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to التوراة by the wāw, accusative like it.
Clauses of ayah 2:
The clause «الله لا إله» has no grammatical position; it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو» is in the position of a nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
Clauses of ayah 3:
The clause «نزّل عليك ...» is in the position of a nominative as a fourth khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «أنزل التوراة» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause نزل.

* Morphology:
(مصدّقا): active participle of the quadriliteral صدّق; its wazn is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn (ayah 89 of al-Baqara).
(التوراة): it is said to be from ورى الزند يرى, when fire appears from the fire-stick, as though the Torah were a light out of misguidance; its wazn is فوعلة, and it contains ibdāl (letter substitution) and iʿlāl: the ibdāl is the changing of the wāw into a tāʾ, its original form being وورية; and the iʿlāl is the changing of the yāʾ into an alif because it is voweled and the letter before it has a fatḥa. It is also said — al-Farrāʾ said it — that its original form is تورية, on the wazn تفعلة, then the rāʾ was given a fatḥa and the yāʾ changed into an alif.
(الإنجيل): from النجل, which is the root from which other things branch out; its wazn is إفعيل. It is also said to be from breadth, from their saying نجلت الإهاب ("I split the hide") when you split it; so the Injīl contained a breadth that the Jews had not had.

* Rhetoric:
1- Metaphor (majāz): in His words «لِما بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ», meaning "before it".
2- Antithesis (ṭibāq): between «الأرض» and «السماء» [Translator's note: these words occur in ayah 5, not in this ayah].

safi-cedvel:4-4.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a preposition; (قبل) a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل) in the preceding ayah; (هدى) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif «[Note: Or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "guiding mankind".]»; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of هدى, or to (هدى) because it is a maṣdar; (الواو) conjunction; (أنزل الفرقان) like أنزل التوراة in the preceding ayah; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as the noun of إنّ; (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كفروا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (شديد) naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عزيز) khabar, nominative; (ذو) a second khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (انتقام) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «أنزل الفرقان» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause أنزل التوراة in the preceding ayah.
The clause «إنّ الذين ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لهم عذاب» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «الله عزيز» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(انتقام): the regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the five-letter verb انتقم; its wazn is افتعال.

safi-cedvel:5-5.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ الله) a particle resembling the verb and its noun; (لا) negative; (يخفى) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (على) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يخفى); (شيء) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of شيء; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation; (في السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what في الأرض is attached to, because it is conjoined to it.
The clause «إنّ الله لا يخفى» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «لا يخفى» is in the position of a nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنّ.

* Rhetoric:
1- What is meant by the earth and the heaven is the whole world. Many have made it a metaphor (majāz) of mentioning the part and intending the whole.

safi-cedvel:6-6.t:
* I'rab:
(هو) an overt detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative as khabar (predicate); (يصور) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (في الأرحام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun, i.e.: being in the wombs «[Note: Or attached to (يصوّر).]»; (كيف) a non-jussive conditional noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as ḥāl, governed by يشاء; (يشاء) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and its object is omitted, i.e. He wills your fashioning; (لا إله إلّا هو) its i'rab has been given before «[Note: in ayah (2) of this sūra.]»; (العزيز) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو"; (الحكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «هو الذي يصوّركم» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive «2».
The clause «يصوّركم» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive «3», and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: however He wills your fashioning, He fashions you in the wombs.
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive «4».
The clause «هو العزيز» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
«[Note: (2, 3, 4) It is permissible for it to be in the position of a nominative as khabar of إنّ in the preceding ayah.]»

* Rhetoric:
1- «هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِي الْأَرْحامِ كَيْفَ يَشاءُ»: the object is omitted, its implied form being "He wills your fashioning". This is by way of concision through omission (ījāz bi-l-ḥadhf), and that is for the sake of wonder and to show the power of Allah the Exalted.

safi-cedvel:114-114.t:
* I'rab:
(يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنون), (الواو) conjunction. (اليوم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الآخر) naʿt (adjective) of اليوم, genitive. (الواو) in the three places is a conjunction. (يأمرون بالمعروف، ينهون عن المنكر، يسارعون في الخيرات) like يؤمنون بالله, and the prepositions are attached to the verbs before them. (الواو) resumptive. (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address. (من الصّالحين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «يؤمنون بالله» is in the position of the nominative as another naʿt of أمّة in the previous verse, or in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of أمّة ...
The clause «يأمرون بالمعروف» is conjoined to the clause يؤمنون بالله and takes its position.
The clause «ينهون عن المنكر» is conjoined to the clause يؤمنون بالله and takes its position.
The clause «يسارعون في الخيرات» is conjoined to the clause يؤمنون بالله and takes its position.
The clause «أولئك من الصّالحين» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:115-115.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (ما) a jussive-causing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (يفعلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (من خير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ما), or it is a tamyīz (specification) of it. (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (لن) a particle of negation and of the accusative. (يكفروا) an imperfect verb, passive, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, by the verb's being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "they will be deprived of its reward". (الواو) resumptive. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (عليم) khabar (predicate), nominative. (بالمتّقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم.
The clause «يفعلوا من خير» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «لن يكفروه» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «الله عليم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:116-116.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a particle resembling the verb. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the ism (subject) of إن. (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (لن) a particle of negation and of the accusative. (تغني) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb). (عن) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تغني), (أموال) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) conjunction. (لا) redundant (zāʾida), for emphasising the negation. (أولاد) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to أموال, nominative like it, and (هم) like the previous. (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أموال or أولاد, by implying an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: as a substitute for the punishment of Allah. (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its qualifier, i.e.: لن تغني عنهم من الله إغناء يسيرا أو كثيرا (it will not avail them against Allah with any availing, little or much).], (الواو) conjunction. (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address. (أصحاب) khabar (predicate), nominative. (النّار) muḍāf ilayhi. (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خالدون), which is the nominative khabar.
The clause «إنّ الذين كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لن تغني» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «أولئك أصحاب ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause لن تغني.
The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of أصحاب, and its governor is the demonstrative (al-ishāra).

safi-cedvel:117-117.t:
* I'rab:
(مثل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (ينفقون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (في) a preposition. (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينفقون), (الحياة) badal (substitute) of ذه or an adjective of it, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الدّنيا) naʿt (adjective) of الحياة, genitive like it, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (كمثل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. (ريح) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. (صرّ) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (أصاب) a past verb, and (التاء) for the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هي. (حرث) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (قوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (ظلموا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) a conjunction. (أهلك) like أصاب, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "it", i.e. the wind. (الواو) resumptive - or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) -. (ما) negative. (ظلمهم) a past verb and its object. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk). (أنفس) a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يظلمون) like ينفقون.
The clause «مثل ما ينفقون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ينفقون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «فيها صرّ» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt of ريح.
The clause «أصابت ...» is in the position of the genitive as a second naʿt of ريح.
The clause «ظلموا ...» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt of قوم.
The clause «أهلكته» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause أصابت.
The clause «ما ظلمهم الله» has no grammatical position, resumptive - or in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of ظلموا.
The clause «يظلمون» is conjoined to the clause ما ظلمهم الله and takes its position in the i'rab.

* Morphology:
(صرّ) intense burning heat, or intense destructive cold, or the sound of the blaze of fire, occurring in the wind; from صرّ الشيء يصرّ, of the class of ضرب. It is a noun on the pattern فعل, with kasra then sukūn, and it may be used as an adjective, so one says ريح صرّ, i.e. a cold wind.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational simile (tashbīh tamthīlī): He likened what they spent, in its being lost and gone entirely without any benefit returning to them, to the tillage of disbelievers struck by an icy wind (ṣirr) which uprooted it, leaving them no benefit in it in any way at all. This is a compound simile.
2- «فِيها صِرٌّ» [Translator's note: the source prints the quotation with its opening letters missing, «ِيها صِرٌّ»] is an adjective meaning "cold", except that what it qualifies is omitted, i.e. a cold coldness (برد بارد), so it is a figurative attribution (isnād majāzī), like ظل ظليل (a shady shade).
3- Tatmīm (completion): it is that the speaker brings a word which, if dropped from the speech, would diminish its meaning in itself or in its attributes. The tatmīm here is in the word «فِيها صِرٌّ» [Translator's note: printed «ِيها صِرٌّ» in the source], for it conveyed intensification just as it conveyed embodiment and personification, as you say برد بارد (a cold coldness) and ليلة ليلاء (a night of darkest night).

* Benefits:
1- We have already come across mention of representation (tamthīl) involving movement and personification, and here it appears at its strongest in His saying, the Exalted: «مَثَلُ ما يُنْفِقُونَ فِي هذِهِ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٍ فِيها صِرٌّ أَصابَتْ حَرْثَ قَوْمٍ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فَأَهْلَكَتْهُ» [Translator's note: the source prints the first word as «َثَلُ», with the mīm missing].
Thus we find that the Quranic style has employed many means that address people's minds at one time and their senses at another, and it may combine all the faculties of the listener; that is more conducive to persuasion and stronger in effect. This is an aspect that deserves to be singled out for an ample study that brings out its merits and clarifies its effect.

safi-cedvel:118-118.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle. (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute) of أيّ or naʿt (adjective) of it. (آمنوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). (لا) prohibitive, causing the jussive. (تتّخذوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بطانة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt of بطانة, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the second object is omitted, its implied form being أصفياء (intimate friends). (لا) negative. (يألون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). And the wāw is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, by يألونكم being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of يمنعونكم [Note: ألا في الأمر: when he falls short in it; then it was used as transitive to two objects in their saying: لا آلوك نصحا أو جهدا (I will spare you no advice / effort), by making the verb include the meaning of أمنعك (I withhold from you) or أنقصك (I diminish you).. (from al-Zamakhsharī).], (خبالا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, according to the preceding taḍmīn [Note: If the verb is not made to include the meaning of a transitive verb, then the pronoun of address in يألونكم is accusative by removal of the preposition, and likewise (خبالا); the implied form is: لا يألون لكم في الخبال (they do not fall short for you in corruption) ...
They also permitted (خبالا) to be accusative as a tamyīz (specification), or it is a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), the verb being transitive to one object; this is the choice of al-ʿUkbarī.], (ودّوا) like آمنوا. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. (عنتّم) a past verb and its fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما عنتّم) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governor being ودّوا.
(قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (بدت) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif which was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (البغضاء) fāʿil, nominative. (من أفواه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بدت), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (الواو) conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (تخفي) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma. (صدور) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أكبر) khabar (predicate), nominative. (قد) like the first. (بيّنا) a past verb and its fāʿil. (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (بيّنا), (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (إن) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (كنتم) a defective past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the pronoun (تم) is the ism (subject) of kāna. (تعقلون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا تتّخذوا» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «لا يألونكم خبالا» has no grammatical position, resumptive «1».
The clause «ودّوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive «2».
The clause «عنتّم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «بدت البغضاء ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive «3».
The clause «ما تخفي صدورهم» أكبر has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause بدت ... [Note: The wāw may be circumstantial, and the clause after it is then in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.].
The clause «تخفي صدورهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «قد بيّنا لكم ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive - or causal (taʿlīliyya) -.
The clause «كنتم تعقلون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
