(زيغ): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb زاغ, of the ضرب pattern; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(تأويل): the regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أوّل; its wazn is تفعيل, with the addition of a tāʾ at the beginning of the past and a yāʾ before the last letter.
(الراسخون): plural of الراسخ, an active participle of the verb رسخ يرسخ, of the نصر pattern; its wazn is فاعل.
(يذكّر): it contains ibdāl (letter substitution); its original form is يتذكر, on the wazn يتفعّل; the tāʾ was changed to a dhāl because it came before the dhāl — the fāʾ of the word — and was assimilated into it for homogeneity.

safi-cedvel:8-8.t:
* I'rab:
(رب) the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, with the vocative particle omitted, accusative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا) prohibitive of supplication, jussive-governing; (تزغ) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (You); (قلوب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative; (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and it has the meaning of "time"; (هديت) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (التاء) is the fāʿil (agent); (نا) a pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunction; (هب) an imperative verb of supplication, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; (اللام) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (هب); (من) a preposition; (لدن) a noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a genitive, attached to (هب); and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (رحمة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of an accusative as the noun of إنّ; (أنت) a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Note: It is permissible for the pronoun to be a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), with (الوهّاب) as the khabar of إنّ; it is likewise permissible for it to be in the position of an accusative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the attached pronoun, and it was borrowed here for the accusative position.]»; (الوهّاب) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أنت, nominative.
The vocative clause «ربّنا لا تزغ» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "they said" (قالوا) or "say" (قولوا) ...
The clause «لا تزغ قلوبنا» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «هديتنا» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, by annexation of (إذ).
The clause «هب ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause لا تزغ.
The clause «إنّك أنت الوهّاب» has no grammatical position; it gives a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «أنت الوهّاب» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(تزغ): it contains iʿlāl by deletion; its original form is تزيغ; the yāʾ was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent ghayn, because of the jussive; its wazn is تفل, with ḍamma on the tāʾ and kasra on the fāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the expected form is تفل with kasra on the fāʾ, but the tāʾ of تُزِغ is indeed with ḍamma as the verb is أزاغ].
(هب): it contains iʿlāl by deletion: the wāw — the fāʾ of the word — was deleted because it is a mithāl (first-radical-weak) verb; its past is وهب; its wazn is عل, with fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(لدن): an adverb for the first limit of a time or place or of an entity, such as: من لدن زيد. It is most often annexed to a single word; it may be annexed to (أن) and its ṣila, and it may be annexed to the nominal and the verbal clause. Its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ and ḍamma on the ʿayn.
(رحمة): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb رحم يرحم, of the فرح pattern; its wazn is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الوهّاب): a derived adjective on the wazn فعّال, so it is an intensive form of the active participle of the verb وهب.

safi-cedvel:9-9.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّنا) its i'rab has been given — in the preceding ayah — and likewise (إنّك); (جامع) khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative; (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (ليوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the active participle جامع; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (ريب) the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative; (في) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of لا; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative; (لا) negative; (يخلف) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (الميعاد) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The clause «ربّنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical, to emphasize the plea for mercy.
The clause «إنّك جامع الناس» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «لا ريب فيه» is in the position of a genitive as naʿt (adjective) of يوم.
The clause «إنّ الله لا يخلف ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive «[Note: Or it is a badal (substitute) of the clause (انّك جامع الناس) in the view of some of them, and there is in the speech a shift (iltifāt) from the second-person pronoun to mention of the Name of Majesty.]».
The clause «لا يخلف ...» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(جامع): active participle of جمع يجمع, of the فتح pattern; its wazn is فاعل.
(الميعاد): a noun of time or place, irregularly formed, from وعد يعد; its wazn is مفعال. It contains iʿlāl by substitution (qalb); its original form is موعاد, with kasra on the mīm: the wāw came quiescent after a kasra, so it was changed to a yāʾ. It is permissible for the word الميعاد to denote the maṣdar in the sense of "promise".

safi-cedvel:10-10.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) its i'rab has been given before; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative as the noun of إنّ; (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (لن) a particle of negation, accusative and future; (تغني) an imperfect verb, accusative; (عن) a preposition, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تغني); (أموال) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation; (أولاد) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to أموال, nominative like it, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيئا — an adjective that has come before the noun it qualifies —; (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative «[Note: If the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, then (شيئا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, the implied form being: wealth will not avail against the punishment of Allah some availing, or anything of availing.]»; (الواو) conjunction; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address; (هم) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position «[Note: Or a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is وقود, and the clause هم وقود is the khabar of أولئك.]»; (وقود) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative; (النار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «إنّ الذين كفروا ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لن تغني عنهم أموالهم» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «أولئك هم وقود» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause لن تغني «[Note: It is permissible for it to be resumptive, with no grammatical position.]».

* Morphology:
(الوقود): the noun from وقد يقد, of the ضرب pattern, i.e. that with which fire is kindled; its wazn is فعول, with fatḥa on the fāʾ. It is said that الوقود with fatḥa on the wāw may be a maṣdar, like الوقود with ḍamma on it.

safi-cedvel:77-77.t:
* I'rab:
(انّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the ism of إنّ; (يشترون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (بعهد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يشترون), which is made to carry the meaning of يستبدلون (they exchange); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (أيمان) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to عهد, genitive like it, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ثمنا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (قليلا) naʿt (adjective) of it, accusative like it; (أولاء) a demonstrative, mabnī on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (خلاق) ism of لا, mabnī on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of لا; (في الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of لا; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (يكلّم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (ينظر) like يكلّم, and the fāʿil is هو; (إليهم) like لهم, attached to (ينظر); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (ينظر); (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ولا يزكّيهم) like ولا يكلّمهم, and the fāʿil is هو; (الواو) conjunction; (لهم) like the first, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أليم) naʿt of it, nominative; (أليم) naʿt of it, nominative like it. «[Translator's note: The source repeats «(أليم)» twice here.]»
The clause «إن الذين يشترون..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يشترون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.
The clause «أولئك» لا خلاق لهم is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «لا خلاق لها» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أولئك. «[Translator's note: The source writes «لها»; the Quranic text is «لهم».]»
The clause «لا يكلّمهم الله» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لا خلاق.
The clause «لا ينظر إليهم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لا خلاق.
The clause «لا يزكّيهم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لا خلاق.
The clause «لهم عذاب» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لا خلاق.

* Morphology:
(ثمنا): a noun for what is the compensation in a sale; its verb is ثمن يثمن, of the كرم class; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas (verse 79 — al-Baqara).

* Rhetoric:
1- Implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya): in "buying", i.e. they exchange what they covenanted and the oaths they swore for the enjoyment of this world; and by that they saw fit to distort the Torah and change what is in it.

safi-cedvel:78-78.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (اللام) the lām of emphasis; (فريقا) the postponed ism of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (يلوون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ألسنة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بالكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يلوون) «[Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الألسنة.]», the bāʾ having the meaning of في, i.e. in reading the Book; (اللام) the lām of purpose (taʿlīl); (تحسبوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من الكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, i.e. counted as part of the Book «[Note: The preposition may be attached to the verb حسب without assuming an object.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تحسبوه ...) is in the position of genitive, attached to (يلوون).
(الواو) of the ḥāl; (ما) negating, operating like ليس; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as the ism of ما; (من الكتاب) like the first, attached to an omitted khabar of ما; (الواو) conjunction; (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (هو) a pronoun like the first; (من عند) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (وما هو من عند الله) like وما هو من الكتاب; (الواو) conjunction; (يقولون على الله ... يعلمون) the i'rab of this verse was given earlier «[Note: In verse (75) of this sūra.]».
The clause «إنّ منهم لفريقا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «يلوون» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (فريقا).
The clause «تحسبوه» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «ما هو من الكتاب» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يقولون..» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يلوون.
The clause «هو من عند الله» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «ما هو من عند الله» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يقولون على الله..» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يلوون.
The clause «هم يعلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

* Morphology:
(يلوون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its original form is يلويون: the ḍamma was found heavy on the yāʾ, so its vowel was moved to the wāw, and the yāʾ was deleted because, being quiescent, it met the wāw of the plural, so it became يلوون; its pattern is يفعون.
(ألسنة): plural of لسان, a non-derived (jāmid) noun; it is — mostly — masculine, and some make it feminine if its plural is ألسن.

* Rhetoric:
1- Simile (tashbīh): in His words «لتحسبوه», i.e. they bend their tongues with something resembling the Book so that you think that resemblance is from the Book.
2- And the overt mention of «the Majestic Name» and «the Book» in a place where a pronoun would be expected, to magnify the horror of what they ventured upon in speech.

* Benefits:
(لوى) the rope: he twisted it, يلويه ليّا. And لوى رأسه and ألوى برأسه: he turned it aside and turned away. And the words of Allah the Exalted: «وَإِنْ تَلْوُوا أَوْ تُعْرِضُوا». Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah be pleased with them both, said: it is the judge whose twisting and turning away is in favour of one of the two litigants against the other. And ألوى بالكلام: he diverted it from its direction. And ألوى بهم الدهر: time destroyed them. The poet said:
أصبح الدهر وقد ألوى بهم، غير تقوالك من قيل وقال
(Time has come to have swept them away, leaving nothing but your much talk of "it was said" and "he said".)

safi-cedvel:79-79.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negating; (كان) an incomplete past verb; (لبشر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of the verb كان; (أن) a maṣdar particle that makes the verb subjunctive; (يؤتي) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الكتاب) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الحكم، النبوّة) two nouns conjoined by the two conjunctions to الكتاب, accusative like it.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يؤتيه الله) is in the position of nominative as the postponed ism of كان.
(ثمّ) a conjunction; (يقول) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, conjoined to (يؤتي), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يقول); (كونوا) an incomplete imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the ism of كونوا; (عبادا) khabar of كونوا, accusative; (اللام) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (عبادا); (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the yāʾ in (لي) «[Note: i.e. singly, apart from Allah.]», (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no governing effect; (كونوا) like the first; (ربّانيّين) khabar of كونوا, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar particle; (كنت) an incomplete past verb, mabnī on the sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun in the position of nominative as the ism of كان; (تعلّمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم تعلّمون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to ربّانيّين, because it carries the meaning of the verb.
(الواو) conjunction; (بما كنتم تدرسون) like بما كنتم تعلّمون, in its single words and as an interpreted maṣdar.
The clause «ما كان لبشر أن يؤتيه الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يؤتيه الله..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن). The clause «يقول.» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يؤتيه الله.
The clause «كونوا عبادا» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «كونوا ربانيين» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl of an implied verb, i.e.:
لكن يقول: «كونوا ربّانيّين» (but he says: be lords of knowledge).. and the implied clause has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «كنتم تعلّمون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تعلّمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنتم.
The clause «كنتم تدرسون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كنتم تعلّمون.
The clause «تدرسون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of the second كنتم.

* Morphology:
(الحكم): maṣdar (verbal noun) of حكم يحكم, of the كرم class, meaning "he understood and became wise"; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(النبوة): a noun standing for the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the five-letter verb تنبأ; its pattern is فعولة with ḍamma on the first radical and fatḥa on the last radical.
(ربّانيّين): plural of ربّانيّ; it is either attributed (nisba) to الربّ, the alif and nūn in it being additions in the nisba to indicate intensiveness, like رقبانيّ and شعرانيّ for one thick of neck and abundant of hair.. or it is attributed to ربّان, who is the teacher of good and the one who governs people and teaches them the matter of their religion, the alif and nūn indicating an increase in the quality, as in عطشان and ريّان. Its pattern is فعلانيّ.

* Benefits:
- الربانيّ: a nisba to الرب with the addition of alif and nūn; this rule can be applied regularly in many nisbas when intensiveness is intended by them, such as «علماني، وروحاني، وديراني، وفوقاني، وتحتاني». This rule is more acceptable among the common people than among the learned; they always say دوماني and فيجاني as nisbas to دوما and الفيجة, and عقلاني and نفساني, etc.

safi-cedvel:80-80.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (يأمر) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), conjoined to the verb يؤتي — in the previous verse — and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is هو; (أن) a maṣdar particle that makes the verb subjunctive; (تتّخذوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الملائكة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (النبيّين) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الملائكة, accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (أربابا) second mafʿūl bihi, whose governor is تتخذوا, and it is accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تتّخذوا ...) is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi, whose governor is يأمركم «[Note: Or genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. بأن تتّخذوا.. and it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يأمركم.]».
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval; (يأمر) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (بالكفر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأمركم); (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يأمركم); (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (مسلمون) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «لا يأمركم» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause that is the ṣila of the particle relative, «يؤتيه الله الكتاب..», in the previous verse.
The clause «تتّخذوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative أن.
The clause «أيأمركم بالكفر» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أنتم مسلمون» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

safi-cedvel:187-187.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember); (أخذ) a past verb; (الله) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (ميثاق) a direct object, accusative (manṣūb); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أوتوا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma.
And the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الكتاب) a direct object, accusative; (اللام) the lām of the oath; (تبيّننّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the presence of the nūn, which was deleted because of the succession of identical letters (tawālī al-amthāl), and the wāw, deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the agent ... and the nūn is the nūn of emphasis, and (الهاء) a pronoun, direct object; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تبيّننّ); (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) negative; (تكتمون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the agent, and (الهاء) a direct object; (الفاء) a conjunction; (نبذوا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the agent, and (الهاء) a direct object; (وراء) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (نبذوه); (ظهور) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (اشتروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters ... and the wāw is the agent; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (اشتروا); (ثمنا) a direct object, accusative; (قليلا) naʿt (adjective) of (ثمنا), accusative like it; (الفاء) resumptive; (بئس) a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, its agent a latent (mustatir) pronoun, necessarily so, implied as "huwa"; (ما) an indefinite noun that is qualified (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of an accusative, tamyīz (specification) of the agent pronoun «[Note: This is one of the ways of parsing (ما). (ما) may be the agent, in which case it is definite.
It may also be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is the tamyīz of the latent pronoun, i.e.:
بئس (هو) شراء هذا الشراء (wretched is it as a purchase, this purchase) ... and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "this purchase".]»; (يشترون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the agent.
The clause «أخذ الله ...» is in the position of a genitive: muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أوتوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «تبيّننّه..» has no grammatical position: the response to an oath.
The clause «لا تكتمونه» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that is the response to the oath «[Note: Some allowed the clause to be the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "أنتم" (you) ... and the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial), making the wāw the wāw of the ḥāl; for a negated verbal clause in the position of a ḥāl may not be preceded by the wāw of the ḥāl.]».
The clause «نبذوه ...» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause أخذ الله.
The clause «اشتروا ...» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause نبذوه.
The clause «بئس ما يشترون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يشترون» is in the position of an accusative: naʿt of (ما).

* Rhetoric:
1- «فَنَبَذُوهُ وَراءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ»: casting behind the back is a representation (tamthīl) and metaphor (istiʿāra) for disregarding and paying no attention; its opposite is placing a thing before one's eyes and facing it.
2- Shift of address (al-iltifāt): Allah, Glorified and Exalted, moved from the third person in His saying «وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثاقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ» to the second person in His saying «لتبيننه», then returned to the third person. The wisdom in that is to increase the direct recording [of the charge] against them.
3- «وَاشْتَرَوْا بِهِ»: an implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya), in that buying is borrowed for exchanging the goods of this world for what they concealed; i.e. they abandoned what they were commanded and took in its place something trivial and contemptible from the debris of this world.

* Benefits:
1- The saying of the Exalted: «فَبِئْسَ ما يَشْتَرُونَ».
The verbs of praise and blame have occupied a large space in the efforts of the grammarians because of the discussions they involve, whether about their agent, their tamyīz, or the one specified for praise or blame in them.
What concerns us in this verse is to explain the rulings concerning «their tamyīz». The grammarians agree that five things are required in the tamyīz of these verbs.
1- Its tamyīz must come after them: one does not say: «رجلا نعم زهير».
2- The tamyīz must precede the one specified for praise or blame, as in «نعم رجلا زهير» (what an excellent man is Zuhayr); placing it after is rare.
3- The tamyīz must agree with the one specified, in singular, dual and plural, and in masculine and feminine, as in «نعم رجلا زهير», نعم رجلين زهير وخالد (what excellent men [two] are Zuhayr and Khālid), نعم رجالا أنتم (what excellent men you are), نعمت فتاة فاطمة (what an excellent girl is Fāṭima), نعمت فتاتين فاطمة وسعاد (what excellent girls [two] are Fāṭima and Suʿād), and نعمت فتيات المجتهدات (what excellent girls are the diligent ones). To this belongs the poet's saying:
نعم امرأين حاتم وكعب ... كلاهما غيث وسيف عضب
(What excellent men [two] are Ḥātim and Kaʿb: both of them are rain and a sharp sword.)
4- It must be capable of taking «أل», because it is transformed from an agent joined with it. Your saying: نعم رجلا زهير is transformed from your saying: نعم الرجل زهير.
The verifying scholars of grammar have chosen that «ما» in the like of the saying of the Exalted: «فَبِئْسَ ما يَشْتَرُونَ» and His saying «فنعما هي» is a complete (tāmma) indefinite noun parsed as a tamyīz, so it is in the position of an accusative; likewise the saying of the Exalted: «نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُمْ بِهِ».
5- Their tamyīz may not be omitted if the agent of these verbs is a pronoun referring to the tamyīz, and it is rarely omitted. An example of that: «إن قلت كذا فبها ونعمت» (if you said such, then so be it, and excellent!), i.e. what an excellent deed is your deed.
In this chapter there are discussions, ramifications and exceptions which it is not in our interest to take up in this abridgement; so turn to the books of grammar if you are among the champions of this field.

safi-cedvel:188-188.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) the prohibitive lā, jussive-governing; (تحسبنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a jussive.. and the nūn is the nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "anta"; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يفرحون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the agent; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفرحون); (أتوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.. and the wāw is the agent; (الواو) a conjunction; (يحبّون) like يفرحون; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يحمدوا) a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (بما) like the first «[Note: It may be an indefinite noun that is qualified (nakira mawṣūfa), and the clause after it is its naʿt (adjective).]», attached to (يحمدوا); (لم) a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; (يفعلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the agent; (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida); (لا تحسبنّ) like the first, and it is a repetition of it because of the length of the speech connected to the first, and (هم) a pronoun, the first direct object; (بمفازة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [element] which is the second object of (تحسبنّهم) «[Note: As for the second object of the first (تحسبنّ), it is omitted, indicated by the mentioned wording (بمفازة).]»; (من العذاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of مفازة «[Note: It may be attached to مفازة if that is a maṣdar.]»; (الواو) resumptive; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (أليم) naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحمدوا ...) is in the position of an accusative, a direct object of the verb يحبون, i.e. they love people's praising them.
The clause «لا تحسبنّ ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يفرحون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أتوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the first relative noun (ما).
The clause «يحبّون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يفرحون.
The clause «يحمدوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «لم يفعلوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «لا تحسبنّهم» has no grammatical position: a repeated resumption.
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مفازة) a mīmī maṣdar (verbal noun with prefixed mīm) from فاز يفوز, of the pattern (bāb) نصر; its wazn is مفعلة with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn.. The tāʾ in it is added for intensification, not for the feminine ... It may also be a noun of place from the same verb, and in the verse both meanings are valid together.

safi-cedvel:189-189.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (ملك) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction; (الأرض) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات, genitive like it; (الواو) a conjunction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (على كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قدير); (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (قدير) khabar, nominative.
The clause «لله ملك السموات» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الله ... قدير» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

safi-cedvel:119-119.t:
* I'rab:
(ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أولاء) a demonstrative, the one addressed (munādā), definite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on its end, its appearance being prevented by the vowel of its original indeclinability, in the position of the accusative [Note: See verse (85) of Sūrat al-Baqara, for there are other views on the i'rab of the demonstrative and the clauses that follow it.], (تحبّون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الواو) conjunction. (لا) negative. (يحبّونكم) like تحبّونهم. (الواو) conjunction. (تؤمنون) like تحبّون. (بالكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تؤمنون), (كلّ) semantic tawkīd (emphasis) of الكتاب, genitive (majrūr) like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) conjunction. (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis قالوا, in the position of the accusative. (لقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (قالوا) like لقوا. (آمنّا) a past verb and its fāʿil. (الواو) conjunction. (إذا خلوا) like إذا لقوا.. and the ḍamma is implied on the alif which was deleted before the wāw because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (عضّوا) like لقوا. (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of عضوا, i.e. enraged against you. (الأنامل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (من الغيظ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عضّوا), and من is causal. (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (موتوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بغيظ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (موتوا), and the bāʾ is causal [Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl, its implied form being متلبّسين بغيظكم (clothed in your rage).], (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the ism (subject) of إنّ, accusative. (عليم) khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative. (بذات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم. (الصّدور) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «أنتم ... تحبّونهم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The vocative clause «أولاء» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «تحبّونهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم.
The clause «لا يحبّونكم» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause تحبّونهم.
The clause «تؤمنون ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause تحبّونهم.
The clause «لقوكم» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the conditional particle, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis are in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause تحبّونهم.
The clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «آمنّا» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «خلوا» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the conditional particle, the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause تحبّونهم.
The clause «عضّوا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «موتوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «إنّ الله عليم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الأنامل), plural of أنملة, a primitive (jāmid) noun: the tip of the finger. Its pattern is أفعلة, with ḍamma on the hamza and ḍamma on the ʿayn, or with fatḥa on both, or with kasra on both; and with ḍamma on the hamza and fatḥa or kasra on the ʿayn; and with fatḥa on the hamza and ḍamma or kasra on the ʿayn; and with kasra on the hamza and fatḥa on the ʿayn - i.e. with all three vowels on the hamza and the ʿayn. It may also be pluralised as أنملات, with all three vowels on the two letters.
(الغيظ), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb غاظ يغيظ, of the class of ضرب, and a noun of maṣdar for the quadriliteral verb غيظ with doubled ʿayn, and the quadriliteral أغاظ, and غايظ; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- «عَضُّوا عَلَيْكُمُ الْأَنامِلَ» biting the fingertips is the habit of the regretful, grieving, helpless person; for this reason it is used to point to the state of these people. What is meant is not that there is actual biting; this is by way of kināya (metonymy) for an attribute.
(2) In the verse the imperative departs from its literal meaning to the meaning of invoking against them the continuance of rage and its increase through the multiplying of the strength of Islam and its people, until they perish from it, or through its intensification until it destroys them.

* Benefits:
- Among the curiosities of i'rab is the view of the Kufans that demonstratives, when intended for approximation (taqrīb), become sisters of kāna, putting the ism in the nominative and the khabar in the accusative. So they parse the demonstrative as a defective noun, the nominative as the ism of approximation and the accusative as the khabar of approximation. The truth may be on their side, since every mujtahid has a share; so choose what you see as closer to the truth.

safi-cedvel:120-120.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (تمسس) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (حسنة) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (تسؤ) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هي. (الواو) conjunction. (تصبكم سيّئة) like تمسسكم حسنة. (يفرحوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الباء) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفرحوا), (الواو) a conjunction. (إن تصبروا) a jussive-causing conditional particle and the protasis, and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (تتّقوا) like تصبروا and conjoined to it. (لا) negative. (يضرّ) an imperfect verb, nominative [Note: This i'rab is the best we can adopt in such an expression, when the imperfect comes in the nominative while being the apodosis - and it is the view of al-Mubarrad - because this fāʾ may occur in other places, as in His saying, the Exalted: فَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَلا يَخافُ بَخْساً وَلا رَهَقاً [al-Jinn - 13]. As for Sībawayh, he makes it nominative because it is an indication of the apodosis, with the intention of fronting.], and the fāʾ is implied, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (كيد) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, accusative (manṣūb), i.e. anything of harm. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the ism (subject) of إنّ, accusative. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to محيط. (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (محيط) khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «تمسسكم حسنة» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تسؤهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تصبكم سيّئة» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يفرحوا بها» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تتّقوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تصبروا.
The clause «لا يضرّكم كيدهم» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, with the fāʾ implied [Note: What permitted making the clause in the position of the jussive, rather than in the position of the nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) as is customary, is that the clause is preceded by the negative particle (لا); this is close to the verb being preceded by the negatives (لن) or (ما) when the clause is joined with the fāʾ.].
The clause «إنّ الله ... محيط» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal or particle relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(كيد) an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb كاد يكيد, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(محيط), a noun from the quadriliteral أحاط; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, and the weak letter was made vowelless because of heaviness. In the word there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change): its origin is محوط, with sukūn on the ḥāʾ and kasra on the wāw. The kasra on the wāw was felt heavy, so its vowel was transferred to the ḥāʾ, and it became محوط with kasra on the ḥāʾ and sukūn on the wāw; then the wāw was converted to yāʾ because of the kasra before it, and it became (محيط) (see al-Baqara - 19).

* Rhetoric:
1- The expression here with "touching" (al-mass) for the good and with "striking" (al-iṣāba) for the evil is merely for variety of expression, by way of the implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya). This is of the marvellous speech before which necks are cut short [i.e. which none can match].

* Benefits:
1- His saying, the Exalted, «لا يَضُرُّكُمْ» is jussive as the apodosis. The rule for the doubled verb when it is made jussive is that its vowel has three options: the first, that it is given a vowel matching the vowel of the verb's ʿayn; the second, that it takes the fatḥa because of the lightness of the fatḥa; and there is a third reading of the verb «يضركم» with kasra on the ḍād and the sukūn appearing on the end of the verb. This reading is according to «undoing the assimilation of the doubled verb when it is made jussive».

safi-cedvel:121-121.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر (remember). (غدوت) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, (التاء) the fāʿil (agent), (من أهل), a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (غدوت), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (تبوّئ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (المؤمنين) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) [Note: or it is accusative by removal of the preposition, which is the lām; it has occurred in His saying, the Exalted: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنا لِإِبْراهِيمَ مَكانَ الْبَيْتِ.]. (مقاعد) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (للقتال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبوّئ) [Note: or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مقاعد.], (الواو) resumptive. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (سميع) khabar (predicate), nominative. (عليم) second khabar, nominative.
The clause «غدوت ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تبوّئ ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of غدوت [Note: It is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), because the times of setting out and of stationing differ; it may be concomitant, i.e. intending to station the believers in positions.].
The clause «الله سميع» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مقاعد), plural of مقعد, which is a noun of place from قعد يقعد, of the class of نصر; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, because the ʿayn in the imperfect has ḍamma.

* Benefits:
1- There are some verbs that can come as defective, putting the ism (subject) in the nominative and the khabar in the accusative, and can come as complete, being content with their fāʿil. Among them is the verb «غد» [Translator's note: thus in the source, for غدا], which can be used in the meaning of going in the morning, so it is a complete verb. It may come in the meaning of صار (became), as in your saying «لقد غدا فلان صديقا» (So-and-so has become a friend), «so فلان is its ism and صديقا its khabar».

safi-cedvel:122-122.t:
* I'rab:
(إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute) of the إذ occurring in the previous verse [Note: or it is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) عليم in the previous verse.], (همّت) a past verb ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (طائفتان) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the alif. (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (طائفتان), (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and of the accusative. (تفشلا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and (الألف) is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تفشلا) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, which is the bāʾ, and the preposition is attached to (همّت).
(الواو) resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (وليّ) khabar (predicate), nominative, and (هما) a pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) conjunction. (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوكّل) [Note: The preposition was fronted here to give it importance.], (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition [Note: The implied form is: إن فشل بعض الناس فليتوكّل المؤمنون على الله (if some people lose heart, then let the believers rely on Allah).].
(اللام) the lām of command. (يتوكّل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (المؤمنون) fāʿil, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «همّت طائفتان» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تفشلا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «الله وليّهما» has no grammatical position, resumptive - or in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) -.
The clause «يتوكّل المؤمنون» is the apodosis of an implied condition [Note: The implied form is: إن فشل بعض الناس فليتوكّل المؤمنون على الله.], and the implied conditional clause is conjoined to the clause الله وليّهما.

safi-cedvel:123-123.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) occurring in the answer of an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (نصر) a past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (ببدر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نصركم), and the bāʾ means "in" [Note: The preposition may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of نصر, i.e.: He helped you while you were present at Badr.]. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أذلّة) khabar (predicate), nominative. (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the ism (subject) of لعلّ. (تشكرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «نصركم الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer of an implied oath.
The clause «أنتم أذلّة» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» is the apodosis of an implied condition [Note: i.e.: if Allah did that for you, then fear Him.].
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(أذلّة), plural of ذليل, an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from ذلّ يذلّ, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعيل. It has two other plurals: أذلّاء and ذلال with kasra on the dhāl.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَأَنْتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ» the speech is a kināya (metonymy) for the smallness of their number and equipment and the weakness of their condition. That is because they went out on water-camels, several of them taking turns on a single camel, and they had with them only one horse.

safi-cedvel:159-159.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) redundant (zāʾida); (رحمة) genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (لنت); (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة; (لنت) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (التاء) is the fāʿil (agent); (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (لنت); (الواو) conjunction; (لو) a non-jussivizing conditional particle; (كنت) a deficient past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn,
and (التاء) a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (فظّا) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (غليظ) a second khabar, accusative; (القلب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو; (انفضّوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (من حول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انفضّوا), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لنت..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كنت..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لنت.
The clause «انفضّوا» has no grammatical position, occurring as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition.
(الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (اعف) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (عنهم) like لهم, attached to (اعف); (الواو) conjunction; (استغفر لهم) like اعف عنهم; (الواو) conjunction; (شاور) like اعف, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في الأمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شاورهم); (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to the content of the apodosis, in the position of accusative; (عزمت) like لنت; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (توكّل) like اعف; (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (توكّل); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna; (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is "he" (هو); (المتوكّلين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «اعف عنهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if they do wrong, then pardon them.
The clause «استغفر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اعف.
The clause «شاورهم..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اعف.
The clause «عزمت» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the condition, its protasis and its apodosis are conjoined to the implied condition.
The clause «توكّل ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition.
The clause «إنّ الله يحبّ ...» has no grammatical position, giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يحبّ المتوكّلين» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(لنت): it involves a phonetic change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf) to suit the indeclinability on the sukūn; its original form is لينت: two sukūns came together - the sukūn of the yāʾ and the sukūn of the nūn - so the yāʾ was dropped. Its pattern is فلت with a kasra on the fāʾ, the kasra being an indication of the dropped letter.
(فظّا): a resembling adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from فظّ يفظّ, of the fataḥa class (bāb fataḥa); its pattern is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn.
(غليظ): a resembling adjective from غلظ يغلظ, of the naṣara class, the ḍaraba class and the karuma class.
(المتوكّلين): plural of المتوكّل, an active participle from the five-letter verb توكّل; it is on the pattern متفعّل, with a ḍamma on the mīm and a kasra on the doubled ʿayn.

* Benefits:
1- «ما» is not a complete indefinite noun meaning "thing", as some grammarians held, nor is it interrogative conveying wonder, as al-Fakhr al-Rāzī suggested. Nor is its being redundant in the Noble Qur'an a detraction from the eloquence of the Qur'an and from the freedom of Allah's speech from idle words; for the addition of a particle in Arabic is not arbitrary, but has purposes and benefits, some of which are too subtle to conceive and some of which need no explanation. «ما» in this verse is redundant in terms of i'rab, but it is not redundant or empty of meaning: it conveys emphasis and makes the meaning clearer and more firmly established. Moreover, we would not depart from the truth if we added that it provides rhythmic cadence and verbal resonance in the composition of the Noble Qur'an, which pairs its verbal inimitability with its semantic inimitability equally.
Ibn al-Athīr has a view on the redundancy of «ما»: he denies that it is redundant with no meaning, and holds rather that it came to magnify the blessing that Allah bestowed on His Messenger and poured upon him, so that on account of it he was gentle with the people.
Dropping it would diminish the meaning and weaken the structure. He brands whoever claims that there is redundancy in the Noble Qur'an without benefit as one of two men: either ignorant of the eloquence of the Arabs, or deviating from the highway of religion.
We are pleased that Ibn al-Athīr echoes what we have said about the redundancy of «ما» in this verse, for he says:
«What the grammarians say about (ما) in this verse, that it is redundant, they mean only that it does not prevent what precedes it from governing; do you not see that it did not prevent the bāʾ from governing the genitive in الرحمة?» So consider well.

safi-cedvel:160-160.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a jussivizing conditional particle; (ينصر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (غالب) the noun of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; (الواو) conjunction; (يخذلكم) like ينصركم; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from ذا; (ينصر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), and it is the resumptive pronoun (al-ʿāʾid); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينصر), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوكّل), the preposition phrase being fronted for its importance; (الفاء) linking an implied apodosis; (اللام) the lām of command; (يتوكّل) an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, and given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; (المؤمنون) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw.
The clause «ينصركم الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا غالب لكم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «يخذلكم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «من ذا الذي ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «ينصركم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «ليتوكّل المؤمنون» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if the believers want victory, let them rely on Allah ... and the implied conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(غالب): an active participle from غلب يغلب, of the ḍaraba class (bāb ḍaraba); its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:38-38.t:
* I'rab:
(هنا): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, departing from its literal spatial sense, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (دعا), which is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif. (زكريّا): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the alif. (ربّ): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ربّ): a vocative in construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative; the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the omitted (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (هب): an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (اللام): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (هب). (من): preposition. (لدن): a noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of genitive, attached to (هب) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ذرّيّة.]», and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (ذريّة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (طيّبة): naʿt (adjective) of ذريّة, accusative like it. (انّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الكاف) is the noun of إنّ. (سميع): the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative. (الدعاء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The clause «دعا زكريّا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قال.» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «the vocative.. رب» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, for imploring mercy.
The clause «هب لي» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنك سميع» لدعاء has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(دعا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is دعو: the wāw came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif. It is of the نصر class.
(هب): it contains iʿlāl by deletion. Its past is وهب, a weak verb of the mithāl type (first radical weak), whose fāʾ is deleted in the imperfect and imperative; its pattern is على with fatḥa on the ʿayn «[Translator's note: so in the text; the pattern intended is evidently عل.]» (and see verse 8 of this sūra).
(سميع): an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) — one of the attributes of Allah — or an intensive form of the active participle, because it is from the transitive سمع يسمع, of the فرح class; its pattern is فعيل (see verse 127 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(الدعاء): it contains ibdāl (letter substitution) of the lām of the word, which is the wāw, into hamza, because it came at the end after a quiescent augment alif; its origin is الدعا وفهو «[Translator's note: so in the text, evidently a misprint for "الدعاو، فهو".]» from the verb دعا يدعو; its pattern is فعال with ḍamma on the fāʾ (see verse 171 of Sūrat al-Baqara).

safi-cedvel:161-161.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negative; (كان) a deficient past verb; (لنبيّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna, fronted; (أن) a maṣdar particle governing the accusative; (يغلّ) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and its fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يغلّ) is in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna, postponed.
(الواو) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يغلل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (يأت) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is "he"; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (يأت); (غلّ) a past verb, indeclinable ... and its fāʿil is "he"; (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the verb يأت; (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (ثمّ) a conjunction; (توفّي) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (كلّ) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (نفس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (كسبت) a past verb ... and (التاء) is for the feminine, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "she" (هي); (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (لا) negative; (يظلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative, in the passive ... and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «ما كان لنبيّ..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يغلّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «من يغلل» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يغلل» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.]».
The clause «يأت ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussivizing condition not joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «غلّ ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «توفّى كلّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من يغلل «[Note: It is permissible for (ثمّ) to be resumptive - as will come in Sūrat al-ʿAnkabūt - and in that case the clause is resumptive.]».
The clause «كسبت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «هم لا يظلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «لا يظلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Rhetoric:
1- Intensification in the prohibition in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَما كانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَغُلَّ»; what is meant is to clear the Prophet ﷺ in the most eloquent way of what the archers suspected of him on the day of Uḥud.

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): conjunction. (نادت): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif, which was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.. (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الملائكة): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (هو): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (قائم): khabar (predicate), nominative. (يصلّي): imperfect verb, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (في المحراب): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يصلّي) or to the active participle قائم. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of أنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (يبشّر): imperfect verb, nominative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (بيحيى): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يبشّر), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "with the birth of يحيى".
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله يبشّرك) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (نادته), i.e. "the angels called him that Allah gives you glad tidings".
(مصدّقا): ḥāl, accusative, from يحيى. (بكلمة): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the active participle (مصدّقا) «[Note: The Word: meaning ʿĪsā, peace be upon him, i.e. confirming ʿĪsā; Yaḥyā was the first to believe in him.]». (من الله): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كلمة. (الواو): conjunction. (سيّدا): conjoined to (مصدّقا), accusative like it; and likewise (حصورا، نبيّا), conjoined by two conjunctions, accusative. (من الصالحين): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (نبيّا); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «نادته الملائكة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the first resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «هو قائم..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, either from the object pronoun in نادته or from الملائكة.
The clause «يصلّي في المحراب» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو.
The clause «يبشّرك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ.

* Morphology:
(نادته): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the alif, which is converted from a yāʾ, was deleted from it because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its pattern is فاعته.
(قائم): active participle from قام يقوم; the weak letter, the wāw, was converted into hamza regularly in the active participle of the hollow verb, where the weak letter is always converted into hamza after the alif of فاعل (see verse 18 of this sūra).
(يحيى): there are two views about it. The first: that it is transferred from the imperfect يحيا, because the Arabs often name with verbs, such as يعيش and يعمر; some said they named him يحيى because Allah gave him life through faith.. On this view it is a diptote because of being a proper name and having the pattern of a verb. The second view: that it is foreign with no derivation — and this is the apparent view — so its being a diptote is due to being a proper name and foreign.
(كلمة): a noun for what a person utters, single or compound; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then kasra, and it may be read on the pattern فعلة with kasra then sukūn (see verse 37 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(سيّدا): an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from ساد يسود on the pattern فيعل; its origin is سيود: the yāʾ and the wāw met in the word with the first quiescent, so the wāw was converted into yāʾ and assimilated into the second yāʾ.
(حصورا): a derived adjective; it is an intensive form of the active participle; its pattern is فعول with the meaning of فاعل. The حصور is one who does not approach women while being capable of that.

safi-cedvel:162-162.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation «[Note: Meaning negation, in the view of Abū Ḥayyān.]»; (الفاء) resumptive; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اتّبع) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (رضوان) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الكاف) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (باء) a past verb, and its fāʿil is "he"; (بسخط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (باء) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of باء, i.e. bound up with wrath.]»; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سخط; (الواو) conjunction; (مأوى) mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (جهنّم) khabar, nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (بئس) an inert (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (المصير) fāʿil, nominative. The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "it" (هي), i.e. Hell.
The clause «من اتّبع رضوان» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اتّبع ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (من).
The clause «باء بسخط» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «مأواه جهنّم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause باء بسخط.
The clause «بئس المصير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(السخط): the maṣdar (verbal noun) of سخط يسخط, of the fariḥa class (bāb fariḥa); its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(قال ربّ): its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (38) of this sūra.]». (أنّى): an interrogative noun meaning "how", in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); or an adverb meaning "from where", attached to (mutaʿalliq) the complete (يكون), or to its khabar if it is incomplete. (يكون): a complete imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (اللام): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يكون) «[Note: Or to the omitted khabar of يكون if it is incomplete.]». (غلام): the fāʿil (agent) of يكون, nominative «[Note: Or the noun of the incomplete يكون, with (لي) its khabar.]». (الواو): of the ḥāl. (قد): particle of realisation. (بلغ): past verb; (النون) is the nūn of protection and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الكبر): fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (امرأة): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (عاقر): khabar (predicate), nominative. (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (كذا): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is يفعل «[Note: Or attached to an omitted khabar, with the mubtadaʾ implied, i.e. "the matter is thus".]»; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (يفعل): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يشاء): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو", i.e. Allah.
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «the vocative and what is within its scope» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) «[Note: Or the vocative clause alone is a parenthetical supplication with no grammatical position, and the clause أنّى يكون is the object of the saying.]».
The clause «أنّى يكون لي غلام» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «بلغني الكبر» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «امرأتي عاقر» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.
The clause «قال (the second)» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «الله يفعل..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «يفعل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(عاقر): active participle from عقرت تعقر, of the ضرب and كرم classes; its pattern is فاعل, and it has the meaning of the passive, i.e. المعقورة (the barren).
(غلام): a primitive (jāmid) noun of entity; its pattern is فعال with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:163-163.t:
* I'rab:
(هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of nominative; (درجات) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "possessors of degrees" (ذوو درجات); (عند) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of درجات; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (بصير) khabar, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to بصير «[Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a maṣdar particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to بصير.]»; (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «هم درجات» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الله بصير ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal or particle relative.

* Rhetoric:
1- «هُمْ دَرَجاتٌ»: He likened them to steps in their varying in height and lowness, by way of istiʿāra (metaphor); or He made them the very degrees, to intensify the variation, so it is an eloquent simile (tashbīh balīgh) with the particle of comparison omitted.

safi-cedvel:41-41.t:
* I'rab:
(قال ربّ): its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (37) of this sūra.]» «[Translator's note: the parsing of قال ربّ is in fact given at verse 38.]». (اجعل): an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (اللام): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (آية): first mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو". (آية): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أن): maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (لا): negating. (تكلّم): imperfect verb, accusative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الناس): mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تكلّم الناس) is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ آيتك.
(ثلاثة): adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تكلّم). (أيّام): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (إلّا): particle of exception. (رمزا): excepted, accusative by the disconnected exception (al-istithnāʾ al-munqaṭiʿ) — gesture is not speech — or the connected one — gesture being a kind of speech. (الواو): conjunction. (اذكر): imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "أنت". (ربّ): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (كثيرا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, as it is its adjective. (الواو): conjunction. (سبّح): like اذكر. (بالعشيّ): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سبّح). (الواو): conjunction. (الإبكار): conjoined to العشيّ, genitive like it.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ربّ اجعل (the vocative one)» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اجعل» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «قال (the second)» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «آيتك ألا تكلّم الناس» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «اذكر» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the second clause of the object of the saying.
The clause «سبّح» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the second clause of the object of the saying.

* Morphology:
(رمزا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رمز يرمز, of the ضرب class and the فتح class; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(العشيّ): a singular, or a plural whose singular is عشيّة. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is عشيو — because its verb is عشا يعشو, maṣdar عشو. When the yāʾ and the wāw met at the end of the word with the first quiescent, the wāw was converted into yāʾ and assimilated into the second yāʾ, so it became عشيّ.. Its pattern is فعيل.
(الإبكار): the regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أبكر; its pattern is إفعال.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His saying, the Exalted, «رمزا» there is the art of ishāra (gesture/allusion), because it indicated the stirrings and meanings within the human soul.

* Benefits:
- His saying, the Exalted, «إِلَّا رَمْزاً»: in this word there is an indication of the art of gesture and suggestion by means of posture and movement. Our poets in times past alluded to this direction. Abū Tammām said!
توحي بأسرارنا حواجبنا ... وأعين بالوصال ترتشق
(Our eyebrows convey our secrets, and eyes that exchange glances of union.)
And he also said:
كلّمته يجفون غير ناطقة ... فكان من رده ما قال حاجبه
(I spoke to him with eyelids that do not speak, and his reply was what his eyebrow said.) «[Translator's note: يجفون is printed so; بجفون "with eyelids" is evidently intended.]»
And another said:
إذا كلمتني بالعيون الفواتر ... رددت عليها بالدموع البوادر
(When she spoke to me with languid eyes, I answered her with hastening tears.)
It is worth mentioning that some authors among the scholars of the West have taken this path and written books on the art of gesture and its role in expression, which have their value and popularity.

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (إذ): an adverb in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". (قال): past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (الملائكة): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (يا): vocative particle. (مريم): a vocative of a single proper name (munādā mufrad ʿalam), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis. (الله): the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (اصطفى): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (الكاف) is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الواو): conjunction in both places. (طهّرك): like اصطفاك, and likewise the second اصطفاك. (على نساء): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اصطفاك). (العالمين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «قالت الملائكة..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «the vocative and what is within its scope» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّ الله اصطفاك» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «اصطفاك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «طهرك» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اصطفاك.
The clause «اصطفاك» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اصطفاك (the first).

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(يا مريم): its i'rab has been given in the previous verse. (اقنتي): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent).
