(نا) is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of nominative; (للكفر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أقرب); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative «[Note: Or it is indeclinable on the fatḥa - according to some views - and it took on indeclinability from the adverb, since it became of the type of the compound adverb, like صباح مساء and بين بين ... [Translator's note: the wording of this footnote is garbled in the source (إذا أصح for إذ أصبح); translated according to its evident sense.]», attached to (أقرب); (إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn is the tanwīn of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ) for an omitted clause; (أقرب) khabar (predicate), nominative; (من) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أقرب); (للإيمان) like للكفر «[Note: The two prepositions, though identical in form and meaning, are attached to a single governor because it is specific to the elative pattern (afʿal al-tafḍīl), so it is equivalent to two governors; and they are للكفر and للإيمان.]»; (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (بأفواه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of يقولون, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) a relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of it.]», in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (ليس) an inert, deficient past verb, and its noun is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو); (في قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ليس, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أعلم) khabar, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun «[Note: Or a maṣdar particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive.]», indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أعلم); (يكتمون) like يقولون.
The clause «يعلم الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «نافقوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «قيل لهم..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause «[Note: It is permissible for it to be resumptive, with no grammatical position.]».
The clause «تعالوا ...» is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) «[Note: Because it is originally the speech reported by the verb "to say" (maqūl al-qawl) ... The majority said that it explains an implied nāʾib fāʿil, i.e. "the saying was said".]».
The clause «قاتلوا ...» is in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from the clause تعالوا.
The clause «ادفعوا» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause قاتلوا.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لو نعلم..» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «اتّبعناكم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition.
The clause «هم ... أقرب» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يقولون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ليس في قلوبهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «الله أعلم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يكتمون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative.

* Morphology:
(أعلم): an adjective on the pattern أفعل, but not for comparison (tafḍīl); it means عليم or عالم ("knowing") (see verse 140 of al-Baqara).

* Rhetoric:
1- Majāz mursal (metonymic trope): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْواهِهِمْ ما لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ»,
i.e. they say with their tongues, the mouths being the place of the tongues; so He expressed the place and meant what resides in it. The relation is thus one of location (maḥalliyya).

safi-cedvel:85-85.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يبتغ) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (غير) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (دينا) — a naʿt (adjective) that preceded what it qualifies — and (دينا) is a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is يبتغ.]», (الإسلام) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (دينا) a tamyīz (specification) of غير, because it is a vague word «[Note: It may be a badal (substitute) of the mafʿūl bihi غير.]», accusative; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لن) a particle of negation that makes the verb subjunctive; (يقبل) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative (marfūʿ), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقبل); (الواو) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (في الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to الخاسرين; (من الخاسرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هو.
«[Translator's note: The source describes (يقبل) as nominative; after لن it is subjunctive (manṣūb).]»
The clause «من يبتغ ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يبتغ ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «لن يقبل منه» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هو ...» من الخاسرين is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.

* Morphology:
(يبتغ): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion because of the jussive; its pattern is يفتع.

safi-cedvel:86-86.t:
* I'rab:
(كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and it carries the meaning of disapproval and deeming something far-fetched; (يهدي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (قوما) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (كفروا) a past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; () an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كفروا) «[Translator's note: The parsed word is missing from the source here; it is (بعد).]», (إيمان) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (شهدوا) like كفروا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الرسول) ism of أنّ, accusative; (حقّ) khabar of أنّ, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الرسول حقّ) is in the position of genitive by an omitted bāʾ, attached to (شهدوا).
(الواو) conjunction; (جاء) a past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (البيّنات) fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (لا) negating; (يهدي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (القوم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الظالمين) naʿt (adjective) of القوم, accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «يهدي الله» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (قوما).
The clause «شهدوا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause كفروا «[Note: The clause may be the ṣila (relative clause) of an implied maṣdar particle.. with the interpreted maṣdar in the position of genitive, conjoined to the explicit maṣdar إيمان.. i.e. after their faith and their testimony that the Messenger is true.. As for conjoining the clause شهدوا to the clause كفروا, the implied sense is: how will He guide them after the two matters have come together, disbelief and testimony to the truthfulness of the Messenger.. Further, some allowed the clause to be a ḥāl, with قد implied.]».
The clause «جاءهم البيّنات» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause شهدوا «[Note: Or the wāw is of the ḥāl and the clause is a ḥāl, with قد implied.]».
The clause «الله لا يهدي..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يهدي..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

* Benefits:
2- كيف: it is the interrogative كيف; it is a vague, non-fully-declinable (ghayr mutamakkin) noun used to ask about the state of a thing, mabnī on the fatḥa. Questioning with it is of two kinds:
Real: as in «كيف حالك؟»; or not real, which is for several considerations. In this verse it is for negation, and it may be for wonder and disapproval, as in the words of Allah the Exalted: كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ؟». As for its i'rab, it is as follows:
- It occurs as khabar of a mubtadaʾ, as in «كيف أنت»?; or as a fronted khabar of كان, as in «كيف كنت»; or as a fronted second object of «ظنّ» and its sisters, as in «كيف ظننت أخاك»; or as a third object of «أعلم» and its sisters, as in «كيف أعلمت فرسك», because the second of the two objects of ظنّ and the third of the objects of أعلم is originally a khabar. «[Translator's note: The source writes «خبر أنّ في الأصل»; the sense is "originally a khabar".]»
It may come before the bāʾ among the prepositions, which is then a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; so you say «كيف بخالد»: كيف is in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar, and بخالد: the bāʾ is redundant and خالد is a mubtadaʾ, nominative in position and genitive in form. It may be in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), as in the words of Allah the Exalted: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحابِ الْفِيلِ; and it occurs as a ḥāl, as in «كيف مضى أخوك», i.e. in what state did he go ... ?

safi-cedvel:87-87.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address; (جزاء) a second mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of (أنّ); (لعنة) the postponed ism of أنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction in both places; (الملائكة، الناس) two nouns conjoined to the Name of Majesty, genitive like it; (أجمعين) a semantic tawkīd (emphasis) of what precedes, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ «[Note: See verse (161) of Sūrat al-Baqara.]» and the interpreted maṣdar (أنّ عليهم لعنة الله) is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ جزاء.
The clause «أولئك جزاؤهم..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «جزاؤهم أنّ عليهم لعنة الله» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).

safi-cedvel:88-88.t:
* I'rab:
(خالدين): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), of the pronoun in (عليهم) — in the previous verse — the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين, and the pronoun refers to the curse, or to the Fire indicated by it; (لا) negating; (يخفّف) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative (marfūʿ); (عنهم) like فيها, attached to (يخفّف); (العذاب) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating, repeated to emphasize the negation; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ينظرون) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «لا يخفّف عنهم العذاب» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in خالدين, or has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هم ينظرون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause لا يخفّف.. or has no grammatical position.
The clause «ينظرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

safi-cedvel:89-89.t:
* I'rab:
(إلّا) a particle of exception; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the excepted; (تابوا) a past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تابوا); (ذا) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (الواو) conjunction; (أصلحوا) like تابوا; (الفاء) causal (taʿlīliyya); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, ism of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (غفور) khabar of إنّ, nominative (marfūʿ); (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «تابوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أصلحوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «انّ الله غفور» has no grammatical position: a causal explanation of something implied, i.e. فالله يغفر لهم إنّ الله غفور رحيم (so Allah forgives them; indeed Allah is Forgiving, Merciful).

safi-cedvel:90-90.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the ism of إنّ; (كفروا) a past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كفروا); (إيمان) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (ازدادوا) like كفروا; (كفرا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (لن) a particle of negation that makes the verb subjunctive; (تقبل) an imperfect verb, passive, subjunctive (manṣūb); (توبة) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (أولئك هم الضالّون) like أولئك هم الفاسقون «[Note: In verse (82) of this sūra.]».
The clause «إنّ الذين كفروا..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ازدادوا..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لن تقبل توبتهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «أولئك هم الضالون» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لن تقبل.

* Morphology:
(توبة): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb تاب يتوب, of the نصر class; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn; and there are other maṣdars: توب without tāʾ marbūṭa, تابة, and متابا — which is a mīmī maṣdar — and تتوبة with kasra on the wāw.

* Benefits:
1- The commentators paused at length before the words of Allah the Exalted لن تقبل توبتهم, given that Allah has opened the door of repentance to His servants however much they have done wrong and sinned. Some of them got out of this difficulty by taking this verse to refer to the hour of death, «since a text has come concerning this specifically, so the repentance of one on the point of death is not accepted by the text of the Noble Qur'an».
2- The conjunctive wāw that precedes a condition conjoins this condition to another condition that is understood, as when you say «أكرم فلانا ولو أساء» (honour so-and-so even if he does wrong): honouring the wrongdoer entails honouring the doer of good, since he is more deserving of honour.

safi-cedvel:195-195.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (استجاب) a past verb; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb استجاب; (ربّ) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of anna; (لا) negative; (أضيع) an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "anā"; (عمل) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (عامل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of عامل; (من ذكر) a preposition and its genitive noun, a badal (substitute) from the preceding preposition and genitive noun, with the preposition repeated «[Note: Some allowed (من) to be redundant (zāʾida) because it rests on a negation, with (ذكر) accusative in position as a ḥāl (circumstantial) ... or the preposition and its genitive noun is a tamyīz (specification) of the second-person pronoun in (منكم).]»; (أو) a conjunction; (أنثى) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ذكر, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the alif; (بعض) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من بعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ بعض.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي لا أضيع ...) is in the position of a genitive governed by an omitted preposition, attached to (استجاب ...), i.e. their Lord answered them with [the assurance] that I do not let be lost ...
(الفاء) resumptive; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ; (هاجروا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw is the agent; (الواو) a conjunction; (أخرجوا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (من ديار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخرجوا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (أوذوا) like أخرجوا; (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أوذوا), and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (قاتلوا) like هاجروا; (الواو) a conjunction; (قتلوا) like أخرجوا; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (أكفرنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative ... and the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis, its agent a latent pronoun, implied as "anā"; (عنهم) like له «[Translator's note: so in the source: «مثل له».]», attached to (أكفّر); (سيّئات) a direct object, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (لأدخلنّهم) like لأكفّرنّ ... and (هم) is the first direct object; (جنّات) a second direct object, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ; (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from الأنهار, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; there is a muḍāf omitted, i.e. from beneath its trees; (الأنهار) the agent, nominative; (ثوابا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar «[Note: It may be in the place of a ḥāl from the object pronoun in (أدخلنّهم), i.e. rewarded ... or a ḥāl from جنّات, i.e. given as a reward ... or a badal from جنّات, by making the verb include the meaning of أعطينّهم (I shall surely give them).]», because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) or a noun for that with which one is rewarded; (من عند) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (ثوابا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (حسن) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الثواب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «استجاب ...» ربّهم has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا أضيع ...» is in the position of a nominative: the khabar of anna.
The clause «بعضكم من بعض» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from عامل, or in the position of a genitive, a naʿt of it «[Note: It may be resumptive, and so have no position ... or parenthetical, with the clause الذين هاجروا conjoined to the resumptive clause.]».
The clause «الذين هاجروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هاجروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أوذوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هاجروا.
The clause «أخرجوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هاجروا.
The clause «قاتلوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هاجروا.
The clause «قتلوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هاجروا.
The clause «أكفّرنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the response to an implied oath ... and the implied oath clause together with its response is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) «[Note: This is a refutation of whoever says that an oath clause cannot be the khabar of a mubtadaʾ.]».
The clause «أدخلنّهم..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that is the response to the oath.
The clause «تجري ... الأنهار» is in the position of an accusative: naʿt of جنّات.
The clause «الله عنده حسن الثواب» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «عنده حسن الثواب» is in the position of a nominative: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

* Morphology:
(أوذوا) it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion; its original is أوذيوا — with kasra on the dhāl and ḍamma on the yāʾ. The ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made quiescent and its vowel transferred to the dhāl; when two quiescent letters met, the yāʾ and the wāw of the plural, the yāʾ was deleted and it became أوذوا ... It contains another change: the conversion of the second hamza in the madda into a wāw when it was made passive. Its original is آذى — without the wāw of the plural — and in the passive أوذي with a yāʾ at its end; then the second hamza was lightened and it became أوذي; then the wāw of the plural was attached and it became أوذوا — after the change by deletion. Its wazn is أفعوا.

* Rhetoric:
1- «فَاسْتَجابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عامِلٍ مِنْكُمْ»: in this noble verse there is a shift of address (iltifāt) from the third person to the first and second persons. That is to show complete attention to the matter of the answer and to honour those who call upon Him with the honour of being addressed. The intent is to confirm it by stating its cause and to indicate that it turns on their deeds, which they put forward before the supplication, not on supplication alone.
2- The close of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān has come beautiful and fine. Just as the close of Sūrat al-Baqara came comprising and containing supplication, the close of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān came comprising and containing a number of beneficial counsels. This is part of the excellence of the conclusion (ḥusn al-khitām), so that it remains firmly in the ears.

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (الهمزة) for interrogation; (أنبّئ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا" (I), and (كم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بخير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنبّئ); (من) a preposition; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, attached to (خير); and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (اتّقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of جنات «[Note: Or attached to the omitted fronted khabar; or attached to خير if the relative noun is attached to it and (جنّات) is parsed as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي".]» — an adjective that has come before the noun it qualifies —; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (جنّات) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative «[Note: Or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو".]»; (تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري), and (ها) muḍāf ilayhi; (الأنهار) fāʿil, nominative; (خالدين) ḥāl, accusative, of the relative noun, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to خالدين; (الواو) conjunction; (أزواج) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to جنّات, nominative like it; (مطهّرة) naʿt (adjective) of أزواج, nominative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (رضوان) maʿṭūf to جنّات, nominative like it; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of رضوان; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (بصير) khabar, nominative; (بالعباد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بصير.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «أأنبّئكم» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «للذين اتّقوا ... جنّات» has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) «[Note: Or in the position of a genitive as badal (substitute) of خير.]».
The clause «تجري من تحتها الأنهار» is in the position of a nominative as naʿt of جنّات.
The clause «الله بصير» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مطهّرة): feminine of مطهّر, a passive participle of the quadriliteral طهّر; its wazn is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn (ayah 25, al-Baqara).
(رضوان): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb رضي يرضى, of the فرح pattern; its wazn is فعلان, with ḍamma on the fāʾ, and kasra on it is permissible in the maṣdar.

* Benefits:
- The verbs that take three objects are «اعلم» and «أرى», on which there is consensus; Sībawayh added «نبأ» and «أنبأ»; al-Farrāʾ added in his Maʿānī «خبر» and «أخبر»; and the Kufans added (حدّث).

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم" (they) «[Note: Or in the position of a genitive: either as naʿt (adjective) of the preceding relative noun in the previous ayah, or as badal (substitute) of it; or as naʿt of العباد. It is also permissible for it to be in the position of an accusative by an omitted verb, with the intention of praise.]»; (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), with the vocative particle omitted, and it is muḍāf, accusative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (نا) a pronoun, the noun of إنّ, in the position of an accusative; (آمنّا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) is the fāʿil; (الفاء) a causal conjunction «[Note: Or linking the apodosis of a condition.]»; (اغفر) an imperative verb of supplication, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; (اللام) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اغفر); (ذنوب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (قنا) like اغفر, indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter, and (نا) mafʿūl bihi; (عذاب) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (النار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «(هم) الذين يقولون» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يقولون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «the vocative and its response» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّنا آمنا» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «آمنا» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «اغفر لنا» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause آمنا «[Note: ʿAbbās Ḥasan said in his book al-Naḥw al-Wāfī, vol. 3, p. 464: "And it — i.e. the fāʾ — often conveys, along with order and immediate succession, causation, i.e. indicating causality (in that the conjoined element is caused by what it is conjoined to); and this predominates in two things: the conjoining of clauses, and in a derived conjoined element." End quote. It is permissible for the clause to be the apodosis of an implied condition.]».
The clause «قنا» is conjoined to the clause اغفر لنا and takes its grammatical position.

* Morphology:
(عذاب): a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the quadriliteral عذّب, whose regular maṣdar is تعذيب; its wazn is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ (al-Baqara 7).

* Benefits:
1- The verb whose first radical is weak is the "mithāl", such as وقى and وعد. When the imperative is formed from it, its fāʾ, which is a wāw or a yāʾ, is deleted; and since the imperative is indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter from its end, the result will be that its fāʾ is deleted and its lām is deleted, as in وقى, which becomes ق, and وعى, ع, etc.

safi-cedvel:17-17.t:
* I'rab:
(الصابرين) naʿt (adjective) of (الذين اتّقوا), genitive «[Note: in ayah (15) of this sūra; or of (الذين يقولون) (in the preceding ayah), in the two cases of the genitive and the accusative.]», the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunction in the four places; (الصادقين، القانتين، المنفقين، المستغفرين) words conjoined to الصابرين, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (بالأسحار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) المستغفرين, for it is an active participle.

* Morphology:
(المنفقين): plural of منفق, an active participle of أنفق; its wazn is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn; it contains the deletion of the hamza for lightness, its original form being المؤنفقين «[Note: See ayah (3) of Sūrat al-Baqara, the word (ينفقون).]».
(المستغفرين): plural of مستغفر, an active participle of استغفر, and it is on the same wazn as the word المنفقين [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e. formed the same way, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the letter before the last].
(الأسحار): plural of سحر, with two fatḥas, an underived (jāmid) noun; it was so named because of the hiddenness in it, as السحر (magic) is a name for the hidden thing; its wazn is فعل, with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
1- Placing the wāw between the enumerated qualities indicates the independence of each of them and their perfection in them, or the difference between those qualified by them.

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(شهد) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الهاء) a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative as the noun of أنّ; (لا إله إلّا هو) its i'rab has been given before «[Note: ayah (2) of this sūra.]».
The interpreted maṣdar from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar, is in the position of a genitive by an omitted preposition, the implied form being: بأنّه لا إله ...; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شهد).
(الواو) conjunction; (الملائكة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty, nominative like it; and (أولو) maʿṭūf to the Name of Majesty by the wāw, nominative like it, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, for it is treated like the sound masculine plural; (العلم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (قائما) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the detached pronoun after إلّا «[Note: Or a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty, the agent of شهد.]»; (بالقسط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قائما), the active participle; (لا إله إلّا هو) its i'rab has been given before; (العزيز) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو", and the clause is a badal (substitute) of the detached pronoun هو «[Note: Or a badal of the detached pronoun هو.]» [Translator's note: so in the source; the footnote presumably means العزيز alone as a badal of هو]; (الحكيم) a second khabar, nominative «[Note: Or a badal of العزيز, nominative like it.]».
The clause «شهد الله» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of أنّ.
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive, repeated for emphasis.

* Morphology:
(قائما): active participle of قام — in every hollow verb the weak letter is changed into a hamza in the فاعل form — and its original form is قاوم.
(القسط): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb قسط يقسط, of the two patterns نصر and ضرب; its wazn is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- In the ayah there is radd al-ʿajuz ʿalā al-ṣadr (returning the end to the beginning): العزيز is returned to His words, the Exalted, «لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ», i.e. to His uniqueness in the Oneness that requires might; and «الحكيم» is returned to His words, the Exalted, «قائِماً بِالْقِسْطِ», for He, the Exalted, is Wise, and no injustice or deviation encroaches upon Him.

safi-cedvel:45-45.t:
* I'rab:
(إذ قالت الملائكة يا مريم إنّ الله): its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (42) of this sūra.]». (يبشّر): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (بكلمة): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يبشّر). (من): preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كلمة. (اسم): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (المسيح): khabar (predicate), nominative. (عيسى): badal (substitute) from المسيح, nominative like it; the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma. (ابن): naʿt of عيسى or a badal from it, nominative like it «[Note: Al-ʿUkbarī said: "ابن مريم is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. هو ابن; it may not be a badal from what precedes it nor an adjective, because ابن مريم is not a name..." End quote. But the meaning in the verse may admit predication and may admit description of the word عيسى; and the retention of the alif in (ابن) in the Quranic orthography may be intended to treat ابن as a khabar, not an adjective — but the mubtadaʾ is then not the word عيسى but the latent pronoun هو.]». (مريم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, because it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and feminine. (وجيها): ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), from the word كلمة. (في الدنيا): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (وجيها) because it is a derived adjective; the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (الآخرة): conjoined to الدنيا, genitive like it. (الواو): conjunction. (من المقرّبين): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl conjoined to the first ḥāl; the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «قالت الملائكة..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يا مريم» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّ الله يبشّرك» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «يبشّرك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «اسمه المسيح» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of كلمة.

* Morphology:
(المسيح): some said it is a Hebrew word meaning "the blessed". Others said it is an intensive form of the active participle on the pattern فعيل, according to one of two views, because he traversed (masaḥa) the earth by wandering, or because he would wipe (yamsaḥu) one with an affliction and he would be healed; or it is فعيل with the meaning of the passive, according to another view, because he was anointed with blessing, or because he was flat-footed, or because his face was anointed with comeliness; then it was transferred from the adjective to the name.
(عيسى): it has been said that it is taken from العيس, which is whiteness overlaid with redness (and see verse 87 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(وجيها): an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha); its pattern is فعيل, from the verb وجه يوجه, of the كرم class.
(المقرّبين): plural of المقرّب, passive participle from the quadriliteral قرّب; its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.

* Benefits:
- إذ is an adverb of time, e.g. «جئت إذ طلعت الشمس» (I came when the sun rose). It may be an adverb for the future, as in His saying, the Exalted, «فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ إِذِ الْأَغْلالُ فِي أَعْناقِهِمْ». It may occupy the place of the muḍāf ilayhi, so that a noun of time is annexed to it, as in His saying, the Exalted, رَبَّنا لا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنا. It is necessarily annexed to clauses, and part of the clause or all of it may be deleted and compensated for by the tanwīn of compensation, as in His saying, the Exalted, «فَلَوْلا إِذا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ وَأَنْتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنْظُرُونَ», i.e. "when the soul reaches the throat, you are looking on".
Some have added that it may be for causation, citing as evidence the saying of al-Farazdaq:
فأصبحوا قد أعاد الله نعمتهم ... إذ هم قريش وإذ ما مثلهم بشر
(So they came to be, Allah having restored their bounty, since they are Quraysh and since no human is like them.)
Likewise it is reported to be for surprise, namely the one occurring after «بينا» and «بينما», as in the saying of the poet:
استقدر الله خيرا وأرضينّ به ... فبينما العسر إذ دارت مياسير
(Ask Allah to decree good and be content with it; for while there is hardship, lo! ease comes round.)
In this case its being a particle is preferred.

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (يكلّم): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "هو". (الناس): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (في المهد): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يكلّم «[Note: The preposition and its genitive noun may not be attached to the verb يكلّم, because the meaning would be far-fetched.]». (الواو): conjunction. (كهلا): conjoined to the omitted ḥāl, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (من الصالحين): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the word كلمة — in the previous verse; the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, and this ḥāl is conjoined to (وجيها).
The clause «يكلّم الناس..» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause اسمه المسيح «[Note: In the previous verse; or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the word كلمة, since it has been qualified by the preposition and its genitive noun and by the clause.]».

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(قالت): past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي", i.e. Maryam.. and (التاء) is for the feminine. (ربّ): a vocative in construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb); the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which has been omitted for lightness, and the omitted yāʾ is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أنّى): an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), whose governor is the complete verb يكون «[Note: Or it is the khabar if the verb is incomplete.]». (يكون): a complete imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (اللام): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يكون) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl from ولد.]». (ولد): the fāʿil of يكون «[Note: Or its noun if it is incomplete.]», nominative. (الواو): of the ḥāl. (لم): jussive-governing negating particle. (يمسس): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); (النون) is the nūn of protection and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بشر): fāʿil, nominative. (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو". (الكاف): preposition, and (ذا) is a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "the matter is thus" «[Note: Or attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is يخلق, i.e. "Allah creates what He wills thus".]»; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (يخلق): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو". (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يشاء): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو". (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to the content of the apodosis. (قضى): past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa, and the fāʿil is "هو". (أمرا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (إنّما): the restraining [ما] and the restrained [إنّ], with no governing effect. (يقول): like يخلق. (له): like لي, attached to (يقول). (كن): a complete imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الفاء): conjunction, causal. (يكون): like the first.
The clause «قالت..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The vocative clause «ربّ» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.. or it, together with what is attached to it, is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يكون» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.. or it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «لم يمسسني بشر» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «(الأمر) كذلك» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «الله يخلق» is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from the clause (الأمر) كذلك.
The clause «يخلق ما يشاء» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «قضى أمرا» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّما يقول..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كن» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «يكون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو".
And the nominal clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يقول.

* Morphology:
(بشر): a primitive (jāmid) noun meaning a human being, male or female, singular and plural; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(قضى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is قضي: the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif.

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (يعلّم): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الكتاب): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الواو): conjunction in the three places. (الحكمة، التوراة، الإنجيل): words conjoined to الكتاب, accusative like it.
The clause «يعلّمه الكتاب» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause اسمه المسيح «[Note: In verse (45) of this sūra.]».

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (رسولا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "يجعله" «[Note: (رسولا) may be a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).. or conjoined to (الكتاب) in the previous verse, i.e. "and He will teach him a message".]». (إلى بني): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رسولا) because it is a derived adjective; the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, as it is assimilated to the masculine plural. (إسرائيل): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, as it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and foreign. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of أنّ. (قد): particle of realisation. (جئت): past verb with its fāʿil (agent), and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بآية): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil, i.e. "arguing with a sign". (من ربّ): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي قد جئتكم ...) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. "بأنّي قد جئتكم".. and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from (رسولا), i.e. "He will make him a messenger declaring: I have come to you".
(أنّي): like the first. (أخلق): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (اللام): preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أخلق). (من الطين): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخلق). (الكاف): preposition «[Note: Or a noun meaning "like", in the position of accusative as the naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "I create for you something like the form of a bird".]». (هيئة): genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted naʿt of the implied object, i.e. "I create something being like the form of a bird". (الطير): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي أخلق ...) is in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) from the previous interpreted maṣdar, or a badal from آية «[Note: Or in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي".]».
(الفاء): conjunction. (أنفخ): like أخلق. (في): preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أنفخ); the pronoun refers back to the implied object or to the form, i.e. the thing formed. (الفاء): conjunction. (يكون): an incomplete imperfect verb, nominative. (طيرا): khabar (predicate), accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: Some make it a ḥāl whose governor is the complete verb يكون.. and that is far-fetched.]». (بإذن): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (طيرا) «[Note: Whoever makes (يكون) complete permits attaching the preposition and its genitive noun to it.]». (الواو): conjunction. (أبرئ): like أخلق. (الأكمه): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (الأبرص): conjoined to الأكمه, accusative like it. (الواو): conjunction. (أحيي): like أخلق; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ. (الموتى): mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied on the alif. (بإذن الله): like the first, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (أحيي). (الواو): conjunction. (أنبئ): like أخلق, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الباء): preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (أنبّئكم). (تأكلون): imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الواو): conjunction. (ما تدّخرون): like ما تأكلون. (في بيوت): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تدّخرون), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (في): preposition, and (ذا) is a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of إنّ; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (اللام): the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), for emphasis. (آية): the noun of إنّ, accusative. (لكم): like the first, attached to an omitted naʿt of آية. (إن): jussive-governing conditional particle. (كنتم): an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (مؤمنين): the khabar of kāna, accusative; the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «(يجعله) رسولا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause يعلّمه in the previous verse.
The clause «جئتكم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «أخلق» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the second أنّ.
The clause «أنفخ» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أخلق.
The clause «يكون» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أنفخ.
The clause «أبرئ ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أخلق.
The clause «أحيي..» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أخلق.
The clause «أنبّئكم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أخلق.
The clause «تأكلون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «تدّخرون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إن كنتم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if you are believers, then these wonders are signs for you, beneficial and guiding".

* Morphology:
(هيئة): a maṣdar meaning "the thing formed", like الخلق meaning "the created"; or it is a noun for the state of a thing and not a maṣdar.
(الطير): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) whose singular is الطائر; or it is a generic noun (ism jins) by which one and more are meant (al-Baqara 260).
(الطين): a primitive (jāmid) noun of entity; the verb طان يطين, of the ضرب class, has been derived from it anomalously, meaning "to coat with clay". Its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.
(الأكمه): an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from كمه يكمه, of the فرح class, [meaning] he became blind; its pattern is أفعل.
(الأبرص): an assimilate adjective from برص يبرص, of the فرح class; its pattern is أفعل.
(تدّخرون): it contains ibdāl (letter substitution); its origin is تذتخرون: the tāʾ of the iftiʿāl form came after the dhāl, so it was changed into dāl; then the dhāl was changed into dāl and assimilated into the first dāl, so it became تدّخرون. Its pattern is تفتعلون.
(بيوتكم): plural of بيت, a primitive noun of entity; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (مصدّقا): conjoined to the position of آية, which is the accusative, because it is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "I have come to you with a sign from your Lord and confirming". (اللام): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, for strengthening. (ما): a relative noun in the position of genitive — this being the near position — and in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle مصدق. (بين): adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (يديّ): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (من التوراة): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the relative noun, its governor being (مصدّقا). (الواو): conjunction. (اللام): for causation. (أحلّ): imperfect verb, accusative by (أنّ) implied after the lām «[Translator's note: so in the text with shadda; the particle meant is أن.]», and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (اللام): preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أحلّ). (بعض): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الذي): a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (حرّم): past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (على): preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (حرّم).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أحلّ) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "أرسلت إليكم" or "جئتكم" «[Note: There are many views on the conjoining of this interpreted maṣdar and what it is attached to; the easiest of them and the nearest to the meaning is that we imply a conjoined-to element suiting the meaning, i.e. "to lighten [the burden] for you and to make lawful for you"..]». (الواو): conjunction. (جئتكم): past verb with its fāʿil and its object. (بآية): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, its implied form being "مدعوما" or "محمّلا". (من ربّ): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): conjunction, linking the effect to the cause «[Note: Or linking the apodosis of an implied condition.. and the clause after it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you believe that, then fear Allah".]». (اتّقوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (أطيعون): like اتّقوا.. the nūn is the nūn of protection, and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is the mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «أحلّ لكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «حرّم عليكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «جئتكم بآية» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause قد جئتكم in the previous verse, following it in position «[Note: The wāw may be made resumptive, the clause then having no grammatical position, as a resumption.]».
The clause «اتّقوا الله» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause جئتكم with a causal link.
The clause «أطيعون» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله.

* Benefits:
1- His saying, the Exalted, «وأطيعون»: we observe that the original is «وأطيعوني»; the yāʾ of the first person has been deleted after the nūn of protection out of regard for the verse-endings (fawāṣil) between the verses, and to realise the sound and rhythm that is one of the marks of the Qur'an and its inimitability. This feature occurs frequently in the Noble Qur'an, as in His saying, the Exalted, وَما أَدْراكَ ما هِيَهْ نارٌ حامِيَةٌ.
2- Regarding these miracles with which Allah distinguished the Lord Messiah, some scholars held that Allah supports His messengers with miracles suited to what the age of each prophet was famed for. Mūsā was supported by Allah with miracles that curbed the sorcerers, who held power and sway in his time; ʿĪsā came at the flourishing of medicine, so his miracles were a challenge to the physicians; and Muḥammad ﷺ came when eloquence, rhetoric and poetry had reached their peak among the Arabs, so Allah supported him with the Noble Qur'an, which challenged the Arabs to produce its like, or the like of a single sūra of it, in thought, eloquence and inimitability.

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (ربّ): the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the bāʾ because the place is occupied by the suited vowel, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction. (ربّكم): conjoined to ربّي, nominative like it.. and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (اعبدوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn..
the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (ها): particle of alerting. (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (صراط): khabar, nominative. (مستقيم): naʿt (adjective) of صراط, nominative like it.
The clause «إنّ الله ربّي» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اعبدوه» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition.. i.e. "if you want triumph and success, then worship Him".
The clause «هذا صراط» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, with the force of a causal clause.

safi-cedvel:129-129.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (الواو) conjunction. (ما في الأرض) like ما في السّموات and conjoined to it. (يغفر) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (اللام) a preposition. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (يغفر), (يشاء) like يغفر. (الواو) conjunction. (يعذّب من يشاء) like يغفر لمن يشاء, and من is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الواو) resumptive. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (غفور) khabar, nominative. (رحيم) second khabar, nominative.
The clause «لله ما في السّموات» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «يغفر ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يشاء (the first)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (من).
The clause «يعذّب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يغفر.
The clause «يشاء (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «الله غفور» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:130-130.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle. (أيّها) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative ... and ها is for alerting (tanbīh). (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as naʿt (adjective) of أي - according to the position - or badal (substitute) of it. (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (لا) prohibitive, causing the jussive. (تأكلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الرّبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (أضعافا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. (مضاعفة) naʿt of أضعاف, accusative like it. (الواو) conjunction. (اتّقوا) an imperative and its fāʿil. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope, and (كم) a pronoun, the ism (subject) of لعلّ. (تفلحون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause يأيّها الذين ... has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause آمنوا ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا تأكلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «اتّقوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تأكلوا.
The clause «لعلّكم تفلحون» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تفلحون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(مضاعفة), feminine of مضاعف, a passive participle from the quadriliteral ضاعف; its pattern is مفاعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Majāz mursal (non-metaphorical trope): in His saying, the Exalted: «يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تَأْكُلُوا الرِّبَوا».
The meaning of "do not eat usury" is: do not take usury. He expressed it with eating because it is caused by the taking; so the relation of the trope here is causedness (al-musabbabiyya).

* Benefits:
1- A historical note: in the Jāhiliyya, when the term of a debt fell due, the Arabs used to say: either you pay, or you increase (turbī). If he paid it, [well and good]; otherwise he increased it in time, and the other increased it in the amount of interest; and so on every year, so that perhaps a little would be multiplied until it became much, multiplied.
Islam fought every means that makes wealth circulate only among the rich: at one time by forbidding usury, at another by encouraging beneficence and charity, at another by forbidding hoarding (iḥtikār), and so on with the other means that are a cause of justice and of achieving equality among the members of society.

safi-cedvel:131-133.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (اتّقوا النار) like اتّقوا الله in the previous verse. (الّتى) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as naʿt (adjective) of النار. (أعدّت) a past verb, passive ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هي. (للكافرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعدّت), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «اتّقوا النّار» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تأكلوا الرّبا in the previous verse.
The clause «أعدّت ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (التي).
(الواو) conjunction. (أطيعوا الله) like اتّقوا الله «1», (الواو) conjunction. (الرّسول) conjoined to the Name of Majesty, accusative (manṣūb) like it. (لعلّكم ترحمون) like لعلّكم تفلحون «2», and the verb is passive ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «أطيعوا الله» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تأكلوا «3».
The clause «لعلّكم ترحمون» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «ترحمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.
(الواو) conjunction. (سارعوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (إلى مغفرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سارعوا), (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of مغفرة, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) conjunction. (جنّة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مغفرة, genitive (majrūr) like it. (عرض) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (السّموات) khabar, nominative, on the basis of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. the extent of the heavens or the breadth of the heavens. (الواو) conjunction. (الأرض) maʿṭūf to السموات, nominative like it. (أعدّت للمتّقين) like أعدّت للكافرين.
The clause «سارعوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تأكلوا [Note: in verse (130) of this sūra.].
The clause «عرضها السموات..» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt of جنّة.
The clause «أعدّت..» is in the position of the genitive as a second naʿt of جنّة [Note: or in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of جنّة, because it has been qualified ... or it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.].

* Morphology:
(عرضها) a noun, the opposite of length or its counterpart; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.. And see verse (21) of Sūrat al-Ḥadīd.

* Rhetoric:
1- This noble verse contains an art of great worth, which is pointedness (al-tankīt) in simile. Its definition is that the speaker deliberately mentions one thing rather than others that could take its place, for the sake of a subtle point. When it occurs in a simile it has reached the utmost. It is here in His saying, the Exalted, «عَرْضُهَا السَّماواتُ وَالْأَرْضُ», and what is meant is "like the breadth of the heavens and the earth". Breadth is the shorter of the two dimensions, and in mentioning it rather than length there is hyperbole; and He increased the hyperbole by deleting the particle of simile and implying the muḍāf.

* Benefits:
(و) of the plural: a wāw attached to the verb to indicate plurality. It is an attached pronoun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative, because it is either a fāʿil or a nāʾib fāʿil, as in: كتبوا، يكتبون.
اكتبوا. سارعوا. ضربوا. ينصرون.

safi-cedvel:134-134.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as naʿt (adjective) of المتّقين [Note: It may be the khabar (predicate) of an obligatorily omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هم, because it is a naʿt cut off for praise; or in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being أمدح (I praise).], (ينفقون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). And the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (في السرّاء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينفقون), on the basis of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. in the state of ease. (الضرّاء) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السرّاء by the conjunction, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الواو) conjunction. (الكاظمين) maʿṭūf to the relative noun, following it in either of the two cases, genitive or accusative, and the yāʾ is the sign for both. (الغيظ) mafʿūl bihi of the active participle الكاظمين, accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) conjunction. (العافين) maʿṭūf to الكاظمين - or to the relative noun - genitive or accusative. (عن النّاس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to العافين. (الواو) resumptive. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (المحسنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «ينفقون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «الله يحبّ ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يحبّ المحسنين» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ الله.

* Morphology:
(السرّاء), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning joy; the hamza is added for the feminine; its pattern is فعلاء, and the verb is سرّ يسرّ, of the class of نصر.
(الكاظمين), plural of الكاظم, an active participle from كظم يكظم, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فاعل.
(العافين), plural of العافي, an active participle from عفا يعفو, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فاعل. In the word there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change): its origin is العافو; the wāw came vowelless - the vowel being implied on it - with a kasra before it, so it was converted to yāʾ. In the word العافين there is another iʿlāl, which is the deletion of the weak letter because of the meeting of two vowelless letters: the sukūn of the weak letter yāʾ and the sukūn of the yāʾ that is the case sign.

safi-cedvel:135-135.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (الذين) conjoined to the relative noun in the previous verse, taking its position in the i'rab. (إذا) a conditional adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis ذكروا. (فعلوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (فاحشة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (أو) a conjunction. (ظلموا) like فعلوا. (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (ذكروا) like فعلوا. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء) conjunction. (استغفروا) like فعلوا. (لذنوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استغفروا), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi, a pronoun. (الواو) parenthetical or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (من) an interrogative noun in the meaning of negation, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (يغفر) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الذنوب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (إلا) a particle of restriction. (الله) the Name of Majesty, badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun in (يغفر), nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (لم) a particle of negation, of the jussive and of converting [the imperfect to past meaning]. (يصرّوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (على) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (يصرّوا), (فعلوا) like the first. (الواو) circumstantial. (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «the condition, its protasis and its apodosis» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «فعلوا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ظلموا..» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause فعلوا.
The clause «ذكروا..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «استغفروا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «من يغفر..» has no grammatical position, parenthetical [Note: or in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), because the interrogative has the meaning of negation, so the clause is declarative (khabariyya), not performative (inshāʾiyya).].
The clause «يغفر ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «لم يصرّوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause [Note: This clause may be a ḥāl of the wāw in (استغفروا), i.e.: they sought forgiveness without persisting.].
The clause «فعلوا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «هم يعلمون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.
The clause «يعلمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(فاحشة), feminine of الفاحش; likewise it has the meaning of الفحشاء (indecency)..
Its pattern is فاعلة.

safi-cedvel:196-197.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) the prohibitive lā, jussive-governing; (يغرّنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a jussive ... and the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (تقلّب) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma.. and the wāw is the agent; (في البلاد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقلّب); (متاع) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو", i.e. the moving about «[Note: It may be a mubtadaʾ — because it is qualified — with its khabar omitted, implied as تقلّبهم (their moving about).]»; (قليل) naʿt (adjective) of متاع, nominative like it; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (مأوى) mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (جهنّم) khabar, nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (بئس) a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (المهاد) the agent, nominative.. and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "هي", i.e. Jahannam.
The clause «لا يغرّنّك تقلّب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «(هو) متاع» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «مأواهم جهنّم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the causal clause.
The clause «بئس المهاد» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

safi-cedvel:198-198.t:
* I'rab:
(لكن) a particle of correction (istidrāk), with no governing action; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (اتّقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ربّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (جنّات) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ); (تجري من تحتها الأنهار) its i'rab has passed «[Note: in verse (196) of this sūra.]» «[Translator's note: the phrase was parsed under verse 195.]»; (خالدين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the hāʾ in (لهم), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (فيها) like لهم, attached to خالدين; (نزلا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "تنزلهم نزلا" (they are lodged as a hospitable lodging); (من عند) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (نزلا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) resumptive; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ; (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted [element], the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (خير) khabar, nominative; (للأبرار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير.
The clause «الذين اتّقوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اتّقوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لهم جنّات..» is in the position of a nominative: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «تجري ...» الأنهار is in the position of a nominative: naʿt of جنّات.
The clause «ما عند الله خير..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(نزلا) either a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning giving and bounty, its wazn being فعل with two ḍammas; or a noun for the food prepared for a guest; or a plural whose singular is نازل ...

safi-cedvel:199-199.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (من أهل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of inna; (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (لام) the lām of emphasis; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative, the postponed noun of inna; (يؤمن) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa", and it is the returning pronoun (al-ʿāʾid); (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمن); (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty; (أنزل) a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) a latent pronoun, implied as "huwa", and it is the returning pronoun; (إلى) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أنزل); (الواو) a conjunction; (ما أنزل إليهم) like ما أنزل إليكم; (خاشعين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), from the agent of يؤمن which refers to من, and it is plural out of regard for the meaning; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خاشعين; (لا) negative; (يشترون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the agent; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يشترون), by making it include the meaning of يستبدلون (they exchange); (ثمنا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (قليلا) naʿt (adjective), accusative; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (أجر) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ḥāl from أجرهم; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (سريع) khabar, nominative; (الحساب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «إن من أهل ... لمن» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يؤمن بالله» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «أنزل إليكم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the first relative noun (ما).
The clause «أنزل إليهم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «لا يشترون» is in the position of an accusative: a ḥāl from the agent of يؤمن.
The clause «أولئك لهم أجرهم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لهم أجرهم» is in the position of a nominative: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.
The clause «إنّ الله سريع ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, causal (taʿlīliyya).

safi-cedvel:200-200.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative, and (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, a badal (substitute) — or naʿt (adjective) — of أيّ according to its position; (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (اصبروا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ...
and the wāw is the agent; (الواو) a conjunction in the three places; (صابروا، رابطوا، اتّقوا) like اصبروا; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), governed by اتّقوا; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of laʿalla; (تفلحون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the agent.
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «اصبروا» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «صابروا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative.
The clause «رابطوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative.
The clause «لعلّكم تفلحون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تفلحون» is in the position of a nominative: the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla ...

* Benefits:
1- Excellence of the conclusion (ḥusn al-khitām): Allah, Glorified and Exalted, concludes this sūra with these verses, which contain a kind of fervent supplication whose like we hardly find except at the end of Sūrat al-Baqara; each of the two surahs ends with this kind of entreaty, accompanied by this captivating musical cadence: «رَبَّنا إِنَّنا سَمِعْنا مُنادِياً يُنادِي لِلْإِيمانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا..»
and the saying of the Exalted: «رَبَّنا وَآتِنا ما وَعَدْتَنا عَلى رُسُلِكَ وَلا تُخْزِنا يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعادَ». This excellence of conclusion is a phenomenon of many of the surahs of the Revelation, and one of the splendours of the Noble Qur'an: the reader finishes hearing the sūra with his soul, thought and taste filled with this captivating splendour, which combines in its context the splendour of the structure and the splendour of the meaning alike.
Excellence of the conclusion is one of the marvels of the Arabic language, and it may be a characteristic of expression among all peoples: through it some people rise and soar in the horizons of eloquence, and through its absence some people sink and utterly deform the eloquence of speech ...
