2- The style of fervent supplication and the idea of entreaty are the best with which the surahs of the Qur'an are concluded, especially the long ones, for they bequeath rest to hearts, tranquillity to souls, and contentment and submission to minds; and in this is the essence of happiness in life and of reassurance about what comes after death.

safi-cedvel:168-168.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) whose implied form is "they" (هم) «[Note: Or a badal (substitute) from (الذين) نافقوا - in the previous verse - or a naʿt (adjective) of it.]»; (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (لإخوان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قالوا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (قعدوا) like قالوا; (لو) a non-jussivizing conditional particle; (أطاعوا) like قالوا, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ما) negative; (قتلوا) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (قل) an imperative verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (ادرؤوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (عن أنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ادرؤوا), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الموت) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (ان) a jussivizing conditional particle; (كنتم) a deficient past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (لم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna «[Translator's note: so in the source (لم); (تم) is meant.]»; (صادقين) the khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) ... and the nominal clause (هم) الذين.. has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قعدوا» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.
The clause «أطاعونا» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb "to say" (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ما قتلوا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition.
The clause «قل..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ادرؤوا..» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you are truthful in your claim, then avert ... and the implied conditional clause is maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position, being explicative.. and the apodosis is omitted, what precedes indicating it..

* Benefits:
1- The saying of Allah the Exalted: «لَوْ أَطاعُونا ما قُتِلُوا»: لو comes in five kinds:
a- Diminution (taqlīl), as in the transmitted saying «تصدقوا ولو بظلف محرّق» ("Give in charity, even if only a burnt hoof"); it is a particle of diminution that has no apodosis.
b- For wishing (tamannī), as in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ». It too does not need an answer like the apodosis of a condition, but it may take an answer in the accusative like the answer of «ليت», i.e. with an imperfect verb in the accusative after the fāʾ of causation.
c- For offering (ʿarḍ), as in: لو تنزل عندنا فتصيب خيرا ("Would you not stay with us, so that you may find good?"); it has no answer, and the fāʾ after it is the fāʾ of causation, because an offer is a kind of request.
d- The maṣdar لو, which is synonymous with «أن»; it most often occurs after «ودّ», as in ودّوا لو تدهن فيدهنون, or after «يودّ», as in «يودّ أحدهم لو يعمّر ألف سنة».
e- The conditional لو, which is of two kinds:
1- That it makes something contingent on the future, and so is synonymous with the conditional «إن», as in the saying of Abū Ṣakhr al-Hudhalī:
ولو تلتقي أصداؤنا بعد موتنا ... ومن دون رمسينا من الأرض سبسب
لظلّ صدى صوتي وإن كنت رمّة ... لصوت صدى ليلى يهشّ ويطرب
(If our echoes were to meet after our death, with a wide stretch of land between our two graves, the echo of my voice, even though I were decayed bones, would still be cheered and moved by the sound of Laylā's echo.)
2- That it makes something contingent in the past, which is its most frequent use; this requires that its protasis be impossible because its apodosis is impossible, as in «وَلَوْ شِئْنا لَرَفَعْناهُ بِها».
Among the properties of the «conditional» لو is that it is specific to the verb; a noun governed by an omitted verb, which what follows explains, may follow it, as in the saying of the poet:
أخلاي لو غير الحمام أصابكم ... عتبت ولكن ما على الدهر معتب
(My friends, had something other than death befallen you, I would have reproached it; but there is no reproaching fate.)
and their saying in the proverb: «لو غير ذات سوار لطمتني» ("Had one other than a bracelet-wearer slapped me").
2- The apodosis of the conditional لو: it is either a past verb, or an imperfect verb negated with لم (i.e. past in meaning), as in: «لو لم يخف الله لم يطعه». In most cases it is joined to the lām, as in «لَوْ نَشاءُ لَجَعَلْناهُ حُطاماً», and it may come without it, as in «لو نشاء جعلناه أجاجا»; and its apodosis may be omitted, what in the speech indicates it being sufficient, as in «لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ آوِي إِلى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ».

safi-cedvel:169-169.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) the prohibitive, jussivizing lā; (تحسبنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت) ...
and (النون) is the heavy nūn of emphasis, with no grammatical position; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (قتلوا) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قتلوا) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil, i.e. proceeding in the way of Allah.]»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (أمواتا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (بل) for transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī), not a conjunction; (أحياء) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) whose implied form is "they" (هم); (عند) an indeclinable adverb, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحياء «[Note: Or it is attached to (يرزقون), or to an omitted second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.]»; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يرزقون) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative (marfūʿ).. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «لا تحسبنّ ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قتلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «(هم) أحياء» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يرزقون» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم «[Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in أحياء, the governor being the state of being a mubtadaʾ (al-ibtidāʾ), which is weak ... or in the position of nominative as a naʿt of أحياء.]».

* Rhetoric:
1- Ṭibāq (antithesis): between أموات and أحياء. As for the nominative, and making it a nominal clause, that is more eloquent in indicating permanence and the arising of remembrance and its renewal every day.

* Benefits:
1- «لا تَحْسَبَنَّ»: know that the nūn of emphasis with the imperfect verb has rulings, the most important of which are:
a- If the doubled nūn of emphasis comes after the alif pronoun, the alif remains and the nūn of the nominative is dropped, to avoid a succession of nūns; but the nūn of emphasis is given a kasra after it, likening it to the nūn of the nominative after the dual pronoun, as in «يكتبان».
b- If it comes after the wāw of the plural or the yāʾ of the feminine addressee, the nūn of the nominative is dropped to avoid a succession of identical letters. As for the wāw and the yāʾ: if the vowel of what precedes them is a fatḥa, they remain, and the wāw of the plural takes a ḍamma and the yāʾ of the addressee takes a kasra; so we say for «تخشون وترضين»: «تخشون» and «ترضين» «[Translator's note: the forms with the nūn of emphasis (تخشونّ، ترضينّ) appear in the source without their vowel marks.]». If what precedes the wāw has a ḍamma and what precedes the yāʾ has a kasra, they are dropped to avoid the meeting of two vowelless letters, and the vowel of what precedes them remains; so we say for «تكتبون وتكتبين وتغزون وتغزين»: «تكتبنّ وتكتبنّ وتغزنّ وتغزنّ».
c- If the doubled nūn of emphasis follows the nūn of the feminine plural, they must be separated by an alif, out of dislike for a succession of identical letters, namely the nūns, as in «يكتبنانّ». As for the light nūn, it does not attach to the nūn of the feminine plural.
Finally, all the rulings of the two nūns of emphasis with the imperfect verb are the same when they emphasise the imperative verb «[Translator's note: the source has فعل الأمن, a misprint for فعل الأمر "the imperative verb".]».
One point remains that deserves mention: the imperfect verb with a sound final letter to which the nūn of emphasis, whether heavy or light, is attached is indeclinable on the fatḥa in form while being nominative in position; likewise, when the nūn of the feminine plural is attached to it, it is indeclinable on the sukūn in form and nominative in position.

safi-cedvel:170-170.t:
* I'rab:
(فرحين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), of the pronoun in (يرزقون), or in أحياء «[Note: It is permissible - though weakly - for it to be accusative by way of praise (ʿalā al-madḥ).]», in the previous verse; (الباء) a preposition, and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فرحين; (آتى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (من فضل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آتاهم) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of the implied resumptive pronoun, i.e. with what He gave them, coming from His bounty.]»; (الواو) of the ḥāl «[Note: al-ʿUkbarī permitted it to be a conjunction conjoining the clause يستبشرون to the word فرحين, because the derived adjective resembles the imperfect verb, i.e. فرحين has the status of يفرحون.]»; (يستبشرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الباء) like the first one; (الذين) in the position of genitive, attached to (يستبشرون); (لم) a particle of negation, conversion (qalb) and jussivization; (يلحقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الباء) like the first one, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يلحقوا); (من خلف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil in (يلحقوا), i.e. being behind them or remaining behind them, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أن) lightened from the heavy (anna), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لا) negative, inoperative - or operating like ليس -; (خوف) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative «[Note: So it relies on a negation ... or it is the noun of the lā that operates like ليس..]»; (عليهم) like بهم, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يحزنون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause آتاهم الله ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause يستبشرون ... is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ whose implied form is "they" (هم) «[Note: And the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun of فرحين.. The mubtadaʾ (هم) was implied because the wāw of the ḥāl does not directly precede an affirmative imperfect verb.]».
The clause «لم يلحقوا بهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا خوف عليهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the lightened (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar أن (هـ).. is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. بأن لا خوف ..., and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to what the preposition (بالذين) is attached to.. or the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive as a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم يحزنون» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لا خوف عليهم.
The clause «يحزنون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(فرحين): plural of فرح, which is a resembling adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) derived from فرح يفرح, the fourth class; its pattern is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a kasra.

* Rhetoric:
- Murāʿāt al-naẓīr (congruity): a beautiful, splendid and marvellous art of embellishment, which some have called tanāsub and tawfīq (harmony and matching). Its definition is that the poet or prose writer brings together a thing and what is congruous with it, whether the congruity is in wording or meaning. Thus He, Glorified is He, matched فرحين with يستبشرون, the absence of fear with the absence of grief, and blessing with bounty.

safi-cedvel:171-171.t:
* I'rab:
(يستبشرون) like the one in the previous verse; (بنعمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يستبشرون); (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of نعمة; (الواو) conjunction; (فضل) conjoined to نعمة, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative (manṣūb); (لا) negative; (يضيع) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (أجر) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (المؤمنين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «يستبشرون..» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) ... «[Note: Or in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from the clause يستبشرون in the previous verse.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله لا يضيع ...) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to نعمة and attached to what it is attached to.
The clause «لا يضيع ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of anna.

safi-cedvel:91-91.t:
* I'rab:
(انّ الذين كفروا) its i'rab was given in the previous verse; (الواو) conjunction; (ماتوا) like كفروا; (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (كفّار) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), because it enters upon the khabar; (لن) a particle that makes the verb subjunctive; (يقبل) an imperfect verb, passive, subjunctive (manṣūb); (من أحد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقبل) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of (ملء الأرض ذهبا) — a naʿt (adjective) that preceded what it qualifies.]» and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ملء) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الأرض) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (ذهبا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (الواو) of the ḥāl; (لو) a particle of "impossibility because of impossibility" (imtināʿ li-mtināʿ) including the meaning of condition; (افتدى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (افتدى); (أولاء) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أليم) naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating, inoperative; (لهم) like the first, attached to a fronted khabar; (من) a redundant preposition, because it rests on the negation; (ناصرين) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «إنّ الذين كفروا..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ماتوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause كفروا.
The clause «هم كفّار» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «لن يقبل.. ملء» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of انّ.
The clause «افتدى به» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: فلن يقبل منه (it will not be accepted from him).
The clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لهم عذاب» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «ما لهم من ناصرين» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لهم عذاب.

* Morphology:
(ملء): a non-derived (jāmid) noun for what a vessel holds when it is full; the plural is أملاء with fatḥa on the hamza; its pattern is فعل with kasra on the first radical.
(افتدى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original form is افتدي with yāʾ: the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa and was changed to alif. Its pattern is افتعل.
(ناصرين): plural of ناصر, active participle of نصر ينصر, the first class; its pattern is فاعل (see verse 22 — Āl ʿImrān).

safi-cedvel:92-92.t:
* I'rab:
(لن) a particle of negation that makes the verb subjunctive; (تنالوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (البرّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (تنفقوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied أن after حتّى, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تنفقوا), and the referent pronoun is omitted; (تحبّون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تنفقوا) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (تنالوا).
(الواو) conjunction; (ما) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, mabnī, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi; (تنفقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من شيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ما «[Note: Or it is a tamyīz (specification) of (ما).]», (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, ism of إنّ, accusative; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (عليم); (عليم) khabar of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «لن تنالوا..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تنفقوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تحبّون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «ما تنفقوا..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «إنّ الله به عليم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.
Part Four
The remainder of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān
from verse 93 to verse 200

safi-cedvel:93-93.t:
* I'rab:
(كلّ) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (الطعام) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (كان) an incomplete past verb, and its ism is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (حلّا) khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb); (لبني) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حلّا), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (إسرائيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote; (إلا) a particle of exception; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the excepted; (حرّم) a past verb; (إسرائيل) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (على نفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حرّم), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حرّم); (أن) a maṣdar particle that makes the verb subjunctive; (تنزّل) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, passive; (للتوراة) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative. «[Translator's note: The source writes «(للتوراة)»; the parsed word is (التوراة).]»
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تنزّل التوراة) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being أنت; (الفاء) connecting an implied apodosis; (ائتوا) an imperative verb, mabnī on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بالتوراة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ائتوا); (الفاء) conjunction; (اتلوا) like ائتوا, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إن) a conditional particle making the verb jussive; (كنتم) an incomplete past verb, mabnī on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) a pronoun, ism of كان; (صادقين) khabar of كان, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «كلّ الطعام كان حلّا..» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying) of an implied verb «[Note: i.e. the Jews said: كلّ الطعام ...]».
The clause «كان حلّا..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ كلّ.
The clause «حرّم إسرائيل..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ائتوا ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, joined with the fāʾ «[Note: i.e.: إن كنتم صادقين بقولكم فأتوا بالتوراة فاتلوها ... (if you are truthful in your claim, then bring the Torah and recite it ...) and the clause of the implied condition is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.]».
The clause «اتلوها» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause ائتوا.
The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position: explicative.

* Morphology:
(حلّا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb حلّ يحلّ, of the ضرب class; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn; it is among the words used as descriptions, so it coincides in pattern with the ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective).

* Benefits:
1- كُلُّ الطَّعامِ كانَ حِلًّا لِبَنِي إِسْرائِيلَ.
The occasion of revelation of this verse was the obstinacy of the Jews and their disputing with the Prophet ﷺ. Among the questions the Jews put to the Messenger was their saying «Tell us about the food that Yaʿqūb forbade to himself»; so he told them that he had vowed that if Allah cured him of his illness he would forbid himself the food most desirable to him, and the meat of camels and their milk was what was meant; so he forbade that to himself before the revelation of the Torah to Mūsā, peace be upon him.
2- «أن تنزّل»: أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by its annexation to the adverb «قبل»; «قبل» is the muḍāf and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by annexation.

safi-cedvel:94-94.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (من) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (افترى) a past verb, mabnī on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (افترى); (الكذب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى) «[Note: Abū al-Baqāʾ allowed it to be attached to الكذب, i.e. the lie occurring after that.]», (ذا) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أولاء) a demonstrative, mabnī on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (هم) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: It may be a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is الظالمون, and the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.]» with no grammatical position; (الظالمون) khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «من افترى ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause قل in the previous verse «[Note: Or it is resumptive, not conjoined.]».
The clause «افترى ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «أولئك ...» الظالمون is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(افترى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original form is افتري with yāʾ: the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa and was changed to alif; its pattern is افتعل.

safi-cedvel:95-95.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت, the address being directed to the Messenger ﷺ; (صدق) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) conjunction, linking the effect to the cause; (اتّبعوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ملّة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (إبراهيم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (حنيفا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of إبراهيم, accusative «[Note: Or a ḥāl of ملّة, which has the meaning of "religion".]», (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (كان) an incomplete past verb, and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو; (من المشركين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «صدق الله» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «اتّبعوا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause صدق الله «[Note: It may be the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. فان أردتم رضاء الله فاتّبعوا ملّة إبراهيم (if you desire the pleasure of Allah, then follow the religion of Ibrāhīm).]».
The clause «ما كان من المشركين» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl (حنيفا).

safi-cedvel:96-96.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (أول) ism of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (وضع) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وضع) «[Note: This is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān; it may also be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil, i.e. it was set up as a place of worship for people.]» (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ «[Note: What permitted the khabar to come as a definite relative noun is that the ism came indefinite, in annexation, and described by the clause ...]», (ببكّة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, being a diptote; (مباركا) a ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil, accusative «[Note: The nāʾib fāʿil belongs to an implied verb, not the verb mentioned, so that no extraneous element — namely the khabar of أنّ — separates the ḥāl from the one it describes; and it is possible that what governs the ḥāl is what governs (ببكة), i.e. "it is settled" or "it exists" in the state of its blessedness.]», (هدى) conjoined by the wāw to the ḥāl, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (للعالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to هدى, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun).
«[Translator's note: The source does not parse (بيت), which is muḍāf ilayhi of أول.]»
The clause «إنّ أول بيت ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «وضع للناس» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of أول.. or in the position of genitive as a naʿt of بيت.

* Morphology:
(بكّة): a non-derived (jāmid) noun; the bāʾ is changed from a mīm, as a dialectal variant of it; and it was said it was named بكة because it crushes (تبكّ) the necks of tyrants, i.e. breaks them; and the verb بكّ يبكّ is of the نصر class.
(مباركا): passive participle of the four-letter بارك; its pattern is مفاعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the second radical.

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الدين) the noun of إنّ, accusative; (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of الدين, i.e.: the religion established, or approved, with Allah; or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الدين, the governing element in it being the meaning of emphasis; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الإسلام) khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negative; (اختلف) a past verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative as fāʿil (agent); (أوتوا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اختلف); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (جاء) a past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (العلم) fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءهم العلم) is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(بغيا) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative «[Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl.]»; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (بغيا) or to an omitted naʿt of it, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive — or conjunction —; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يكفر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يكفر); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّ الله) like إنّ الدين; (سريع) khabar of إنّ, nominative; (الحساب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «إنّ الدين ... الإسلام» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «ما اختلف الذين ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أوتوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «جاءهم العلم» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «من يكفر ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive or conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يكفر بآيات الله» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis to be the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).]».
The clause «إنّ الله سريع» has no grammatical position; it gives the reason for the omitted apodosis, i.e.: then Allah will call him to account, because He is swift in reckoning.

* Morphology:
(الإسلام): the noun from أسلم الرجل, i.e. he took Islam as his way and religion; it is in the form of the maṣdar, its wazn being إفعال, with kasra on the hamza, regularly.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَمَا اخْتَلَفَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ»: expressing them by the relative noun and making the giving of the Book its ṣila is to increase the ugliness of their state, for disagreement on the part of one who has been given what removes it and cuts it off at the root is the utmost of ugliness and repugnance.
2- «فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسابِ»: in making the Majestic Name overt there is a nurturing of reverence and an instilling of awe; and in making the punishment follow upon disbelief in general, right after explaining the state of those mentioned, there is an intimation of the severity of their punishment.

safi-cedvel:20-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (حاجّوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of a jussive, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قل) an imperative verb, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; (أسلمت) a past verb and its agent; (وجه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the hāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أسلمت); (الواو) conjunction; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the pronoun in (أسلمت) «[Note: The conjoining came without a detached pronoun because of the presence of a separating element between the conjoined and what it is conjoined to. Abū Ḥayyān rejected this i'rab, as he rejected making the wāw one of accompaniment (maʿiyya) and (من) a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), which al-Zamakhsharī held. It is also permissible to make (من) a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "and those who follow me have submitted their faces to Allah", or "has submitted his face to Allah"; Abū Ḥayyān chose this.]»; (اتبع) a past verb, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring back to من, and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); and (النون) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the deleted (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) resumptive; (قل) like the first; (اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of a genitive, attached to (قل); (أوتوا الكتاب) its i'rab was given in the preceding ayah; (الأميّين) maʿṭūf to the relative noun by the wāw, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الهمزة) for interrogation indicating a command; (أسلمتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and تم a pronoun, fāʿil; (الفاء) resumptive; (إن أسلموا) like إن حاجّوا; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (اهتدوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, having no position, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (إن تولّوا) like إن حاجّوا, and the indeclinability in (تولّوا) is like the indeclinability in (اهتدوا); (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (إنّما) a restraining particle and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (على) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (البلاغ) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الواو) resumptive; (الله بصير بالعباد) its i'rab has been given before «[Note: in ayah (15) of this sūra.]».
The clause «إن حاجّوك» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause in the preceding ayah «[Note: It is permissible for it to be resumptive without conjunction.]».
The clause «قل ...» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «أسلمت وجهي ...» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اتّبعن» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «قل (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «أوتوا الكتاب» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أأسلمتم» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «أسلموا» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «قد اهتدوا» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن تولّوا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إن أسلموا.
The clause «عليك البلاغ» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «الله بصير ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(اتّبعن): the yāʾ of the first person is deleted from some words in the Noble Qur'an, especially after the nūn of protection, either in continuous recitation (waṣl) or in both continuous recitation and pausing (waqf). Nāfiʿ and Abū ʿAmr [Translator's note: the source has أبو عمر, evidently Abū ʿAmr] read the ayah retaining the yāʾ in continuous recitation and deleting it in pausing.
(الأميّين): plural of الأميّ, who is one who neither reads nor writes. It is stated in al-Muḥīṭ: «الأميّ and الأمان [Translator's note: so in the source], with a doubled mīm: one who does not write, or one who is in the natural state of the أمة «[Note: He means the mother (الأم), because الأمة is the mother.]» and has not learned writing».
(البلاغ): a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the quadriliteral verb بلّغ, whose regular maṣdar is تبليغ; the wazn of البلاغ is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- Synecdoche (al-majāz al-mursal): in His words «فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِيَ», i.e. I have made my soul, my heart and my whole self sincere; it was expressed by "the face" only because it is the noblest of the outward organs, the seat of the faculties and senses, and the place where most of what worship is performed by comes together — prostration and recitation — and through it one turns toward everything. The relation here is wholeness (kulliyya).
2- Interrogation: in His words «أَأَسْلَمْتُمْ», its meaning is reproach and reviling, i.e. have you then submitted and acted upon the clear proofs that came to you, or are you still in your disbelief? — as one says who has summarized a matter for his companion and has left no path of clarification and explanation untrodden: "So have you understood it?" — after the manner of His words, the Exalted, «فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُنْتَهُونَ», following the detailing of the deterrents from wine and gambling. In it there is a charge of their falling short, a reproach of them with obstinacy and lack of fairness, and a rebuke of them for dullness.

* Benefits:
1- «فَإِنَّما عَلَيْكَ الْبَلاغُ»: the preposition and its genitive noun were placed before the mubtadaʾ because it is the point of concern on the one hand, and so that the expression may take its musical cadence on the other; both are among the characteristics of eloquence and of the inimitability of the Qur'an.
2- «اهتدوا وتولّوا»: we notice that the weak letter, which is the yāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source], has been deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, which are the weak letter of the verb and the wāw of the plural. Whether the weak verb is past or imperfect, the weak letter is deleted when it meets the wāw of the plural. To distinguish between the wāw which is a weak letter and part of the root of the verb and the wāw which is the wāw of the plural, the grammarians agreed on adding an alif, called the alif of distinction (alif al-tafrīq); an example of that is أحمد يغزو and والمنافقون لم يغزوا. This aspect of writing is one of the pitfalls of spelling, since many confuse the two examples and put the alif of distinction on the verb يغزو and يعلو, contrary to the rule.

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الذين) a relative noun, the noun of إنّ, in the position of an accusative; (يكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يكفرون); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (يقتلون) like يكفرون; (النبيّين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (بغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, an emphatic ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of يقتلون; (حقّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (يقتلون) like يكفرون; (الذين) like the first, and it is mafʿūl bihi; (يأمرون) like يكفرون; (بالقسط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأمرون); (من الناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the wāw in the verb يأمرون; (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), because the relative noun contains the meaning of condition; (بشّر) an imperative verb, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت", and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بعذاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بشّرهم); (أليم) naʿt (adjective) of عذاب, genitive like it.
The clause «إنّ الذين يكفرون ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يكفرون بآيات الله» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يقتلون ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يقتلون (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يأمرون ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «بشّرهم» is in the position of a nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(النبيّين): plural of النبيّ, on the wazn فعيل, a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from the quadriliteral verb نبّأ, irregularly; the hamza may be lightened so that it becomes a yāʾ — as it came in this ayah — or the hamza may remain as it is, so that it is pronounced النبيء.

* Rhetoric:
1- The dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya): in His words, the Exalted, «فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذابٍ أَلِيمٍ». The use of "good tidings" here is figurative, intended as sarcasm; the meaning is "warn them of a painful punishment", because one is not given good tidings of punishment. So He borrowed "giving good tidings" for warning, after treating opposition as though it were congruity, by way of sarcasm. Therefore the expression with the word بشرهم is more eloquent, because it stings and pains more than the literal word أنذرهم.
2- We often find the fāʾ linking the apodosis coming after the occurrence of a relative noun; in such a case the relative noun may contain the meaning of a conditional noun or bear some connection to it, as in His words, the Exalted: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ ... up to His words فبشرهم; so the fāʾ here links the apodosis.

safi-cedvel:136-136.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address. (جزاء) second mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (مغفرة) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ جزاء. (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مغفرة, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (جنّات) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مغفرة, nominative like it. (تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma. (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الأنهار) fāʿil (agent), nominative, (خالدين) ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (جزاؤهم), because it is the object in meaning; the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ. (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to خالدين. (الواو) resumptive. (نعم) an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise. (أجر) fāʿil of نعم, nominative. (العاملين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being الجنّة (Paradise).
The clause «أولئك جزاؤهم..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جزاؤهم مغفرة» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.
The clause «تجري ...» الأنهار is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of جنّات.
The clause «نعم أجرّ العاملين» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(العاملين), plural of العامل, an active participle from عمل يعمل, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:137-137.t:
* I'rab:
(قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (خلت) a past verb.. and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلت), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (سنن) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (سيروا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سيروا), (الفاء) conjunction. (انظروا) like سيروا. (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a fronted khabar (predicate). (كان) a defective past verb. (عاقبة) the ism (subject) of kāna, nominative. (المكذّبين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «خلت سنن..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «سيروا..» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن شككتم فسيروا (if you doubt, then travel).
The clause «انظروا..» is conjoined to the clause سيروا..
The clause «كان عاقبة المكذّبين» is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb انظروا, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative (كيف); and this object is restricted by the preposition [Note: i.e. the meaning of the preposition is taken into account in it, because you say: فكّرت فيه (I thought about it), سألت عنه (I asked about it) and نظرت فيه (I looked into it).. (see the i'rab of clauses in al-Mughnī of Ibn Hishām..).].

* Morphology:
(سنن), plural of سنّة, meaning way and custom, from the verb سنّ يسنّ, of the class of نصر. It is a noun on the pattern فعلة with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(عاقبة), feminine of عاقب, in the form of an active participle and the meaning of a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. recompense. Its pattern is فاعل, from عقب يعقب, of the class of نصر and the class of ضرب; it is an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb, and there are other maṣdars: عقب with fatḥa then sukūn, and عقوبة with ḍamma on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- The command to travel and look, even though it is specific to the believers, acting according to it is not restricted to one person rather than another; so in it there is also an inducement for the deniers to look at the outcomes of the deniers before them and take heed. This is of the type of majāz (figurative usage), and the relation in this trope is what the matter of travelling in the land leads to.

safi-cedvel:138-138.t:
* I'rab:
(ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (بيان) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بيان [Note: or attached to بيان, since it is a maṣdar (verbal noun).], (الواو) conjunction in both places. (هدى، موعظة) both conjoined to بيان, nominative like it, and the sign of the nominative in هدى is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (للمتّقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هدى) or to موعظة, since both are maṣdars.
The clause ... has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(بيان) an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb بان يبين, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ. There are other maṣdars: تبيان with fatḥa and with kasra on the tāʾ.

safi-cedvel:139-139.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (لا) prohibitive, causing the jussive. (تهنوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الواو) conjunction. (لا تحزنوا) like لا تهنوا. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الأعلون) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (إن) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (كنتم) a defective past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and (تم) is a pronoun, the ism (subject) of kāna. (مؤمنين) khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «لا تهنوا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا تحزنوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أنتم الأعلون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position, resumptive ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: فلا تهنوا ولا تحزنوا (then do not weaken and do not grieve) ...

* Morphology:
(تهنوا), in it there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion. Its origin is توهنوا; the deletion in it followed the course of وجد and وصل in the imperfect. Its pattern is تعلوا.
(الأعلون), in it there is iʿlāl by deletion: the weak letter alif was deleted because it came vowelless before the vowelless wāw; then the letter before the wāw was given a fatḥa as an indication of the deleted alif. Its pattern is الأفعون with fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:140-140.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (يمسس) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (قرح) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (مسّ) a past verb. (القوم) a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (قرح) fāʿil, nominative. (مثل) naʿt (adjective) of قرح, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) resumptive. (تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (الأيام) badal (substitute) of تلك, following it in the nominative. (نداول) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being نحن, for majesty, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نداول), (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) causal (li-l-taʿlīl). (يعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) concealed after the lām. (الله) fāʿil, nominative. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلم الله) is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, attached to (نداولها); and this preposition-phrase is conjoined to an implied preposition-phrase, i.e.: ليتّعظوا وليعلم الله (so that they take admonition, and so that Allah may know) ...
(الواو) conjunction. (يتّخذ) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to the verb يعلم, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يتّخذ) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شهداء - a naʿt placed before what it qualifies -], (شهداء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) parenthetical. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (لا) negative. (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الظالمين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «يمسسكم قرح» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قد مسّ القوم قرح» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ [Note: Abū Ḥayyān said in al-Baḥr: «The apodosis is omitted, its implied form being فتأسّوا فقد مسّ.. (then take consolation, for [a wound] has touched..), because what is past in meaning cannot be the apodosis of a condition; whoever claims that the apodosis is فقد مسّ.. is inattentive.» End quote. This objection has no justification, because the clause is joined with the fāʾ and the verb is preceded by قد, which brings it close to the present, which is near to the future.].
The clause «تلك الأيام نداولها» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «نداولها ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ تلك [Note: Some permit the clause to be a ḥāl, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ being the word الأيام.].
The clause «يعلم الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يتّخذ ...» "is in the position [of]" [Translator's note: thus in the source, «في محلّ لها», evidently for «لا محلّ لها», "has no grammatical position"], conjoined to the clause يعلم.
The clause «الله لا يحبّ الظالمين» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «لا يحبّ الظالمين» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

* Morphology:
(قرح), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb قرحته أقرحه, of the class of فرح [Translator's note: thus in the source]; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- وَتِلْكَ الْأَيَّامُ نُداوِلُها بَيْنَ النَّاسِ.
Some permitted parsing «الأيام» as the khabar of the demonstrative «تلك», which is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. The error in this direction is clear, because a noun made definite by «ال» after a demonstrative is parsed only as ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) or badal. On that Ibn Mālik says:
وكل اسم معرّف بأل ... بعد اسم إشارة فعطف أو بدل
(Every noun made definite by al- ... after a demonstrative is an apposition or a substitute.)
In this verse, parsing الأيام as a badal is the clear and correct view, and in it the meaning flows and is clear.

safi-cedvel:141-141.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (ليمحّص ... آمنوا) like ليعلم الله الذين آمنوا in the previous verse.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يمحص الله) is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what ليعلم in the previous verse is attached to, for it is conjoined to it.
(الواو) conjunction. (يمحق) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to يمحّص, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الكافرين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «يمحّص الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يمحق ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يمحّص.

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): resumptive. (لمّا): an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال). (أحسّ): past verb. (عيسى): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the alif. (من): preposition, and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الكفر), which is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (قال): like أحسّ, and the fāʿil is "هو". (من): an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أنصار): khabar (predicate), nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the rāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (إلى الله): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the first-person pronoun in أنصاري, i.e. "taking refuge in Allah". (قال): like أحسّ. (الحواريّون): fāʿil, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (نحن): a detached pronoun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (أنصار): khabar, nominative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. (آمنّا): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (بالله): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنّا). (الواو): conjunction. (اشهد): imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الباء): preposition. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of أنّ. (مسلمون): khabar, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّا مسلمون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (اشهد).
The clause «أحسّ عيسى..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «من أنصاري..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قال الحواريّون» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «نحن أنصار الله» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «آمنّا بالله» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from أنصار «[Note: That is with قد implied; it may also be in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the pronoun نحن.]».
The clause «اشهد» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause نحن أنصار.

* Morphology:
(أنصار): plural of نصير, on the measure of شريف; it is a derived adjective, an intensive form of the active participle, from the transitive نصر ينصر, of the نصر class.
(الحواريّون): plural of الحواريّ; the final yāʾ is for relation (nisba). The word is derived from الحور, which is whiteness, for the disciples used to bleach clothes. It has been said it is from حار يحور, i.e. to return, as though they were those returning to Allah; and it has been said it is derived from the whiteness of the face and heart, and their clarity and purity.

* Rhetoric:
- «فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ عِيسى مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ»: the basic sense of الإحساس is perception by one of the five outward senses; it has been borrowed by a dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya) for knowledge without doubt. It has been said: it is a majāz mursal (metonymic trope) for that, of the type of mentioning the antecedent and intending the consequent. The motive for that is that unbelief is not something that is perceived by the senses.

* Benefits:
- The temporal لما (lammā al-ḥīniyya): it is the adverbial one; it is specific to the past, and its apodosis is a past verb, e.g. «فَلَمَّا نَجَّاكُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ», or a nominal clause joined with «the إذا of surprise», e.g. «فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ», or with the fāʾ, e.g. «فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ». Its apodosis may be omitted.
Sībawayh said: the most wondrous of words is «لما»: if it enters upon the past it is an adverb, if it enters upon the imperfect it is a particle, and otherwise it means «إلّا».

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّنا): a vocative in construct (munādā muḍāf) from which the vocative particle has been omitted.. and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (آمنّا): past verb with its fāʿil (agent). (الباء): preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنا). (أنزلت): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (التاء) is the fāʿil. (الواو): conjunction. (اتّبعنا): like آمنّا. (الرسول): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied condition. (اكتبنا): imperative verb..
(نا) is an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (مع): adverb of place, accusative, attached to (اكتبنا). (الشاهدين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The vocative clause «ربّنا» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, imploring mercy.
The clause «آمنّا» is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from the clause آمنّا in the previous verse, taking its grammatical position.
The clause «أنزلت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «اتّبعنا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause آمنّا بما أنزلت.
The clause «اكتبنا» is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if our saying is true, then write us down"..

* Morphology:
(الشاهدين): plural of الشاهد, active participle from شهد يشهد, of the فرح class; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (مكروا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الواو): resumptive. (مكر): past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو): resumptive. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (خير): khabar (predicate), nominative. (الماكرين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The three clauses: have no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الماكرين): plural of الماكر, active participle from مكر يمكر, of the نصر class; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of mushākala (verbal correspondence), which is mentioning a thing with the word for something else because it occurs in its company. Mushākala has occurred in His saying, the Exalted, وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ. Scheming, inasmuch as it is basically a stratagem by which one draws another into harm, cannot be attributed to Him, glory be to Him, except by way of mushākala.

* Benefits:
1- «وَمَكَرُوا وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ»: this is the mushākala to which we drew attention earlier. Let the reader know that Allah does not scheme; rather the style runs in correspondence with the style the unbelievers adopted.

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
(إذ): an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". (قال): past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (يا): vocative particle. (عيسى): a vocative of a single proper name (munādā mufrad ʿalam), indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif, in the position of accusative. (انّ): a particle resembling the verb. (الياء): a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (متوفّي): the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction. (رافعك): like متوفّيك, by conjunction to it. (إلى): preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رافع. (الواو): conjunction. (مطهّرك): like متوفّيك, by conjunction to it. (من): preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to مطهّر. (كفروا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الواو): conjunction «[Note: The wāw may be resumptive, with the address directed to the Prophet ﷺ, and (جاعل) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "أنا"; on this view the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.]». (جاعل): conjoined to متوفّيك, nominative like it. (الذين): in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (اتّبعوا): like كفروا, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (فوق): adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of جاعل. (الذين): like the previous. (كفروا): like the first. (إلى يوم): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاعل. (ثمّ): conjunction. (إليّ): like the first, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (مرجع): postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): conjunction. (أحكم): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (بين): adverb of place, accusative, attached to (أحكم), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (في): preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أحكم). (كنتم): an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of kāna, in the position of nominative. (في): preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تختلفون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال الله ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يا عيسى» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّي متوفّيك» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «كفروا (the first)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (الذين).
The clause «اتّبعوك» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «كفروا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative (الذين).
The clause «إليّ مرجعكم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause إنّي متوفّيك.
The clause «أحكم بينكم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause إليّ مرجعكم.
The clause «كنتم..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تختلفون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(متوفّي): active participle from توفّاه الله; its pattern is متفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.
(رافع): active participle from رفع; its pattern is فاعل.
(مطهّر): active participle from the quadriliteral طهّر; its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.
(مرجع): a noun of place or time from رجع on the pattern مفعل with kasra on the ʿayn, because its ʿayn in the imperfect has kasra, so it is of the ضرب class. The word may also properly be a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رجع, used in that sense in the verse.

* Rhetoric:
1- Ibn Abī Ḥātim reported from Qatāda, who said: This is a case of what is placed earlier and what is placed later, i.e. "raising you to Me and taking you in death". This is one of the interpretations required by the apparent sense of the verse conflicting with what is well known and stated explicitly in the verse.
The second of them: that what is meant is "fulfilling your term and causing you to die a natural death; I will not give power over you to anyone who would kill you", so the speech is a kināya (metonymy) for his protection from enemies.
The third of them: that what is meant by death here is sleep, because the two are brothers, and each of them is applied to the other.

safi-cedvel:56-56.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): of ramification (tafrīʿiyya), conjunction. (أمّا): a particle of condition and detailing. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (كفروا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (أعذّب): imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا", and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (عذابا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb). (شديدا): naʿt (adjective) of (عذابا), accusative like it. (في الدنيا): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اعذّب); the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (الآخرة): conjoined to الدنيا, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): negating, inoperative. (اللام): preposition, and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (من): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (ناصرين): genitive in form, nominative in position, as postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «الذين كفروا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أحكم in the previous [verse].
The clause «أعذّبهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ما لهم من ناصرين» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أعذّبهم.

safi-cedvel:57-57.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (أمّا الذين آمنوا): like أمّا الذين كفروا in the previous verse. (الواو): conjunction. (عملوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الصالحات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (الفاء): linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (يوفّي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma; (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (أجور): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): resumptive. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (لا): negating. (يحبّ): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الظالمين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «الذين آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الذين كفروا in the previous verse.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «عملوا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يوفّيهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «الله لا يحبّ..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا يحبّ الظالمين» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

* Benefits:
1- أمّا: it is a particle that always carries the sense of condition and emphasis, and usually that of detailing. The first is shown by the necessity of the fāʾ after it, e.g. «فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ. وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَيَقُولُونَ ماذا أَرادَ اللَّهُ بِهذا مَثَلًا».
The second is shown by the fact that when you intend to emphasise «زيد ذاهب» (Zayd is going) you say: أمّا زيد فذاهب, i.e. he is going without doubt. Detailing is shown by surveying its occurrences, e.g. «أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكانَتْ لِمَساكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ، وَأَمَّا الْغُلامُ.. وَأَمَّا الْجِدارُ», and likewise «فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلا تَقْهَرْ وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلا تَنْهَرْ».

safi-cedvel:58-58.t:
* I'rab:
(ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "الأمر كذلك", and the clause نتلوه is a ḥāl (circumstantial).]»; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (نتلو): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma; (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". (على): preposition, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نتلوه). (من الآيات): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the third-person pronoun in (نتلوه) «[Note: Or attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك, the clause نتلوه being a ḥāl.]». (الذكر): conjoined by the wāw to الآيات, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الحكيم): naʿt (adjective) of الذكر, genitive like it.
The clause «ذلك نتلوه» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «نتلوه» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك).

* Morphology:
(الذكر): maṣdar (verbal noun) of ذكر يذكر, of the نصر class; but it is used here as a primitive (jāmid) noun, since it means the Noble Qur'an.
(الحكيم): a derived adjective; its pattern is فعيل with the meaning of the passive, i.e. المحكم (with fatḥa on the kāf) (see al-Baqara 32).

safi-cedvel:59-59.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (مثل): the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (عيسى): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra. (عند): adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from مثل. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (كمثل): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ. (آدم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, because it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and foreign. (خلق): past verb; (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من تراب): preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلق). (ثمّ): conjunction. (قال): like خلق. (اللام): preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (قال). (كن فيكون): its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (118) of Sūrat al-Baqara and in verse (47) of this sūra.]».
The clause «إنّ مثل عيسى..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خلقه..» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) «[Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from آدم, with قد implied. Abū Ḥayyān, moreover, made it an explanation of the meaning of "مثل آدم".]».
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause خلقه.
The clause «كن» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يكون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو", and the nominal clause is conjoined to the clause يقول «[Translator's note: so in the text, apparently carried over from verse 47; the verb in this verse is قال.]».

* Benefits:
- «إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ آدَمَ»:
This verse was revealed in the ninth year of the Hijra, «the Year of Delegations». The delegation of Najrān came to him; he offered them Islam but they did not accept it, and they asked him his view of the Messiah, so Allah revealed this verse to him. When they disputed with the Messenger and argued with him at length, he called them to «mutual imprecation (al-mulāʿana)». They consulted among themselves, and Allah cast terror into their hearts, so they dreaded the consequence of the imprecation and asked the Messenger of Allah to excuse them from it. Then they proposed to the Messenger ﷺ that he send with them a trustworthy man to judge between them in what they disagreed about. «فأشر أبت» «[Translator's note: so printed; evidently فاشرأبّت "craned/longed"]» the soul of ʿUmar to be the trustworthy one, but the Messenger ﷺ called Abū ʿUbayda and sent him with the people to judge between them; and from then on Abū ʿUbayda became the trustworthy one (amīn) of this Umma, may Allah be pleased with them all.

safi-cedvel:172-172.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) whose implied form is "they" (هم) «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause «للذين أحسنوا منهم أجر....», and it is permissible for it to be a naʿt (adjective) of المؤمنين in the previous verse.]»; (استجابوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) a preposition and its genitive noun «[Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is لله.]», attached to (mutaʿalliq) (استجابوا); (الواو) conjunction; (الرسول) conjoined to the Name of Majesty, genitive like it; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استجابوا); (ما) a maṣdar particle; (أصاب) a past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (القرح) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أصابهم القرح) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (أحسنوا) like استجابوا; (من) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (أحسنوا); (الواو) conjunction; (اتّقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, which was dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (أجر) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عظيم) a naʿt of أجر, nominative like it.
The clause «استجابوا لله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أصابهم القرح» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the maṣdar relative particle (ما).
The clause «أحسنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «اتّقوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أحسنوا.
The nominal clause «للذين أحسنوا.. أجر» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Benefits:
1- The wise commander.
Scarcely had the dawn of the second day after the battle of Uḥud broken when the caller of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ summoned the believers to prepare to set out in pursuit of the polytheists, and he restricted this to those who had been present at the battle the day before. The Messenger of Allah went out with the army until he reached Ḥamrāʾ al-Asad, eight miles from Medina in the direction of Mecca, and stayed there three days, challenging the army of the polytheists. As for the disbelievers, Allah cast terror into their hearts, and they thought that reinforcements had come to the Muslims, so they did not stop for anything until they reached Mecca. One result of that was that the Messenger of Allah established the awe of the Muslims in the hearts of their enemies, among the Bedouin and the polytheists outside Medina and among the Jews and the hypocrites inside it, and raised the morale of the believers; they returned from this expedition unharmed, since none of the polytheists confronted them.

safi-cedvel:173-173.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is "I praise" (أمدح) «[Note: Some permitted it to be a badal (substitute) from الذين استجابوا, but those are other than these:
