those who responded are the people of Uḥud, while those to whom the people said it are some of the believers or all of them.]»; (قال) a past verb; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال); (الناس) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الناس) the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (جمعوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (لكم) like لهم, attached to (جمعوا); (الفاء) conjunction, linking the cause to the effect; (اخشوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الفاء) conjunction; (زاد) like قال, and (هم) mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو), referring to the warning understood from the context of the verse; (إيمانا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (قالوا) like جمعوا; (حسب) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of genitive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate), nominative, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. Allah's help; (الواو) conjunction - or resumptive -; (نعم) an inert (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; (الوكيل) fāʿil, nominative; and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being "Allah".
The clause «قال لهم الناس» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الناس قد جمعوا..» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb "to say" (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «جمعوا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «اخشوهم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause جمعوا «[Note: Conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) clause to an informative (khabar) one is permissible here because of the causal link.]».
The clause «زادهم..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause قال ...
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause زادهم ...
The clause «حسبنا الله» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «نعم الوكيل» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause حسبنا الله ... or has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الوكيل): a resembling adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from وكل يكل, of the ḍaraba class (bāb ḍaraba); its pattern is فعيل.
(حسبنا): a maṣdar (verbal noun) with the meaning of an active participle, i.e. محسبنا - with a ḍamma on the mīm and a kasra on the sīn - i.e. "sufficing us". The pattern of حسب is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn (and see verse 206 of Sūrat al-Baqara).

* Rhetoric:
- General and particular (al-ʿumūm wa-l-khuṣūṣ): in mentioning "the people" in general after mentioning the particular ones, namely Abū Sufyān and those with him; this is a case of using the general and intending the particular.

safi-cedvel:174-174.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (انقلبوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma..
and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (بنعمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent pronoun in انقلبوا; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of نعمة; (الواو) conjunction; (فضل) conjoined to نعمة, genitive like it; (لم) a particle of negation, conversion (qalb) and jussivization; (يمسس) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (سوء) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الواو) conjunction; (اتّبعوا) like انقلبوا; (رضوان) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (ذو) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw; (فضل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (عظيم) a naʿt of فضل, genitive like it.
The clause «انقلبوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا in the previous verse.
The clause «لم يمسسهم سوء» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «اتّبعوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause انقلبوا.
The clause «الله ذو فضل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
- Ordered lapping and unfolding (al-laff wa-l-nashr al-murattab): in His saying «بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ», with the mention of what is lapped and unfolded left implicit, namely: bodily safety, which goes back to "blessing", and profit from trade, which goes back to "bounty".

safi-cedvel:175-175.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) a restraining particle and the particle restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (اللام) for distance, (الكاف) for address, and (الميم) a particle for the masculine plural; (الشيطان) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: Or a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative, with the clause يخوّف as the khabar ... or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause يخوّف, and the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative.]»; (يخوف) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو) ... and the first object is implied, i.e. "he makes you fear" (يخوّفكم); (أولياء) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (لا) the prohibitive, jussivizing lā; (تخافوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunction; (خافوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (النون) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء), dropped for lightness, is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (إن) a jussivizing conditional particle; (كنتم) a deficient past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (تم) is the noun of kāna; (مؤمنين) khabar, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «ذلك الشيطان ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يخوّف أولياءه» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الشيطان «[Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.]».
The clause «لا تخافوهم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition «[Note: i.e.: if they urge you to disobedience, then do not fear them ... or: if you are believers, then do not fear them.]».
The clause «خافون» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive or explicative ... and the apodosis of the stated condition is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: if you are believers, then fear Me.

safi-cedvel:97-97.t:
* I'rab:
(في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (آيات) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (بينات) naʿt (adjective) of آيات, nominative like it; (مقام) a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of آيات, nominative (marfūʿ) like it «[Note: It may be a postponed mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. منها مقام ... (among them is the Station ...), and the clause is either a ḥāl (circumstantial) of آيات or a naʿt of it. It may also be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هي.]», and the linking pronoun is implied (muqaddar), i.e. منها; (إبراهيم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, being a diptote; (الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (دخل) a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (كان) an incomplete past verb in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو; (آمنا) khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «فيه آيات ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the relative noun in the previous verse «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position: resumptive.]».
The clause «من دخله كان ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «دخله» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «كان آمنا» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a jussive condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
(الواو) resumptive; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (على الناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; (حجّ) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (البيت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من) a badal (substitute) of part from whole, the whole being الناس; a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, and the linking pronoun is implied, i.e. استطاع منهم (whoever of them is able) «[Note: (من) cannot be the fāʿil of the maṣdar حج, because that would corrupt the meaning.]», (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of (سبيلا) — a naʿt that preceded what it qualifies; (سبيلا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction — or resumptive; (من كفر) like من دخل; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) ism of إنّ, accusative; (غنيّ) khabar, nominative; (عن العالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غنيّ, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «لله على الناس حجّ» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «استطاع» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «من كفر ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».. «[Translator's note: As in the parallel «دخله» above, the clause meant as the khabar is evidently «كفر».]»
The clause «إنّ الله غنيّ ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ, or it is a causal explanation of the omitted apodosis, i.e. فالله مستغن عنه إنّ الله غنيّ عن العالمين (Allah has no need of him; indeed Allah is free of need of the worlds).

* Benefits:
The words of Allah the Exalted: «وَمَنْ دَخَلَهُ كانَ آمِناً».
The grammarians mentioned meanings indicated by the sisters of كان, namely: (a) - what indicates timing:
1- أصبح, for morning timing, e.g. (أصبح الطير منتشرا في الحقل) (the birds were, in the morning, spread over the field).
2- أضحى — for forenoon timing — e.g. (أضحى الجوّ صحوا) (the weather became clear in the forenoon). 3- أمسى — for evening timing: e.g. (أمسى الفلاح عائدا إلى بيته) (in the evening the farmer was returning to his house).
(b) what indicates transformation, such as صار, e.g. (صار البرتقال عصيرا) (the oranges became juice).
(c) what indicates negation, such as ليس, e.g. (ليس الشجر مثمرا) (the trees are not bearing fruit).
(d) - what indicates continuation, such as (ما زال- ما برح- ما فتى- ما انفك), e.g. (ما زال القمر منيرا) (the moon is still shining). (e) what indicates the statement of duration, namely (ما دام), e.g. (ينجح الطالب ما دام مجدا) (the student succeeds as long as he is diligent), i.e. (for the duration of his remaining diligent).

safi-cedvel:176-176.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) the prohibitive, jussivizing lā; (يحزن) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (يسارعون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (في الكفر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of يسارعون «[Note: Or it is attached to the verb يسارعون, by making it imply the meaning "they fall into it" (يقعون فيه).]»; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (هم) a pronoun, the noun of inna, in the position of accusative; (لن) a particle of negation, the accusative and futurity; (يضرّوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (شيئا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is part of it. (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (أن) a maṣdar particle governing the accusative; (لا) negative; (يجعل) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يجعل); (حظا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (في الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (حظّا); (الواو) conjunction; (لهم) like the first one, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (عظيم) a naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألا يجعل ...) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governor being يريد.
The clause «لا يحزنك الذين..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يسارعون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّهم لن يضرّوا ...» has no grammatical position, giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لن يضرّوا..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «يريد الله ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption or parenthetical.
The clause «لا يجعل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لن يضرّوا ...

* Morphology:
(حظّا): the noun meaning "share" (نصيب), of the verb حظّ يحظّ, of the fataḥa class (bāb fataḥa); its pattern is فعل, with a fatḥa followed by a sukūn. It is pluralised as حظوظ, with a ḍamma on the ḥāʾ, حظاظ, with a kasra on the ḥāʾ, and أحظّ, with a fatḥa on the hamza, a ḍamma on the ḥāʾ and a doubled ẓāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- «إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَضُرُّوا اللَّهَ شَيْئاً»: the indefiniteness in His saying «شيئا» is to emphasise the paltriness, contemptibility and insignificance in it.

* Benefits:
1- «يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَلَّا يَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ حَظًّا»: «ألّا» is composed of two words assimilated into each other, namely the accusative-governing أن and the negative لا. When «لا» comes after the accusative-governing أن, as in this example, «لا» does not prevent «أن» from governing, and it remains putting the imperfect verb in the accusative. We know that «أن» is a particle of the maṣdar, the accusative and futurity; and this last property, «futurity», is not exclusive to «أن», but all the accusative-governing particles carry this property, for all of them shift the meaning of the imperfect verb from the present to the future. «أن» does not occur after a verb meaning certainty and firm knowledge; if it does occur there, it is lightened from «أنّ», as in «أفلا يرون أن لا يرجع إليهم قولا».
But if it occurs after what indicates supposition or doubt, it may be made operative or inoperative, and the accusative is preferable. Know that «the أن that puts the imperfect in the accusative is used only in a context of hope and desire, and after what does not indicate certainty or supposition».

safi-cedvel:98-98.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is أنت; (يا) a vocative particle; (أهل) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb); (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (اللام) a preposition and (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تكفرون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تكفرون); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial) — or resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (شهيد) khabar (predicate), nominative; (على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to شهيد; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يا أهل الكتاب» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
The clause «تكفرون» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «الله شهيد» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:99-99.t:
* I'rab:
(قل يا أهل ... سبيل الله) the i'rab of its counterpart was given in the previous verse, in single words and clauses.. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (آمن) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (تبغون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (عوجا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) «[Note: It was said: البغي here is transgression, i.e. they transgress against it or in it ... and al-Zajjāj and al-Ṭabarī said: يبغون means "they seek for it crookedness".. so on this view (عوجا) is a mafʿūl bihi.]», (الواو) of the ḥāl; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (شهداء) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating, operating like ليس; (الله) the Name of Majesty, ism of ما, nominative; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (غافل) genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما; (عن) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by a description, the clause being its description ... It may also be maṣdariyya, with the interpreted maṣdar in the position of genitive.]», mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) غافل; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «آمن» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «تبغونها ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تصدون or of السبيل, or has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أنتم شهداء» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تبغون.
The clause «ما الله بغافل ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause «[Note: Or resumptive with no grammatical position.]».
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(عوجا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb عاج يعوج, of the نصع class «[Translator's note: The source writes «نصع»; evidently نصر is meant.]»; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn. The maṣdar may come with fatḥa on the first radical, but the Arabs distinguished between them, assigning the form with kasra on the first radical to abstract meanings and the form with fatḥa to concrete things.. You say: in his religion and his speech there is عوج, with kasra, and in the wall there is عوج, with fatḥa.

* Benefits:
1- The words of Allah the Exalted: «وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغافِلٍ».
This is the Hijazi negating «ما». It operates like ليس only in the dialect of the people of the Hijaz, in whose dialect the Noble Qur'an came, and in the dialect of the people of Tihāma and Najd; that is why it is called «the Hijazi negating ما». In the dialect of Tamīm, however, it is inoperative, and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ and khabar.
And «the Hijazi ما» operates like ليس only under four conditions:
a- that its khabar does not precede its ism.
b- that what its khabar governs does not precede its ism.
c- that «إن» is not added after it.
d- that its negation is not cancelled by «إلا».
If any one of these conditions is missing, its operation is void, as in the words of Allah the Exalted: وَما أَمْرُنا إِلَّا واحِدَةٌ.

safi-cedvel:100-100.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative, and (ها) for alerting; (الذين) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of accusative — following the position — as a badal (substitute) of أيّ or a naʿt (adjective) of it; (آمنوا) a past verb, mabnī on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إن) a conditional particle making the verb jussive; (تطيعوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (فريقا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt of (فريقا); (أوتوا) a past verb, passive, mabnī on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (يردّوا) like تطيعوا, and it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يردّوكم) «[Note: Or attached to كافرين.]», (إيمان) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (كافرين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ «[Note: Or it is a second mafʿūl bihi of the verb ردّ, if it is among the verbs of transformation.]».
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ان تطيعوا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أوتوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «يردّوكم» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a condition, not joined with the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:142-142.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) it is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) أم meaning بل (rather). (حسبتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent). (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and of the accusative. (تدخلوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الجنّة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تدخلوا ...) is in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi of the verb حسب [Note: or it stands in place of the two objects of حسب - according to the view of Sībawayh. -]. As for the second object, it is omitted, and the implied form is: حسبتم دخولكم الجنّة حاصلا (you thought your entering Paradise to be a settled matter).
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لمّا) a particle of negation, of the jussive and of converting [the imperfect to past meaning]. (يعلم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (جاهدوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil. (الواو) the wāw of accompaniment (al-maʿiyya). (يعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) concealed after the wāw of accompaniment [Note: Shudhūr al-Dhahab of Ibn Hishām ... Some explained the fatḥa by saying that the verb is jussive - not accusative - conjoined to the first يعلم, and was given a fatḥa because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, since the fatḥa is the lightest of the vowels.], and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الصابرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلم) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the speech before it, i.e. ... and there is not yet knowledge of who strove and knowledge of who was patient.
The clause «حسبتم..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تدخلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «يعلم الله ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl, i.e.: did you think that you would enter Paradise while your state is this state? [Note: See Shudhūr al-Dhahab of Ibn Hishām, p. 375, third edition.].
The clause «جاهدوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يعلم الصابرين» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).

safi-cedvel:143-143.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (اللام) occurring in the answer of an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (كنتم) a defective past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and تم is a pronoun, the ism (subject) of kāna. (تمنّون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) - one of the two tāʾs has been deleted from it - and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الموت) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تمنّون), (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and of the accusative. (تلقوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تلقوه) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(الفاء) conjunction. (قد) like the first. (رأيتم) a past verb and its fāʿil - the seeing is either visual or mental - [Note: Abū Ḥayyān said: His saying تنظرون after His saying رأيتموه [indicates] that the seeing here is mental, and the second object is omitted, its implied form being حاضرا (present). Visual seeing of death is by seeing its effects, and the verb then takes one object.], and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), from the lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the ḍamma of the mīm, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) [Note: If the meaning is: you are looking into your deed now after the end of the battle, then the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumed.], (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (تنظرون) like تمنّون.
The clause كنتم تمنّون ... has no grammatical position, being the answer of an implied oath ... and the oath is conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «تمنّون الموت» is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate) of كنتم.
The clause «تلقوه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «رأيتموه» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كنتم تمنّون.
The clause «أنتم تنظرون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «تنظرون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم.

* Morphology:
(تمنّون), in it one of the two tāʾs is deleted for lightness; its origin is تتمنّون. In it there is also iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: its lām (third radical), which is the alif, was deleted from it because it came vowelless before the vowelless wāw of the plural, and the letter before the wāw was given a fatḥa as an indication of the alif.
Its pattern is تفعّون.
(تلقوه), in it there is iʿlāl by deletion, following the course of (تمنّون) (see verse 37 of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān).

safi-cedvel:144-144.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative, inoperative (muhmala). (محمّد) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (إلّا) a particle of restriction. (رسول) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (خلت) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif which was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلت), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الرسل) fāʿil (agent), nominative. (الهمزة) for interrogation of denial (istifhām inkārī). (الفاء) conjunction. (إن) a jussive-causing conditional particle. (مات) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (أو) a conjunction. (قتل) a past verb, passive, in the position of the jussive, conjoined to مات, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (انقلب) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil. (على أعقاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انقلبتم), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction - or resumptive -. (من) a jussive-causing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (ينقلب) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (على عقبي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينقلب), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) linking to the apodosis. (لن) a particle of negation and of the accusative. (يضرّ) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (شيئا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. he will not harm Him with any harm at all. (الواو) resumptive. (السين) a particle of the future. (يجزي) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الشاكرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «ما محمّد إلّا رسول» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «خلت ... الرسل» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt (adjective) of رسول.
The clause «إن مات ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «قتل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to مات.
The clause «انقلبتم..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من ينقلب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause - or resumptive.
The clause «ينقلب ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «لن يضرّ الله» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «سيجزي الله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(محمّد), a proper name derived from الحمد (praise), on the form of the passive participle of the quadriliteral (حمّد); its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His saying, the Exalted, «وَما مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ» is the art of qaṣr (restriction). Linguistically it means confinement, and technically it is the specifying of one of two matters over the other and negating it of everything else. It occurs as restriction of the qualified to the quality and the reverse; the verse is of the first type, i.e. others like him have passed away before him, so he will pass away as they passed away. The restriction is reversing (qalbī), for when they turned back on their heels it was as though they believed that he, upon him be blessings and peace, was a messenger not like the other messengers in that he would pass away as they passed away, and that it was obligatory to hold fast to his religion after him just as it was obligatory to hold fast to their religion after them. So He refuted them by saying that he is nothing but a messenger like the other messengers, so he will pass away as they passed away, and it is obligatory to hold fast to his religion just as it is obligatory to hold fast to theirs. It was also said that it is a restriction of singling (qaṣr ifrād), for when they found it momentous that he, upon him be blessings and peace, would not remain with them, they were treated as those who deem his perishing far-fetched, as if they believed two attributes of him: messengership and remoteness from perishing. So He refuted them by saying that he is restricted to messengership and does not go beyond it to remoteness from perishing.

safi-cedvel:145-145.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative. (كان) a defective past verb. (لنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna. (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle and of the accusative. (تموت) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هي.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تموت) is in the position of the nominative as the ism (subject) of kāna.
(الّا) a particle of restriction. (بإذن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of تموت [Note: i.e. it dies with its term ending by the permission of Allah.], (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (كتابا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being كتب ذلك (He has decreed that). (مؤجلا) naʿt (adjective), accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (من) a jussive-causing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (يرد) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (ثواب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الدنيا) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (نؤت) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being نحن, for majesty. (من) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (نؤته). (الواو) conjunction. (من يرد ... نؤته منها) like the preceding. (الواو) conjunction. (السين) a particle of the future. (نجزي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is نحن, for majesty. (الشاكرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «ما كان لنفس أن تموت» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «تموت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «من يرد» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يرد ثواب ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «1».
The clause «نؤته منها» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من يرد (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من يرد (the first).
The clause «يرد ثواب (the second)» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of (من) «2».
The clause «نؤته (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «سنجزي ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(كتابا), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun); its verb is كتب يكتب, of the class of نصر, meaning to prescribe and decree; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ.
(مؤجلا), a passive participle from the quadriliteral verb أجّل; its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.
(ثواب), a noun of maṣdar from the quadriliteral verbs أثاب or ثوّب; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ; or it is a noun for that with which one is rewarded.
(يرد), in it there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive; its origin is يريد. The yāʾ is converted from a wāw, because its bare form is راد يرود. Its imperfect in the quadriliteral was originally يرود with sukūn on the rāʾ and kasra on the wāw; the vowel on the wāw was felt heavy and transferred to the rāʾ; the letter before the wāw became kasra-voweled, so the wāw was converted to yāʾ, and it was said يريد.. The pattern of يرد is يفل with ḍamma on the yāʾ of the imperfect.
(نؤته), in it the hamza is deleted from its beginning for lightness, following the course of ننفق; its origin is نؤأته, just as [the origin of ننفق] was نؤنفق. In it there is also iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive; its origin is نؤتيه. Its pattern is نفعه with ḍamma on the nūn and kasra on the ʿayn (al-Baqara - 247).

safi-cedvel:146-146.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (كأيّ) a noun of allusion (kināya) to a number, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (من نبيّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, tamyīz (specification). (قاتل) a past verb. (مع) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قاتل), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (ربّيّون) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the wāw [Note: The fāʿil of قاتل may be a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو, referring back to نبيّ; in that case (ربّيّون) is a postponed mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is the adverb معه, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil pronoun in قاتل.], (كثير) naʿt (adjective) of (ربّيّون), nominative like it [Note: (كثير) remained singular because it is an adjective on the pattern فعيل, in which singular and plural are the same.], (الفاء) conjunction. (ما) negative. (وهنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.
And the wāw is the fāʿil. (اللام) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (وهنوا) [Note: (ما) may be an indefinite noun qualified (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of the genitive, and the clause after it a naʿt of it.], (أصاب) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أصابهم) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (أصابهم), i.e. it befell them while striving in the way of Allah.], (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (ما ضعفوا) like ما وهنوا. (الواو) conjunction. (ما استكانوا) like ما وهنوا. (الواو) resumptive. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative. (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (الصابرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «كأيّ من نبيّ قاتل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قاتل معه ربّيّون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ كأيّ [Note: The clause may be a naʿt of نبيّ in the position of the genitive, and the khabar of كأيّ is the clause معه ربّيّون ... or the khabar is omitted, its implied form being مضى (passed away) or صبر (was patient) ... etc., and the clause معه ربّيّون becomes a second naʿt of نبيّ.].
The clause «ما وهنوا» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause قاتل [Note: This clause takes a position in the i'rab, just as the clause it is conjoined to, which is the clause قاتل, takes one in the other case mentioned in footnote no. (5).].
The clause «أصابهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «ما ضعفوا» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause ما وهنوا.
The clause «ما استكانوا» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause ما وهنوا.
The clause «الله يحبّ ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يحبّ الصابرين» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).

* Morphology:
(كأيّ، كأيّن), without nūn or with nūn, an allusion to a number. For its various states and the many opinions about it, refer to the books of grammar and the references of the language.
(ربّيّون), plural of ربّي, attributive (nisba) to الربّ (the Lord); it was also said that it is attributive to الربة with kasra on the rāʾ, which is the group.
(And see verse 79 of this sūra).
(استكانوا), in it there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion). Its origin is استكينوا with fatḥa on the yāʾ; then its vowel was transferred to the kāf, then it was converted to alif because it was voweled originally.

* Benefits:
1- «كأي» is like the predicative كم (kam al-khabariyya) in meaning, as in «وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ آيَةٍ فِي السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ». It is originally compounded of the kāf of simile and «أيّ», and because the tanwīn became part of its composition it was written with the nūn, so it is now a single word; it may be written «كأيّ» according to its origin. There is another dialect form in it, where it is pronounced «كأين», as in the saying of the poet:
وكائن ترى من صامت لك معجب ... زيادته أو نقصه في التكلم
(How many a silent man you see who pleases you ... his excess or deficiency shows when he speaks.)
It has the meaning of «كم» and agrees with it in five matters: vagueness, need for a tamyīz, indeclinability, obligatory placement at the head of the sentence, and conveying abundance, which is the usual case, as in His saying, the Exalted: وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ قاتَلَ مَعَهُ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٌ. It differs from it in five matters:
The first: that كأين is compound while كم is simple. The second: that its tamyīz is usually genitive with «من», as has passed in the verse and before it «وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ لا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا». The third: that it does not occur as interrogative, according to the majority. The fourth: that it does not occur in the genitive. The fifth: that its khabar does not occur as a single word but as a clause, as has passed in the verses mentioned.

safi-cedvel:101-101.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) «[Note: The interrogative came for rebuke and to bring the believers to wonder.]», (تكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) of the ḥāl; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تتلى) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تتلى); (آيات) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (فيكم) like عليكم, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (رسول) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun making the verb jussive, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يعتصم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is هو; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعتصم); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قد) a particle of verification; (هدي) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, referring to (من); (إلى صراط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هدي); (مستقيم) naʿt (adjective) of صراط, genitive like it.
The clause «تكفرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer to the vocative in the previous verse.
The clause «أنتم تتلى» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «تتلى ... آيات» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم.
The clause «فيكم رسوله» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.
The clause «من يعتصم..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يعتصم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «هدي ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
1- From the history of the Jews.
The Jews never cease — whenever the opportunity arises for them — to sow the seeds of discord among the members of society, as a means of weakening people's standing and raising the standing of the Jews. This kind of corruption was frequent in the time of the Messenger; one of their men strove to spoil relations within the ranks of the Anṣār, between al-Aws and al-Khazraj, until they almost fought one another, had it not been for the Messenger going out to them and bringing them back into the fold of love and harmony and casting the call of the Jāhiliyya behind their backs.

safi-cedvel:102-102.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيّها الذين آمنوا) its i'rab was given «[Note: In verse (100) of this sūra.]», (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (حقّ) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; (تقاته) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).. and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تموتنّ) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw, deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and the nūn is the nūn of emphasis, with no grammatical position; (الّا) a particle of restriction; (الواو) of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (مسلمون) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «اتّقوا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «لا تموتنّ» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أنتم مسلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

safi-cedvel:103-103.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (اعتصموا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بحبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اعتصموا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (جميعا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), of the fāʿil in (اعتصموا); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تفرّقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and one of the two tāʾs was deleted from the verb; (الواو) conjunction — or resumptive; (اذكروا) like اعتصموا; (نعمة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of نعمة; (إذ) an adverb for the past, mabnī, in the position of accusative, attached to نعمة — because it includes the meaning of the maṣdar (verbal noun) — or a badal (substitute) of نعمة; (كنتم) an incomplete past verb, mabnī on the sukūn, and (تم) an attached pronoun, ism of كان, in the position of nominative; (أعداء) khabar of كنتم, accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (ألّف) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (ألّف); (قلوب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (أصبحتم) like كنتم; (بنعمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of (إخوانا) «[Note: al-ʿUkbarī allowed the attachment to be to an omitted khabar of أصبح, with (إخوانا) a ḥāl of the pronoun of the addressee, i.e. you became clothed in His favour.. as brothers.. As for his statement that the verb (أصبح) may be complete, that is far-fetched.]», and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (إخوانا) khabar of أصبح, accusative.
The clause «اعتصموا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer to the vocative in the previous verse.
The clause «لا تفرّقوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اعتصموا.
The clause «اذكروا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اعتصموا, or it is resumptive with no grammatical position.
The clause «كنتم أعداء» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ألّف» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause كنتم.
The clause «أصبحتم ... إخوانا» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause ألّف.
(الواو) conjunction — or resumptive; (كنتم) like the first; (على شفا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of كنتم, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (حفرة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من النار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حفرة; (الفاء) conjunction; (أنقذ) like ألّف, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أنقذ); (الكاف) a preposition «[Note: The kāf may be a noun meaning مثل (like), so that it is a naʿt of the omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), in the position of accusative.]», (ذا) a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e.: يبيّن الله لكم آياته بيانا كذلك (Allah makes clear to you His signs with a clarification like that), and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; يبيّن an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (لكم) like عليكم, attached to (يبيّن); (آيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative, ism of لعلّ; (تهتدون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «كنتم على شفا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the first clause كنتم ... or has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أنقذكم» is conjoined to the clause كنتم على شفا and takes its position.
The clause «يبيّن الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لعلّكم تهتدون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تهتدون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(تفرّقوا): its original form is تتفرّقوا, one of the two tāʾs having been deleted from the verb for lightness.
(شفا): the alif in it is originally a wāw; its dual is شفوان and it is pluralized as أشفاء ...
And in al-Miṣbāḥ: the شفا of anything is its edge; it is a noun from شفا يشفو, of the نصر class; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(حفرة): a noun for what is dug in the ground; its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma then sukūn; its plural is حفر with ḍamma then fatḥa.

* Rhetoric:
1- In the speech there is a representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya): the state of the believers in seeking support from one of the things mentioned, and their confidence in its protection, is likened to the state of one hanging down from a high place holding fast to a firm rope that is safe from breaking, without regard to any figurative usage in the individual words; and the expressions used for the thing likened-to were borrowed for the thing likened.
2- Antithesis (ṭibāq): between أعداء (enemies) and اخوان (brothers).

* Benefits:
1- العصام and العصمة: refuge and shelter. It is stated in fiqh al-lugha (the philology of the language) that when ʿayn and ṣād occur as the first and second radicals of a word, they indicate strength, impregnability and the like, as in رجل عصامي (a self-made man) and ذو عصبية قوية (having strong partisanship), and in العصا (the stick), العصيان (disobedience), العصر (pressing), المعصرة (the press), and عصفت الريح فهي عاصفة (the wind blew violently, so it is a storm). This is one of the secrets of our eloquent language, the language of the Revelation and the language of concise comprehensive speech.
2- حَقَّ تُقاتِهِ: the description came annexed to what it describes, for the firm establishment of the description and intensification by it on the one hand, and for musical sound (jaras) on the other. Expression through sound in His verses, Exalted is He, is not to be denied, because Allah willed that His Book be accompanied by all the elements of influence upon the heart and mind of the hearer, so He made musical sound one of the elements and factors of this influence.
3- شَفا حُفْرَةٍ: «الشفا» may be treated as masculine or feminine; the pronoun referring to it came feminine: «فأنقذكم منها». If we regard «الشفا» as feminine, the referring pronoun agrees with what it refers to; and if we regard الشفا as masculine, it has acquired femininity from what it is annexed to, namely «الحفرة». This is a regular way in the world of grammar and language: a masculine muḍāf may acquire femininity from a feminine muḍāf ilayhi, just as a feminine muḍāf may acquire masculinity from a masculine muḍāf ilayhi. An example of the first is the saying of the poet:
وما حب الديار شغفن قلبي ... ولكن حب من سكن الديارا
(It is not love of the dwellings that has infatuated my heart, but love of the one who dwelt in the dwellings.)

safi-cedvel:104-104.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction — or resumptive; (اللام) the lām of command; (تكن) an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) — or complete; (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أمة — a naʿt (adjective) that preceded what it qualifies «[Note: Or attached to (تكن) if it is complete ... and some allowed it to be attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb تكن.]», (أمّة) ism of the incomplete تكن — or fāʿil (agent) of the complete تكن; (يدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلى الخير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدعون); (الواو) conjunction; (يأمرون) like يدعون; (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأمرون); (الواو) conjunction; (ينهون عن المنكر) like يدعون إلى الخير; (الواو) resumptive or of the ḥāl; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (هم) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is المفلحون, and the clause هم المفلحون is the khabar of أولئك.]», (المفلحون) khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «لتكن منكم أمّة» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اعتصموا «[Note: In verse (103) of this sūra.]» ... or it has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يدعون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of the incomplete تكن — or in the position of nominative as a naʿt of أمة if (تكن) is parsed as complete «[Note: Likewise it is a naʿt of أمة if the khabar is taken to be the preposition and its genitive noun (منكم).]».
The clause «يأمرون ...» is conjoined to the clause يدعون and takes its position.
The clause «ينهون ...» is conjoined to the clause يدعون and takes its position.
The clause «أولئك ... المفلحون» has no grammatical position: resumptive ... or is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(الخير): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb خار يخير, of the ضرب class; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; it is the opposite of evil; its plural is خيور with ḍamma on the khāʾ.
(المنكر): passive participle of the four-letter أنكر, meaning he found fault with it and forbade it; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the second radical; its plurals are منكرات and مناكر.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ»: the conjunction in the verse is of the type of conjoining the specific to the general, to show their superiority over all other good deeds, like the conjoining of Jibrīl and Mīkāl to the angels, peace be upon them.
The detail of that is that calling to good is general, and following it with commanding the right and forbidding the wrong signals that these two are singled out for extra attention, and shows their superiority over the other good deeds.
- Contrast (muqābala): He set in correspondence command and prohibition, and the right (al-maʿrūf) and the wrong (al-munkar).

* Benefits:
1- «وَلْتَكُنْ»: the lām of command is originally with kasra, but when it occurs after the wāw and the fāʾ it is mostly made quiescent, as in «فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي»; it may be made quiescent after ثمّ. The lām of command enters upon the verb specific to the third person, active and passive, and upon the first person other than him (the speaker alone), its entry upon it being easier and lighter, as in «وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطاياكُمْ»; that is because a single person does not command himself, but if someone else is with him the matter becomes easier, because the other shares in what he commands. Less frequent than that is the entry of the lām upon the active verb of the addressee, because it has a special form, namely «افعل». «[Translator's note: The source writes «وعلى المخاطب غيره»; from the example «وَلْنَحْمِلْ» and the following explanation, the first person (the speaker with others) is evidently meant.]»
Then, requesting an action or its abandonment, when it is from the lower to the higher, is called a supplication (duʿāʾ), out of courtesy, and «the lām» and «lā» are called two particles of supplication, as in «لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنا رَبُّكَ» and as in «لا تؤاخذنا بما فعل السفهاء منا»; likewise a command in the imperative form is called a verb of «supplication», as in «رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي». This way is part of the etiquette of speaking, especially with Allah.

safi-cedvel:177-177.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (اشتروا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, which was dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (الكفر) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (بالإيمان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اشتروا), by making it imply the meaning of بدّلوا ("they exchanged"); (لن يضرّوا الله شيئا): its i'rab has been given in the previous verse; (الواو) conjunction; (لهم عذاب أليم): the i'rab of its counterpart has been given in the previous verse.
The clause إنّ الذين اشتروا ... has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause اشتروا ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause لن يضرّوا ... is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لن يضرّوا.

* Rhetoric:
- «إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الْكُفْرَ بِالْإِيْمانِ», i.e. they took it in exchange for it, out of desire for what they took and turning away from what they left; "buying" is by way of an implied metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya).

safi-cedvel:178-178.t:
«[Note: It is written thus in the muṣḥaf, but the orthographically correct form is to write it separately (أنّ ما), whether ما is relative or maṣdar, so that it is not confused with the redundant, restraining ما.]» .
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) the prohibitive, jussivizing lā «[Note: Because there is a reading with the tāʾ (تحسبنّ).]»; (يحسبنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive ... and (النون) is the heavy nūn of emphasis; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the noun of anna «[Note: Or it is a maṣdar particle which, with what follows it, is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as the noun of anna, i.e.:
that Our granting them respite is good.]»; (نملي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "we" (نحن), for majesty; (اللام) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نملي) ... and the resumptive pronoun of the relative is omitted, its implied form being نمليه; (خير) the khabar (predicate) of anna, nominative; (لأنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إنّما) a restraining particle and the particle restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa), with no governing effect; (نملي لهم) like the first one; (اللام) a particle of causation (taʿlīl); (يزدادوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after the lām, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (إثما) a tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ ما نملي ...) stands in place of the two objects of يحسب.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يزدادوا ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to the second (نملي).
(الواو) conjunction; (لهم عذاب مهين): the i'rab of its counterpart has been given «[Note: In verse (176) of this sūra.]».
The clause «لا يحسبنّ ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «نملي ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative.
The clause «إنّما نملي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive and giving a reason.
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the second clause نملي.

* Rhetoric:
1- «أَنَّما نُمْلِي لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ»: borrowed from أملى لفرسه, said when one lengthens the tether for one's horse so that it may graze as it wishes. He likened granting them respite and leaving the rope on their withers to the horse whose rope is let out so that it may run as it pleases; He omitted the thing likened, namely respite and leaving alone, and kept what it is likened to, namely letting out the rope (الإملاء). This is of the type of explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya).

* Benefits:
1- The saying of Allah the Exalted: «أَنَّما نُمْلِي لَهُمْ»: أنّ, which resembles the verb, and «ما», maṣdar or relative - both are permissible - ought by rights to be written separately, but they have remained joined in order to preserve the script of the Noble Qur'an and to protect it from change. There is much of this kind in the script of the Qur'an, and changing the script in what is not the Qur'an does no harm.

safi-cedvel:179-179.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negative; (كان) a deficient past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of kāna, nominative (marfūʿ); (اللام) the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd) or of rejection; (يذر) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after the lām of denial, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (المؤمنين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يذر ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna, i.e. Allah was not intending to leave the believers.
(على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (يذر); (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (عليه) a preposition and a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (يميز) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن), its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (الخبيث) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من الطيّب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يميز).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يميز ...) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (يذر).
(الواو) conjunction; (ما كان الله ليطلع) like ما كان الله ليذر, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (على الغيب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يطلع); (الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk); (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of lākinna, accusative; (يجتبي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (من رسل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجتبي), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يشاء) an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil is "he"; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (آمنوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنوا); (الواو) conjunction; (رسل) conjoined to the Name of Majesty, genitive like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (إن) a jussivizing conditional particle; (تؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (تتّقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the verb تؤمنوا.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (أجر) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عظيم) a naʿt (adjective) of أجر, nominative like it.
The clause «ما كان الله ليذر ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يذر ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «أنتم عليه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يميز ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «ما كان الله ليطلعكم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يطلعكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the maṣdar relative particle (أن).
The clause «لكنّ الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the second clause ما كان..
The clause «يجتبي ...» has no grammatical position, being the khabar of lākinna «[Translator's note: so in the source; as the khabar of lākinna, the clause would be in the position of nominative.]».
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied non-jussivizing condition, i.e.: when the one chosen by Allah comes to you, then believe in him.
The clause «تؤمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تتّقوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تؤمنوا.
The clause «لكم أجر» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
The saying of Allah the Exalted: «حَتَّى يَمِيزَ الْخَبِيثَ».
The imperfect verb is put in the accusative by an «أن» that must be implied after «حتى» when it is the prepositional حتى, meaning (إلى "until", or the lām of causation), as in «قالُوا: لَنْ نَبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عاكِفِينَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنا مُوسى» and the saying «أطع الله حتى تفوز برضاه» ("Obey Allah so that you may attain His good pleasure"). It may mean «إلّا» ("except"), as in the saying of the poet:
ليس العطاء من الفضول سماحة ... حتى تجود وما لديك قليل
(Giving from one's surplus is not generosity, unless you give when what you have is little.)
For the verb after it to be put in the accusative by an implied أن, it is required that it be future, either relative to the speaker's speech or relative to what precedes it.
If the verb is meant in the sense of the present, then «أن» is not implied; rather the verb after it is definitely nominative, as in «مرض فلان حتى ما يرجونه» ("So-and-so fell ill, so that they no longer hope for him"). In this case حتى is a particle of commencement and what follows it is nominative because it is free of any accusative or jussive governor; it is a particle with which clauses begin.
The sign that the verb is for the present is that it is correct to put the fāʾ in place of «حتى», as in your saying «مرض فلان فلا يرجونه».

safi-cedvel:180-180.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction or resumptive; (لا يحسبنّ الذين): its i'rab has been given «[Note: In verse (178) of this sūra.]»; (يبخلون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يبخلون); (آتى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (من فضل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آتاهم), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (هو) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no governing effect; (خيرا) second mafʿūl bihi, its governor being يحسبنّ, while the first object is omitted, the context of the speech indicating it, namely "the stinginess" (البخل); (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (خيرا); (بل) a particle of digression (iḍrāb), stripped of conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (شرّ) khabar (predicate), nominative; (لهم) like the first one, attached to شرّ.
(السين) a particle of futurity; (يطوّقون) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative ... and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (بخلوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (بخلوا); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (يطوّقون); (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) parenthetical; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (ميراث) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (الأرض) conjoined to السموات, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (بما) like the first one, attached to خبير «[Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a maṣdar particle ... and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to خبير.]»; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (خبير) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الله, nominative.
The clause «لا يحسبنّ الذين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا يحسبنّ الذين كفروا ... and what lies between the two clauses has the status of a parenthesis «[Note: It is permissible for the clause to be resumptive.]».
The clause «يبخلون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «آتاهم الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «هو شرّ لهم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «سيطوّقون ...» has no grammatical position, giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «بخلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «لله ميراث ...» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «الله ... خبير» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause سيطوّقون.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(ميراث): a noun for what is left after death, from ورث يرث, of the wathiqa class (bāb wathiqa). The word involves a phonetic change by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb): its original form is موراث, on the pattern مفعال with a kasra on the mīm; when the wāw came vowelless after a kasra, it was changed into a yāʾ, and it became ميراث.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ»: using the majestic Name overtly where a pronoun would be expected, in order to instil awe.
And the iltifāt (shift) from the third person to the second person in His saying «تعملون», to intensify the threat and to signal the severity of the wrath of the All-Merciful arising from the mention of their vile deeds.
2- Muqābala (contrast): He set in antithesis خير and شر, and السموات and الأرض.

* Benefits:
1- A difference in reading:
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «ولا يحسبنّ» there are two readings, the second of them being «ولا يحسبنّ» «[Translator's note: both readings appear identically in the source; the second is evidently the reading with the tāʾ (ولا تحسبنّ).]». The difference in reading results in omission and implication in the two objects of حسب, and behind that lies a precise and useful discussion in «Mughnī al-Labīb», in its fifth chapter. If it indicates anything, it indicates the convolutedness of the grammarians and their contrivance in matters which it would have been better, for them and for readers, to simplify as far as they could. Their long, tedious disagreement may be dispensed with by the saying of one of them:
It is permissible to omit one of the two objects of the verbs of the heart (afʿāl al-qulūb) for brevity, if there is evidence indicating it. The majority permitted that by analogy with the verbs whose object is omitted, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted:
«هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لا يَعْلَمُونَ» and His saying «كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا وَلا تُسْرِفُوا». Whoever has an interest in this labour should consult Mughnī al-Labīb.
